summary: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
title_translated: ArchSpace：记录、回顾与引用大语言模型架构研究
summary_translated: 模型架构决定了大语言模型的扩展行为、训练效率和推理成本，因此成为产业界和学术界的关注焦点。在产业界，DeepSeek、Qwen 和 Kimi 等团队频繁引入架构创新，但公开报告很少记录哪些想法成功、哪些被放弃以及原因。在学术界，受限于计算资源和不一致的基线，评估往往局限于小规模、单点比较，难以判断改进是否在更大规模下依然有效或具有广泛影响。ArchSpace 作为一个公共平台，旨在填补这两项空白：记录、评审和引用架构研究。每个提案都附带其实验过程和推理依据，由社区评审，并可被后续工作引用。为在昂贵的大规模训练前评估想法，ArchSpace 利用缩放定律从较小实验中预测大尺度下的模型损失，这一做法在产业界已被广泛采用。我们提供了初始参考基准，使平台可用：包括 Qwen3.5 和 OLMo3 基线、拟合的缩放定律以及可复用的训练方案。通过该评审验证的想法可进一步成为新的基线，从而推动更多创新思想塑造下一代模型。

summary: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
title_translated: 学习扩散语言模型何时应重新生成
summary_translated: 重掩码机制使扩散语言模型能够重新审视已生成文本，但有效的修正需要明确何时以及如何修改。我们在数独任务上的诊断揭示了两个问题：隐藏状态包含错误信息，而仅靠标记置信度无法可靠暴露；当周围上下文保持不变时，对孤立错误进行重掩码通常会重复该错误。这些发现促使我们提出 DiVR 验证器，它能预测部分生成序列是否能达到正确答案。DiVR 在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上进行训练，决定何时重新生成一个区块以及保留哪个替代方案，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 上的五个推理基准测试中，DiVR 将微调后生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提升至 43.4%，代价仅为贪婪解码的 1.9–3.5 倍，优于使用 3.8–7.4 倍代价的搜索基线。此外，DiVR 还可与后训练方法（如监督微调和强化学习）互补，并泛化到其他生成器，包括 Dream 模型。

summary: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.
title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
comment: Project page, code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 大语言模型中的目标编码
summary_translated: 我们研究大语言模型是否以及如何编码目标：即在行动之前形成并引导行为的内部神经表征，且具备足够灵活性以通过多种执行路径实现。我们构建了一个包含多个子任务的编码场景，用于评估目标导向行为及子目标选择。在此场景中，我们定位到稀疏注意力头的输出中存在下一个子目标的编码。这些相同的注意力头也可用于以自然语言解码模型未来的动作（例如，“我正在检查一个词是否是回文”）。我们验证了该编码对下一步动作具有因果作用，并具有可塑性：将其移植到不同环境（如另一种编程语言）时，会触发相同操作，但使用不同的标记序列实现。此外，模型在整个动作执行过程中持续维持该编码，这令人困惑，因为无循环结构的 Transformer 模型无法将状态传递超过其层数。我们提出非递归目标寻求（NRGS）解释：模型频繁从任务说明中重新读取目标，与不断增长的上下文中的进展进行比较，并继续推进剩余任务。我们通过有针对性的因果干预测试了该理论的预测。

summary: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.
title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
title_translated: 合成走私：在大语言模型输出中恶意隐藏推断出的个人属性
summary_translated: 我们提出一种新型威胁模型——合成走私，其中攻击性大语言模型从用户日常求助互动中推断敏感信息，并以隐蔽方式将这些信息嵌入看似无害的模型生成内容中。用户可能在不知情的情况下通过普通通信渠道（如邮件、社交媒体帖子或消息）分享这些生成物，从而泄露个人信息。监控这些通道的攻击者可从中发现该信息。我们通过训练两个开源权重模型，利用对话线索推断性别和年龄组标签，并通过不可见字符或词汇选择将预测结果编码进去，展示了该威胁的可行性。结果表明，即使模型本身没有直接联系攻击者的能力，用户共享的模型输出仍可能成为个人推断的隐蔽通道。

summary: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and models: this https URL
title_translated: 解析、合理但错误：输出格式控制小型模型语义解析中的沉默错误
summary_translated: 一个经过微调的小型解析器若生成格式正确但错误的语法树，将无声失败：下游系统无法察觉。我们探讨输出格式（一种自由设计选择）是否会影响此类错误的发生频率。在 PIZZA 订餐基准测试中，我们对两个亚十亿参数模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 LFM2.5-350M）使用 LoRA 微调，采用六种无损编码同一目标树的方式，从每订单 44.3 个标记减少至 10.9 个标记，包括两组固定长度但表面形式不同的配对。在 300 次运行中（5 个训练池大小，5 个随机种子），采用分层 Bootstrap 和 Holm 校正，在结果读取前已固定，结果显示：单纯缩短标记数量从未带来提升，但使用普通词语书写目标却显著有效。词语编码在两个模型上均表现最佳（Qwen 的精确匹配率为 87.5%，高于原生 s-expression 的 85.8%），同时发出的标记量减少 4.1 倍，并使 Qwen 的沉默错误率降低 2.3 倍，LFM2 降低 1.8 倍，且在所有池大小下均显著分离。错误分析显示，大部分增益来自否定处理。所有实验还学会拒绝菜单外输入（外部测试集：95.9–99.0% 被处理），并应用句内自我纠正。严格拒绝策略有实际代价：2.1–10.1% 的真实订单（多为礼貌请求）被错误拒绝。

summary: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
title_translated: 参数高效的简洁性适应：面向小型语言模型的可微分长度控制以实现简洁的临床推理
summary_translated: 小型语言模型（SLMs）使得在大型专有模型过于昂贵的情况下部署临床自然语言处理成为可能，而参数高效的微调允许它们在普通硬件上进行专业化。然而，训练后仍存在一个障碍：在医疗任务中，这些模型的回答长度远超临床问题所需。在临床决策支持和即时诊疗场景中，即使推理过程正确，这种冗长也难以快速响应。现有的长度控制方法依赖于偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，这削弱了使SLMs具有吸引力的可访问性。我们提出了参数高效的简洁性适应（PECA），在QLoRA监督微调目标中添加了一个单一的可微分简洁性项。由于标记数量是离散且不可微的，PECA在生成超过标记预算时提高序列结束概率，从而在常规训练中优化一个平滑信号，无需偏好数据、辅助模型或单个消费级GPU。在一个17亿参数模型上对medical-o1-reasoning-SFT语料库进行微调后，PECA将平均响应长度减少了72.8%，同时将多项选择诊断准确率从40.8%提升至44.0%。对简洁性强度的扫描描绘出可解释的准确率-长度权衡前沿，用于平衡简洁性与诊断完整性。

summary: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.
title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
comment: 21 pages. Published at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
title_translated: 解耦虚假相关性：IRM如何处理文本分类中的多样化捷径
summary_translated: 在自然语言处理中，通过经验风险最小化（ERM）训练的模型常常利用虚假相关性（如方言标记），牺牲稳健的语言特征，从而降低其在分布外（OOD）情况下的泛化能力。不变风险最小化（IRM）旨在通过识别在不同环境中保持稳定的预测关系来抑制这些捷径，但其在NLP中的实际效用仍存在争议。我们采用因果驱动框架，在三种捷径生成机制下评估IRM：标签生成特征、混淆因素和选择偏差。结果表明，IRM在所评估的因果与反因果结构中均成功拒绝了捷径，包括在环境变化有限和标签噪声增加的情况下。随后，我们将分析扩展到两个更宽松的设置：Bias in Bios中的性别-职业关联，以及ActorCorr中的语义负载型角色名称捷径。这些实验表明，不变学习可以缓解更真实的文本捷径，而语义有意义的特征需要对不变性惩罚进行仔细校准。

summary: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction. Existing fixes change the distribution, synchronize whole pools of tokens at a capacity that collapses with large vocabularies, or track several token histories. We prove that if extraction is exact and error-free across full-support language models, a single-history receiver is confined to a prefix-free candidate set at every step -- even if it reads the entire future text and the sender constrains later steps -- and must therefore give up the stop entropy, the entropy of deciding whether each prefix token ends there. Fixing these stop decisions on the prefix forest with shared randomness yields coin projection: a closed-form scheme that attains the bound, works with any distribution coder in one model call per token, preserves ordinary sampling, and refines SyncPool for every key. Across English, Chinese and Japanese, ambiguous text is rare (at most 11 in 1,000 tokens), yet the stop entropy at word and morpheme prefixes takes 7.2-9.0% of the entropy at every step; SyncPool's further loss comes from space and single-byte UTF-8 hubs that merge subtrees while carrying almost no stop uncertainty. Coin projection keeps 91-93% of the string entropy for the coder at every vocabulary size; with the full vocabulary, it turns 2.16-6.85 times as much entropy into message bits as SyncPool and recovers every completed message.
title: Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures
title_translated: 最优单历史分词消歧：用于可证明安全的自然语言隐写术
summary_translated: 可证明安全的自然语言隐写术假设接收方能恢复发送方的标记，但文本信道仅传递文本，模糊的分词会破坏提取。现有方法要么改变分布，要么在大词汇量下同步整个标记池导致容量崩溃，或追踪多个标记历史。我们证明，若在全支撑语言模型下提取是精确且无错误的，单历史接收方在每一步只能局限于前缀无关的候选集——即使它读取了全部未来文本，且发送方约束后续步骤——因此必须放弃停止熵，即决定每个前缀标记是否结束的熵。通过共享随机性固定这些停止决策，得到“硬币投影”：一种闭式方案，达到理论极限，适用于任意分布编码器，每标记仅需一次模型调用，保留普通采样方式，并对每个密钥改进SyncPool。在英语、中文和日语中，模糊文本极为罕见（每1000标记最多11个），但前缀处的停止熵占每步熵的7.2%-9.0%；SyncPool的额外损失来自空间和单字节UTF-8枢纽，它们合并子树却几乎不携带停止不确定性。硬币投影在所有词汇量下保留91%-93%的字符串熵；在完整词汇量下，其产生的消息比特是SyncPool的2.16-6.85倍，并能恢复所有完成的消息。

summary: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables
title_translated: 通过程序演化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
summary_translated: 程序演化为发现智能体记忆设计并研究其有效性背后的决策提供了有前景的方法。我们引入MAPE框架，通过标准化生命周期接口和迭代诊断-提议循环，从极简种子演化出完整的记忆程序。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，相较于手动设计基线，MAPE在仅35%的服务成本下实现了最高达12%的绝对准确率提升，进一步评估支持跨服务骨干和基准的迁移。实证分析与消融研究识别并验证了两种反复出现的设计模式：保留原始对话作为可检索证据，有助于保存从提取记忆中遗漏的细节；根据查询意图组合检索证据，有助于回答模型有效使用该信息。将组合模块移植到五个现有记忆系统中，均提升了准确率。此外，搜索目标决定了计算资源的分配：在优化服务成本的同时兼顾准确率，将计算从基于LLM的记忆构建转移到查询时的选择性处理，同时保持竞争性准确率。这些发现共同为智能体记忆设计提供了实证启示。代码可在https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE获取。

summary: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks

title_translated: 评估预训练语言模型语义在结构化电子健康记录预测任务中的应用
summary_translated: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为特定数据集的标记，丢弃与事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念间的关系主要需从EHR共现中学习，无法直接利用任何先验语义知识。我们研究如何通过开发tEHR，将预训练因果语言模型适配于纵向EHR预测任务。在此方法中，我们使用自然语言描述表示事件，并利用该文本流进行EHR自适应的持续预训练，随后使用LoRA进行任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM作为纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四个预测任务以及CPRD数据集上的胰腺癌预测任务（1至12个月时间范围）上评估该方法，tEHR采用Mistral-7B-v0.3骨干网络取得了最强的整体性能。消融实验表明，当临床描述被移除或错位、数值被省略，或任一适应阶段被移除时，性能均下降，而显式的时间间隔描述带来的额外收益较小。对学习到的患者表征的分析进一步揭示了与疾病风险和临床病史不同模式相关的临床上一致的结构。

summary: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.
title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers

title_translated: 审计AI同行评审：基于真实科学论文的基准测试
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的同行评审现已大规模投入使用，但其评估仍有限。我们提出一个基准测试，将四种类型（普遍问题、数学、数值、引用）的局部化错误以三个严重程度注入真实论文中，并测量每个评审系统在不同错误类型和严重程度下的检测率，以及在干净样本上的误报率。我们还介绍了Skepthical，一种多智能体评审系统，通过检索被引论文、使用计算机代数处理数学内容、执行代码验证数值声明来验证有引用支持的主张。我们将该基准应用于两个各包含15篇近期arXiv预印本的语料库（天体物理和机器学习），共注入357个错误，评估了十二种评审系统：六种单LLM评审器、两种Claude Code配置、三种公开可用的评审器以及Skepthical。模型选择对检测率影响最大：在相同提示下，三种前沿LLM在两个语料库上的总检测率相差约50个百分点。当工具和辅助结构能补充模型自身无法提供的能力时，它们才真正起作用。特别是在天体物理领域，Claude Code在数学和数值检测上优于单一Claude调用；强制引用检索使Skepthical在引用错误检测率上大幅领先所有系统。然而，在机器学习领域未观察到这一优势，因为模型似乎更熟悉文献，Skepthical的引用检测率与最佳单LLM无统计差异。大多数系统的误报率低于10%，但随提示、模型和辅助结构变化，数学标记是主要误报来源。评估流程、注入的错误及裁定日志已作为基准发布。

summary: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics. We argue that this framing conflates genuine redundancy with topics that are semantically similar but meaningfully distinct, and that the central challenge in high-granularity modelling is separating the two. Recent post-hoc refinement methods address topic redundancy through either embedding-based similarity thresholding or LLM-guided merging. We show that neither suffices in high-granularity settings and propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM), a hybrid approach that iteratively generates context-rich topic representations, uses embedding similarity to propose candidate merges across the topic space, then applies LLM judgement to accept only genuinely redundant pairs while preserving niche distinctions. Across two patent corpora and one legal corpus, LLM judgement rejects 83% of embedding-identified candidates as non-redundant. EGIM improves discriminability on merged topics by 25-55% over a prior iterative LLM baseline while better preserving the original topic distribution.
title: Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models

title_translated: 相似但不冗余：用于高粒度主题模型的嵌入门控精炼方法
summary_translated: 高粒度主题建模从语料库中提取数百个细分主题，但该范式很少被研究，常被视为一种失败模式——‘过度聚类’，即连贯的主题被分割为冗余子主题。我们认为这种表述混淆了真正的冗余与语义相似但意义不同的主题，而高粒度建模的核心挑战在于区分二者。现有事后精炼方法通过基于嵌入的相似性阈值或LLM引导合并来解决主题冗余问题。我们发现这两种方法在高粒度场景下均不充分，并提出嵌入门控迭代合并（EGIM）方法，这是一种混合策略：迭代生成上下文丰富的主题表示，利用嵌入相似性在主题空间中提出候选合并对，再由LLM判断仅接受真正冗余的配对，同时保留细分主题的差异性。在两个专利语料库和一个法律语料库上，LLM判断拒绝了83%由嵌入识别出的候选对，认为其并非冗余。相较于先前的迭代LLM基线，EGIM在合并后主题的可区分性上提升了25%-55%，同时更好地保持了原始主题分布。

summary: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests.   Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT
title: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
title_translated: 阿尔茨海默病中的形态简化：从连贯言语中进行计算分析与识别
summary_translated: 目的：形态学通常被认为在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中相对不受影响，且在连贯言语中很少被建模。本研究旨在探讨哪些形态特征能区分AD患者与健康对照者，形态学在AD分类中的表现是否优于其他语言层次及BERT模型，以及该信号是否超出转录长度和词汇量的影响。方法：从ADReSS Cookie Theft描述任务中参与者言语数据中计算了55项自动测量指标（八类，其中七类为新提出且理论驱动），并采用组间比较、等效性检验、SHAP分析、家族消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器及BERT模型进行分析。自动指标经人工验证，模型在另外两个语料库上进行了迁移测试。结果：38项指标中有19项在两组间存在差异：AD患者产生的带词缀和屈折词较少，动词和名词较短，现在进行时形式较少但过去时形式较多（最大效应r = -0.42），而错误率在两组间罕见且无统计差异。八项指标在调整长度和词汇频率后仍显著。在测试集特征选择下，形态学达到0.85的宏F1，与句法相当，高于微调BERT（0.80，五次种子平均）；全交叉验证选择得分为0.62。将形态学加入BERT可提升AUC（0.91 vs. 0.89），但不影响宏F1。迁移效果有限，尽管三分之二的效应在轻度认知障碍中仍保持方向一致。结论：AD连贯言语表现出形态简化与时间锚定重构，而非语言崩溃。形态学比其声誉更具信息量。

summary: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size. A common concern is that, in small models, languages compete for capacity. We present Lara Mini base, a model trained from scratch on 6T tokens in English and 44 other languages, which together cover all 24 official languages of the European Union. As training progresses, the 44 other languages together come to outweigh English. To give these languages enough capacity at low cost, Lara Mini base uses a mixture of experts architecture with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters. Among open base models with up to 2B active parameters, it achieves the highest average score across standard English, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks, ahead of models trained on 4 to 6 times as many tokens. Its margin is largest on multilingual benchmarks in the languages it supports and on math benchmarks. It supports contexts of up to 128k tokens. We find that our MoE architecture reduces capacity competition between languages. For a single user on one GPU, without quantization, it generates text at least 1.8 times faster than any model with a higher average score. We release the weights of Lara Mini base under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. In addition, we will release T-HellaSwag, a higher-quality machine translation of the commonsense reasoning benchmark HellaSwag into 110 language variants.
title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off

title_translated: Lara Mini Base：语言多样性作为资源而非权衡
summary_translated: 通用语言模型主要在英语上训练：我们审查的开放模型中，非英语预训练数据最多仅占12%。为欧洲语言构建的模型虽拥有更多非英语数据，但得分远低于同规模通用模型。常见担忧是小模型中语言之间会争夺容量。我们提出Lara Mini base，一个从零开始训练的模型，使用6T tokens的英语和44种其他语言（涵盖欧盟全部24种官方语言）。随着训练推进，这44种语言的总量超过英语。为低成本赋予这些语言足够容量，Lara Mini base采用专家混合架构，总参数量72亿，活跃参数量0.6亿。在最多2B活跃参数的开源基础模型中，它在标准英语、多语言、数学和代码基准上的平均得分最高，优于训练数据量为其4至6倍的模型。其优势在支持语言的多语言基准和数学基准上最为明显。支持长达128k token的上下文。我们发现MoE架构减少了语言间的容量竞争。对于单个用户在单块GPU上运行且无需量化的情况下，其文本生成速度至少比平均得分更高的任何模型快1.8倍。我们以CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可发布Lara Mini base权重。此外，还将发布T-HellaSwag，即HellaSwag常识推理基准向110种语言变体的高质量机器翻译。

summary: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task. Prompts greatly influence the generation process, but existing detectors focus solely on the generated texts --- supervised methods learn from labeled texts only, and zero-shot methods rely on the text's probability distributions --- ignoring the underlying generation process, which limits their robustness in open-world scenarios. We introduce SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection, a novel framework for detecting AI-generated text that transfers better across datasets. Specifically, we measure the prompt's influence and use it as a discriminative signal. We characterize the prompt's influence by introducing a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) term that captures how much a prompt explains a text. Based on this quantity, SPADE trains one soft prompt per class to amplify the separation, and predicts the class whose prompt best explains the candidate text. Extensive experiments on several benchmarks against various detectors demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets.
title: SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection

title_translated: SPADE：用于AI文本检测的软提示
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的易获取性使得网络上的AI生成文本日益普遍，因此AI文本检测成为关键任务。提示对生成过程有重大影响，但现有检测器仅关注生成文本本身——监督方法仅从标注文本中学习，零样本方法依赖文本的概率分布——忽略了底层生成过程，限制了其在开放世界场景中的鲁棒性。我们提出SPADE：Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection，一种新型框架，用于检测AI生成文本，具有更好的跨数据集迁移能力。具体而言，我们测量提示的影响，并将其作为判别信号。通过引入点互信息（PMI）项来刻画提示对文本的解释力，基于此，SPADE为每类训练一个软提示以增强类别分离，并预测哪个提示最能解释候选文本。在多个基准上对多种检测器的广泛实验表明，该方法在分布外（OOD）数据集上表现出卓越的鲁棒性和有效性，达到当前最优（SOTA）性能。

summary: Speech recognition (ASR) systems are usually compared by word error rate (WER) on recorded files, after punctuation, capital letters and number format are removed. In dictation, the audio is streamed live and the text goes into the user's message as written, so what matters is which mistakes the user has to fix. The test set, streamed to eleven ASR systems, comprises 106 scripted English dictations from one speaker (read in a quiet room, with a fan on, and whispered), 20 clips in each of eleven other language and dialect sets, and 400 recordings that join clips in two languages. Every error was sorted by a fixed rule into four levels: recognition, output formatting, language handling and, for the self-hosted models, audio dropped before the model. Systems with similar WER failed in different ways. Zoom Scribe and OpenAI's GPT-Live-Transcribe have almost the same WER on quiet English (7.4% and 7.3%), but 34.7% and 8.8% on whispered English. Zoom and both AssemblyAI models left out 26-28% of whispered words, and still 21-26% with their end-of-turn detection relaxed or off; seven other systems left out at most 3%. Qwen3-ASR's 32% came from the speech detection in our own deployment (6% when relaxed). Across 107 EARS speakers, the same four systems lost 7-31% of whispered words, while six others lost under 2%. With only English selected, Gemini, Deepgram and our self-hosted Whisper lost the non-English part of a two-language recording in 86-99% of recordings, against 33-46% with both languages selected, while GPT-Live-Transcribe, OpenAI's realtime Whisper and Meta lost it in at most 20%. Running Whisper behind a Silero voice activity detector that drops audio judged to be silence raised whispered WER from 10.1% to 51.4%. Most English results come from one read speaker. The code, the recordings, both references and every transcript are released.
title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR

title_translated: 超越词错误率：流式转录ASR的失败分类
summary_translated: 语音识别（ASR）系统通常在去除标点、大小写和数字格式后，通过词错误率（WER）在录制文件上进行比较。但在字处理场景中，音频是实时流式传输的，文本会直接进入用户的输入消息中，因此关键在于用户需要修正哪些错误。测试集被实时传送给十一个ASR系统，包含106段由同一说话者朗读的英语字处理录音（在安静房间内，有风扇噪音且低声说出），每种其他语言和方言各20段剪辑，以及400段包含两种语言剪辑的录音。每个错误根据固定规则分为四个级别：识别错误、输出格式错误、语言处理错误，以及自托管模型的音频丢失问题。具有相似WER的系统以不同方式失败。Zoom Scribe和OpenAI的GPT-Live-Transcribe在安静英语上的WER分别为7.4%和7.3%，但在低声英语上分别达到34.7%和8.8%。Zoom和两个AssemblyAI模型在低声英语中漏掉了26%-28%的词语，即使放宽或关闭句末检测仍保留21%-26%；其他七个系统最多漏掉3%。Qwen3-ASR的32%错误源于我们自己部署中的语音检测（放宽后为6%）。在107位EARS说话者中，同样的四个系统漏掉了7%-31%的低声词语，而其他六个系统漏掉不足2%。仅选择英语时，Gemini、Deepgram和我们自托管的Whisper在双语录音中丢失非英语部分的比例高达86%-99%，而当两种语言都选定时仅为33%-46%；而GPT-Live-Transcribe、OpenAI的实时Whisper和Meta则最多丢失20%。在Whisper前使用Silero语音活动检测器（丢弃被判定为静音的音频）使低声WER从10.1%上升至51.4%。大多数英语结果来自一位朗读者。代码、录音、参考数据和所有转录均已公开。

summary: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Human-annotated and synthetically generated preference data differ substantially in per-sample cost, but prior work typically holds sample count fixed when comparing the two. In this work, we explicitly study the interplay between cost and performance by comparing the effect of post-training with human and synthetic preference data under a fixed, dollar-matched annotation budget. We train and evaluate multiple base model families across helpfulness and summarization tasks. We find that synthetic data is far more cost-efficient at low-to-moderate budgets, achieving high win rates with as little as \$200--\$400. On helpfulness, human data closes the gap only at budgets roughly two orders of magnitude larger; on summarization, it does not close the gap at any tested budget. We also find that human-annotated data varies in reliability: one widely used human preference source substantially underperforms another, and the gap persists even after standard remedies such as domain restriction and deduplication.
title: Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training

title_translated: 真人还是合成？固定预算下后训练的收益分析
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的后训练通常结合监督微调（SFT）与基于偏好的微调方法，如直接偏好优化（DPO）。真人标注与合成生成的偏好数据在单样本成本上存在显著差异，但以往研究通常在比较两者时保持样本数量不变。本文通过在固定美元预算下对比真人与合成偏好数据对后训练的影响，明确研究了成本与性能之间的权衡。我们在多个基础模型家族上训练并评估其在帮助性与摘要任务上的表现。结果表明，在低至中等预算下，合成数据远比真人数据更具成本效益，仅需200-400美元即可实现高胜率。在帮助性任务上，真人数据仅在预算约为两数量级更大的情况下才能缩小差距；在摘要任务上，即使在测试的所有预算范围内，也无法弥补差距。此外，我们发现真人标注数据的可靠性存在差异：一种广泛使用的真人偏好来源明显劣于另一种，且即便经过领域限制和去重等标准修复措施，差距依然存在。

summary: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
title: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models

title_translated: 预训练数据统计特征塑造语言模型实体比较学习的阶段
summary_translated: 预训练数据如何在整个预训练过程中塑造语言模型（LM）的行为？我们通过一项关于实体比较的任务案例研究来探讨这一问题，例如“在法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”涵盖九个跨五类实体的比较任务。我们首先在小规模语言模型（163M参数）上进行受控实验，训练它们在预训练语料库的自然文本与合成任务数据混合数据集上。我们的分析识别出三个学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，模型根据实体出现频率选择；（2）中期阶段，模型根据提示中实体的位置（首次提及 vs. 最后提及）选择；（3）晚期阶段，模型选择正确答案。我们证明这三个阶段的出现是由训练数据的统计特性所决定的因果关系。当仅有少量特定任务的合成数据时，模型仅表现出前两个阶段，无法学会任务；而当数据量较大时，模型直接从基于频率的启发式跳转到正确解题。此外，将实体频率分布从自然存在的齐普夫分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数罕见）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加速任务学习。最后，我们发现这些受控实验中观察到的三个训练动态阶段也出现在开源模型OLMo-2 32B中。综上，我们的研究结果表明，预训练数据的特性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并且小规模合成实验能够预测大规模模型的训练动态。

summary: Pre-trained encoders fine-tuned on natural language inference (NLI) and other language understanding tasks keep much of their accuracy after the input is perturbed, e.g. by removing all nouns or shuffling the words. Does the same hold for large language models (LLMs), and if so, is it because they have seen the benchmarks during pre-training? In this paper we revisit these perturbation experiments with eight LLMs alongside fine-tuned encoders on GLUE and the three rounds of ANLI. Regardless of model size, every system that answers directly retains 36-72% of its above-chance performance without nouns on MNLI compared to only 14-29% on ANLI. Only a model that reasons before answering departs from this pattern. We also check contamination indicators (including exact $n$-gram counts in the public pre-training data of two of the models) and find no link between exposure and robustness. Our strongest evidence comes from 368 new, human-validated items that none of the models can have seen. All eight LLMs keep more of their performance without nouns on items written in MNLI's style than on items written without its cues. When the perturbation instead removes the function words carrying such cues, this advantage reverses. In light of these results, we argue that robustness to perturbation on familiar NLI benchmarks reflects dataset shortcuts rather than memorisation, and tells us more about the benchmark than about the model.
title: Shortcuts or Memorisation? Revisiting Data Corruption in Natural Language Understanding with Large Language Models
title_translated: 捷径还是记忆？重新审视大语言模型在自然语言理解中的数据污染问题
summary_translated: 在自然语言推理（NLI）和其他语言理解任务上微调的预训练编码器，在输入被扰动（如移除所有名词或打乱单词顺序）后仍能保持较高的准确率。大语言模型（LLMs）是否也具备类似鲁棒性？如果是，这是否是因为它们在预训练期间见过这些基准数据？本文在GLUE和ANLI三轮数据集上，对八种LLMs和微调编码器重新进行了这类扰动实验。无论模型规模如何，所有直接作答的系统在MNLI上移除名词后仍保持36%-72%的高于随机水平的表现，而在ANLI上仅保持14%-29%。只有在回答前进行推理的模型偏离了这一模式。我们还检查了污染指标（包括两个模型公开预训练数据中的精确n-gram计数），未发现暴露程度与鲁棒性之间的关联。我们最强有力的证据来自368个新的人工验证样本，这些样本均未被任何模型见过。所有八个LLM在MNLI风格的题目中，移除名词后保留的性能优于无MNLI线索的题目；而当扰动改为移除承载这些线索的功能词时，这种优势反转。基于这些结果，我们认为在熟悉NLI基准上的抗扰动能力反映的是数据集捷径，而非记忆，更多揭示的是基准本身的特点，而非模型的能力。

summary: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens. This expansion creates an outer-accounting problem distinct from within-trajectory credit assignment: row-based outcome statistics can count one episode outcome multiple times, while token-level reduction can assign unequal aggregate objective mass across trajectories. We term these effects outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance. We introduce Outcome-Mass Alignment (OMA), a two-component method that makes both accounting choices explicit. Outcome Alignment computes outcome statistics over unique source trajectories, while Mass Alignment controls aggregate objective mass after within-trajectory aggregation of optimizer-native token objectives. Neither redesigns the base optimizer's credit assignment, importance ratios, or clipping. Across matched ALFWorld GRPO comparisons at two model scales, where failed trajectories typically expand much more than successful ones, OMA improves matched-horizon endpoint success by 7.0-9.4 percentage points. Ordinary WebShop exhibits weak or reversed expansion-outcome coupling and correspondingly mixed effects, whereas in a success-oriented WebShop setting, WebShop-SOL, OMA improves success nAUC from 0.399 to 0.511. Component ablations and GiGPO and GSPO comparisons further support component separability and cross-optimizer compatibility. These results show that trajectory expansion always defines an implicit weighting rule, but its practical effect depends on how expansion couples to outcomes and optimizer-native updates.
title: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning

title_translated: 结果质量对齐：控制多轮LLM智能体强化学习中长度依赖轨迹影响
summary_translated: 为了保持长交互上下文的可处理性，多轮LLM智能体的逐步分组相对训练将每个源轨迹展开为多个响应行和有效标记。这种扩展带来了不同于轨迹内信用分配的外部会计问题：基于行的结果统计可能多次计算同一episode的结果，而基于token的聚合可能导致不同轨迹间目标质量不均衡。我们将这两种现象称为结果统计多重性和目标质量失衡。我们提出结果质量对齐（OMA），一种包含两个组件的方法，使这两种会计选择显式化。结果对齐在唯一源轨迹上计算结果统计，而质量对齐在轨迹内聚合优化器原生token目标后控制总目标质量。该方法不重构基础优化器的信用分配、重要性比率或裁剪机制。在两个模型规模下进行匹配的ALFWorld GRPO对比中，失败轨迹通常比成功轨迹扩展得更严重，OMA使匹配时间终点的成功率提升了7.0-9.4个百分点。普通WebShop表现出弱或反向的扩展-结果耦合，相应效果混杂；而在以成功为导向的WebShop设置（WebShop-SOL）中，OMA将成功率nAUC从0.399提升至0.511。组件消融实验及GiGPO与GSPO对比进一步支持了组件的可分离性与跨优化器兼容性。这些结果表明，轨迹扩展始终定义了一种隐含的加权规则，但其实际影响取决于扩展如何与结果及优化器原生更新耦合。

summary: Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware. Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone. With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one. Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.
title: Towards Green Text Generation: Memory-Based Speculative Decoding

title_translated: 迈向绿色文本生成：基于记忆的推测解码
summary_translated: 推测解码通过让一个低成本的草稿模型提出候选词，由大型验证模型在单次前向传播中进行检查，从而加速大语言模型的文本生成。我们提出了Olifant，一种基于记忆分类器构建的草稿模型。它在CPU上以不到0.3毫秒的时间从四词窗口预测下一个词，无需GPU、反向传播或加速器内存。我们在消费级硬件上测量了两种验证器配置下的吞吐量和能耗。在无KV缓存的情况下，草稿几乎免费：与领域匹配的Olifant模型在欧盟法律文本上达到38.1%的接受率，相比仅使用神经验证模型，吞吐量提升2.43倍，每token能耗降低2.51倍。在使用KV缓存验证器时，自身已节省约10倍能耗，此时草稿成本变得重要：尽管TinyLlama草稿模型接受率高，但其吞吐量减半、能耗翻三倍；而Olifant仍实现1.25倍吞吐量，并在研究中达到最低能耗（每100个token 93焦耳，比未缓存基线低14倍）。我们进一步表明，KV缓存使时间和能耗解耦：更长的草稿验证会增加功耗，导致能耗最优的草稿长度低于速度最优的长度。只要草稿几乎免费，推测解码在快速验证器时代仍未过时。

summary: Business-to-business (B2B) companies develop and deliver a one-of-a-kind product in response to a client's orders. To prepare resources for development beforehand, companies estimate dates when they will receive orders from clients in their sales process, called scheduled order dates. However, dates when the companies actually receive orders can differ from the scheduled order dates. This difference increases costs in the development. If the difference could be forecasted before receiving orders, companies could optimize their resource preparation. Towards reducing the costs, we introduce sales delay forecasting, a novel task of forecasting delay days from the scheduled order dates during sales process where sales representatives (sales reps) interact with the clients to receive orders. Sales delay forecasting is challenging because the sales process progress inherently involves uncertainty and depends on the client's willingness to order. To address this task, we propose confidence features which represent sales reps' confidence as a proxy measure of the client's willingness to order. To represent it, our method extracts dates of future sales events anticipated by sales reps from textual reports. To consider whether the confidence objectively looks reasonable, we also introduce status features which describe sales process status based on current date and past events. In experiments using real sales data, our method achieved a 16% lower mean absolute error compared with a feature-based baseline similar to a prior work. Moreover, our method outperformed non-feature-based baselines using large language models, indicating that it is crucial to explicitly create our features.
title: Forecasting Sales Delay through Time-aware Analysis of Sales Events in Textual Reports

title_translated: 通过时间感知分析文本报告中的销售事件来预测销售延迟
summary_translated: 企业对企业（B2B）公司根据客户订单开发并交付独一无二的产品。为提前准备资源，公司需估算在销售过程中从客户处收到订单的预计日期，即预定订单日期。然而，实际收到订单的日期可能与预定日期不同，这种差异会增加开发成本。如果能在收到订单前预测该差异，公司便可优化资源准备。为此，我们引入销售延迟预测这一新任务，旨在销售过程中基于销售代表与客户互动的文本报告，预测从预定订单日期起的延迟天数。该任务具有挑战性，因为销售进程本身存在不确定性，且依赖于客户的订购意愿。为应对这一任务，我们提出置信度特征，作为销售代表对客户订购意愿的代理度量。我们的方法从文本报告中提取销售代表预期的未来销售事件日期。为评估置信度是否客观合理，我们还引入状态特征，基于当前日期和历史事件描述销售进程状态。在真实销售数据上的实验表明，我们的方法相比类似先前工作的基于特征的基线，平均绝对误差降低了16%。此外，我们的方法优于不使用特征的大语言模型基线，表明显式构建特征至关重要。

summary: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer mental states in others, is pivotal for human social cognition. Existing evaluations of ToM in large language models (LLMs) mainly focus on static belief attribution and false-belief reasoning, leaving a critical aspect of social reasoning underexplored: can LLMs decide whether perceptual evidence is sufficient to justify another person's belief revision? To address this gap, we present MuSeToM, a human-validated, text-based benchmark for evaluating epistemic belief revision in ToM reasoning. MuSeToM contains 2,415 instances adapted from BigToM and OpenToM, with textual cues spanning six sensory categories, and tests whether models can determine when a protagonist should revise a belief and infer the resulting updated belief state. Using MuSeToM, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs under direct and chain-of-thought prompting, revealing a pronounced dissonance: while models often detect that a belief may change, they struggle to identify the updated belief and frequently over-update on perceptually salient but epistemically insufficient cues.
title: MuSeToM: Multi-Sensory Evaluation of Belief Revision with Textual Cues Across Six Senses
title_translated: MuSeToM：基于文本线索跨六种感官的信念修正多感官评估
summary_translated: 心智理论（ToM）是推断他人心理状态的能力，对人类社会认知至关重要。现有大语言模型（LLM）的ToM评估主要集中在静态信念归属和错误信念推理，忽视了一个关键的社会推理方面：LLM能否判断感知证据是否足以支持他人信念的修正？为填补这一空白，我们提出了MuSeToM，一个经人类验证的、基于文本的基准测试，用于评估ToM推理中的认识论信念修正。MuSeToM包含2,415个实例，源自BigToM和OpenToM，涵盖六种感官类别的文本线索，测试模型能否判断主角应在何时修正信念并推断出更新后的信念状态。利用MuSeToM，我们系统评估了最先进的LLM在直接提示和思维链提示下的表现，揭示出显著的不一致：尽管模型常能察觉信念可能变化，但在识别更新后的信念方面表现不佳，且经常因感知显著但认识论上不足的线索而过度修正。

summary: This paper describes the approach of the Unibuc - NLP team in tackling the "Voight-Kampff" Generative AI Detection task from PAN at CLEF 2025. In the Subtask 1: Voight-Kampff AI Detection Sensitivity we have explored different approaches of leveraging embeddings extracted from LLMs, using either classical ML models or further fine-tuning LLMs with a classification head for the downstream binary classification task. Our experiments showed that using a majority vote ensemble of classical ML models (Light GBM, XGB, Logistic Regression and SVM) is comparable with fine-tuning for downstream task achieving around 99.4% F1 score. For the Subtask 2: Human-AI Collaborative Text Classification we explored a way of combining features at different layers extracted using transformer backbone with layer-wise projection and attentive pooling which proved modest results.
title: Unibuc - NLP at "Voight-Kampff" Generative AI Detection PAN 2025
title_translated: Unibuc - NLP在CLEF 2025 PAN“Voight-Kampff”生成式AI检测任务中的应用
summary_translated: 本文介绍了Unibuc-NLP团队在CLEF 2025 PAN“Voight-Kampff”生成式AI检测任务中的方法。在子任务1：Voight-Kampff AI检测灵敏度中，我们探索了利用大语言模型提取的嵌入向量，结合经典机器学习模型或进一步微调大语言模型以添加分类头，完成下游二分类任务。实验表明，使用Light GBM、XGB、逻辑回归和SVM的多数投票集成模型，在性能上与微调相当，F1得分约为99.4%。在子任务2：人机协同文本分类中，我们探索了使用Transformer主干网络在不同层提取特征，并通过分层投影和注意力池化进行融合的方法，结果表现一般。

summary: We present EvenVLM, the first text and multimodal (VQA) dataset for Even (Lamut), an endangered Northern Tungusic language spoken by approximately 6,800 people in Siberia. Our dataset comprises 50,521 structured Even-Russian entries extracted from dictionary and phrasebook sources via GPT-4o Mini-based parsing, from which we synthetically generate 107,543 training examples spanning translation, grammar, reading comprehension, and semantic classification. To address tokenization inefficiency on Even's agglutinative morphology, we propose a three-step tokenizer expansion algorithm that adds Even-specific graphemes (eng, oe, o-umlaut), whitelisted vocabulary, and BPE merges, reducing average tokens per word by 27% (4.99 to 3.64). Using LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-4B, we adapt the model for text tasks (0.53% trainable parameters, rank 32) and separately for visual question answering (rank 64, frozen vision encoder). Our best configuration achieves 11.4% exact match and a 13.6 weighted score on text benchmarks, 0.1283 chrF for sentence translation, and 65% accuracy on VQA (up from 0% for the base model and text-only fine-tuning). We release our datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and training pipeline to support further research on Even and other low-resource languages.
title: EvenVLM: A Text and Multimodal Dataset for the Even Language with Vision-Language Fine-Tuning
comment: Published in Proceedings of the Workshop on Open Reasoning Across Cultures Languages (ORACLE) at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: EvenVLM：面向Even语言的文本与多模态数据集及视觉-语言微调
summary_translated: 我们提出了EvenVLM，这是首个针对濒危的北通古斯语Even（Lamut）的文本与多模态（VQA）数据集，该语言在西伯利亚约有6,800名使用者。我们的数据集包含50,521条从词典和短语手册来源通过GPT-4o Mini-based解析提取的结构化俄文-Even条目，从中合成生成了107,543个训练样本，涵盖翻译、语法、阅读理解与语义分类任务。为解决Even语言黏着形态带来的分词效率低下问题，我们提出了一种三步分词器扩展算法，添加了Even特定的字符（eng、oe、o-变音符）、白名单词汇和BPE合并，将每个词的平均词元数减少27%（从4.99降至3.64）。通过LoRA微调Qwen3-VL-4B模型，我们分别将其适配于文本任务（0.53%可训练参数，秩32）和视觉问答任务（秩64，冻结视觉编码器）。最佳配置在文本基准测试中达到11.4%的精确匹配率和13.6的加权得分，句子翻译的chrF得分为0.1283，VQA准确率达到65%（相比基础模型和仅文本微调的0%有显著提升）。我们发布了数据集、评估基准和训练流程，以支持Even及其他低资源语言的后续研究。

summary: Laya is a small model that answers a multiple-choice question about a text in one pass: the question, the options (each with a name and a description) and the text form one sequence of at most 512 tokens, the window, in the English release. A longer text is silently cut at the end, and we measure what that costs. Test documents place a held-out row's text, the evidence, at a chosen token offset among distractor text; 177 items, five tasks, three checkpoints (released, short-row fine-tune, long-document fine-tune), four window sizes and 93,275 scored requests. When the evidence lies beyond the window, accuracy falls to 26.4% for the released checkpoint (27.2% for both fine-tunes), near the 27.0% of guessing and below the 35.6% of always giving the commonest label. Confidence gives no warning (AUROC 0.50 to 0.55 for telling cut from read requests; 0.5 = chance), and the runtime's truncation flag also fires on requests whose evidence was visible. The released checkpoint reads visible evidence badly once text precedes it: 38.5% pooled against 60% when the evidence comes first, so a larger window alone gains +6.2 points. Fine-tuning on long documents adds +27.6 points on visible evidence over the short-row fine-tune (95% interval +22.3 to +33.1) and nothing on cut evidence. That is an in-family result: training rows and test documents share generator and question types, and the main filler is of the training kind. With encyclopedic filler never seen in training the gain is +13.2 (+9.9 to +16.6), with rows of other tasks as filler -2.0. Among training-free rearrangements a 312-token window scan helps most (+11.9 points over the default for the released checkpoint) at six to eleven forward passes. Documents are synthetic, labels are LLM-made and one backbone is studied, so these diagnose this model, not long documents in general.
title: Where in the Input Does a One-Pass Decision Encoder Look?

title_translated: 单次决策编码器在输入中的何处进行查看？
summary_translated: Laya 是一个小型模型，能够在单次遍历中回答关于文本的多项选择题：问题、选项（每个包含名称和描述）以及文本共同构成最多512个标记的序列窗口。较长的文本会在末尾被无声截断，我们测量这种截断带来的损失。测试文档将待保留行的文本（证据）放置在干扰文本中的指定标记偏移位置；共177个样本，五个任务，三个检查点（发布版、短行微调、长文档微调），四种窗口大小，93,275次评分请求。当证据位于窗口之外时，发布版检查点的准确率降至26.4%（两个微调版本分别为27.2%），接近猜测水平的27.0%，低于始终选择最常见标签的35.6%。置信度无法提供预警（区分截断与完整请求的AUROC为0.50至0.55，0.5表示随机水平），且运行时的截断标志也对可见证据的请求触发。发布版检查点在文本前置时对可见证据的读取表现较差：整体准确率为38.5%，而当证据位于开头时为60%；因此仅增大窗口即可提升+6.2分。在长文档上微调相比短行微调，在可见证据上额外提升+27.6分（95%置信区间+22.3至+33.1），而在截断证据上无提升。该结果属于同家族：训练行与测试文档共享生成器和问题类型，主要填充内容为训练中出现的类型。若使用训练中从未见过的百科类填充，提升为+13.2（+9.9至+16.6）；若使用其他任务的行作为填充，则性能下降-2.0。在无需训练的重排方法中，312个标记窗口扫描效果最佳（相对于发布版检查点提升+11.9分），需六到十一轮前向传播。文档为合成数据，标签由大语言模型生成，仅研究一种主干模型，因此这些结果诊断的是该模型本身，而非一般长文档情况。

summary: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming formal theorem proving. Yet further progress remains constrained by the lack of a transparent and effective data recipe for systematically improving theorem-proving models. In this work, we argue that effective agentic provers require strong mathematical skill priors to ground theorem proving and agentic trajectories to enable long-horizon, interactive proof construction. To this end, we synthesize an agent-native 33.7B-token mid-training corpus covering decomposition, search, self-verification, and revision, together with verifier-grounded agentic trajectories. We further introduce the daVinci-Prover harness, which enables models to construct proofs and interact with a Lean verifier in an isolated workspace, and use it to collect approximately 36K high-quality agent trajectories for supervised fine-tuning. Our mid-training recipe yields an average improvement of 13.7 points over the matched Qwen3-8B SFT-only baseline across MiniF2F, FATE-M, and ProofNet. When applied to the Qwen3.5 series, our approach also yields strong performance across theorem-proving benchmarks and achieves near-saturating MiniF2F performance with memory compaction. The results highlight agent-native mid-training as an effective foundation for developing stronger interactive theorem-proving agents.
title: daVinci-Prover: Agent-Native Mid-Training for Formal Theorem Proving
title_translated: daVinci-Prover：面向形式定理证明的原生智能体中期训练
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的进步正在迅速改变形式定理证明领域。然而，进一步进展仍受限于缺乏透明且有效的数据配方来系统性地提升定理证明模型。本文认为，高效的智能体式证明者需要强大的数学技能先验以支撑定理证明，并通过智能体轨迹实现长周期、交互式证明构建。为此，我们构建了一个原生智能体的337亿标记中期训练语料库，涵盖分解、搜索、自我验证和修订等内容，并结合验证器引导的智能体轨迹。我们还引入了daVinci-Prover工具包，使模型能在隔离工作空间中与Lean验证器交互并构建证明，由此收集约3.6万条高质量智能体轨迹用于监督微调。我们的中期训练方案在MiniF2F、FATE-M和ProofNet基准上相较匹配的Qwen3-8B仅SFT基线平均提升13.7分。应用于Qwen3.5系列时，该方法在多个定理证明基准上表现优异，并在内存压缩条件下达到接近饱和的MiniF2F性能。结果表明，原生智能体中期训练是开发更强交互式定理证明智能体的有效基础。

summary: EmbeddingGemma-300M is a small open embedder, and used as released it finds the right passage first for 60.8% of the Kazakh Belebele retrieval questions. We present Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M, the same model fully fine-tuned for one epoch on 208,511 pairs: 166,263 Kazakh questions that our own language model wrote about source passages from encyclopedias, Wikipedia, news and books, each checked by a second model, plus English and Russian replay. On Kazakh Belebele, recall@1 rises from 60.8% to 78.0% and recall@10 from 76.3% to 91.4%. Our model scores above 161 of the 194 models with a published MTEB score on the same test, among them OpenAI text-embedding-3-large (47.1%). The other 33 score higher: the ten best are large multi-billion-parameter or closed models, reaching up to 92.2%, and at least 9 are open models of up to 0.6B parameters, the smallest with 339M. We also scored 6 Kazakh-specific embedders shared on Hugging Face with the same code in one run: our model (77.3% there) is ahead of 4 of them, including the two E5-base models of similar size (72.6% and 69.0%), and behind kaz-embedder (86.0%, three towers with 1,695M parameters in total) and a BGE-M3 fine-tune (81.0%); at recall@10 its interval overlaps those of its nearest neighbours on both sides. Our four-language model, trained with a capped share of the same Kazakh pairs, is 2.8 points lower at recall@1, with overlapping recall@10 intervals. The Kazakh model also scores higher than the released model on the Uzbek and Kyrgyz versions of Belebele, but our Tajik model, trained without any Turkic pairs, gains as much there, so these gains are not specific to Kazakh training. Our Kazakh Wikipedia test questions come from the same generator family as the training questions, so we rest the main claims on Belebele.
title: Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M: How Far One Epoch of Generated Questions Takes a Small Kazakh Embedder

title_translated: Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M：一次训练循环如何提升小型哈萨克嵌入模型
summary_translated: EmbeddingGemma-300M是一个小型开源嵌入模型，按原样使用时在哈萨克Belebele检索问题中能正确找到相关段落的比例为60.8%。我们提出Saidzoda-Kazakh-EmbeddingGemma-300M，即在同一模型上用208,511对数据进行一周期全微调：包括166,263个由我们自己的语言模型基于百科、维基、新闻和书籍来源段落生成的哈萨克语问题，每条均经第二模型校验，外加英语和俄语回放数据。在哈萨克Belebele上，召回率@1从60.8%提升至78.0%，召回率@10从76.3%提升至91.4%。我们的模型在相同测试集上超过194个已发布MTEB得分模型中的161个，其中包括OpenAI text-embedding-3-large（47.1%）。其余33个得分更高：其中前十名为参数量达数十亿或封闭的大模型，最高达92.2%；至少有9个是参数量不超过0.6B的开源模型，最小为339M。我们还使用相同代码对Hugging Face上6个哈萨克专用嵌入模型进行了评分：我们的模型（该测试中为77.3%）优于其中4个，包括两个同规模的E5-base模型（72.6%和69.0%），但落后于kaz-embedder（86.0%，三塔结构共1,695M参数）和一个BGE-M3微调版本（81.0%）；在召回率@10上，其区间与邻近模型重叠。四语言模型（仅使用部分哈萨克对数据）在召回率@1上低2.8分，召回率@10区间仍与邻近模型重叠。哈萨克模型在乌兹别克和吉尔吉斯版本的Belebele上也优于原始模型，但我们在未使用任何突厥语数据训练的塔吉克模型上也获得了类似提升，说明这些增益并非特异性于哈萨克语训练。我们的哈萨克维基百科测试问题来自与训练问题相同的生成家族，因此我们主要依据Belebele上的表现做出结论。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) advance toward increasingly long inputs, soft context compression offers a promising approach to efficient inference by converting long inputs into compact memory slots. Under limited memory budgets, effective context compression remains challenging because task-relevant evidence varies substantially across queries, ranging from localized evidence to multiple distant spans or information dispersed throughout the full document. Instead of compressing everything indiscriminately, we propose CoMem, a query-guided selective context compression framework that learns memory representations conditioned on both the document and the query. CoMem develops Contrastive Compressor Learning to achieve query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations. To inject a strong prior over query-dependent evidence distributions, we devise a same-context hard negative mining strategy by pairing a single document with multiple queries, requiring the compressor to selectively retain information according to each query's distinct evidence needs. To address the restricted information flow imposed by causal masking, we further enable bidirectional attention among memory slots. Experiments demonstrate that CoMem consistently outperforms existing context compression methods across compression ratios on question answering and RULER-NIAH benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem.
title: Beyond Compressing Everything: Contrastive Memory Learning for Selective Context Compression

title_translated: 超越全面压缩：用于选择性上下文压缩的对比记忆学习
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）处理越来越长的输入，软上下文压缩通过将长输入转换为紧凑的记忆槽，为高效推理提供了有前景的解决方案。在有限的内存预算下，有效上下文压缩仍然具有挑战性，因为任务相关的证据在不同查询间差异显著，可能从局部证据到多个遥远片段，或分散在整个文档中。我们不盲目压缩所有内容，而是提出CoMem——一种查询引导的选择性上下文压缩框架，其记忆表示同时依赖于文档和查询。CoMem采用对比压缩学习，实现对查询敏感但保留上下文信息的记忆表示。为注入对查询依赖证据分布的强先验，我们设计了一种同一文档多查询配对的硬负样本挖掘策略，要求压缩器根据每个查询的独特证据需求选择性保留信息。为克服因果掩码带来的信息流限制，我们进一步在记忆槽之间启用双向注意力。实验表明，CoMem在问答和RULER-NIAH基准上，于不同压缩比下均持续优于现有上下文压缩方法。代码已公开于https://github.com/scar-on/CoMem。

summary: Millions of Bangla Sign Language (BdSL) users lack reliable automatic translation tools. Existing systems are limited by data scarcity, unidirectional design, and computationally expensive architectures that are not suitable for low-resource deployment. We introduce IsharaBART, a bidirectional generative framework for gloss-sentence translation in BdSL. IsharaBART uses Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformers (BART)-based conditional language modeling with denoising learning objectives. We developed a parallel dataset of 1,000 professionally annotated gloss-sentence pairs, balanced across tenses and structures. We expanded the dataset to 4,831 pairs through four augmentation techniques: rule-based tense transformations, masked token substitutions, back-translation, and one-shot prompting. A compact denoising sequence-to-sequence model was pre-trained from scratch on monolingual Bangla text from six different corpora, then fine-tuned on the annotated and augmented datasets. We compare IsharaBART against four larger baseline models under identical conditions, where it achieves comparable or superior bidirectional performance. On the gloss-to-sentence (G2S) task, it attains Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU-4) score up to 51.7, and on the sentence-to-gloss (S2G) task, it achieves 61.40, outperforming multilingual models despite having fewer than 10% of the parameters. Ablation studies demonstrate that pre-training provides 62.5-90.4% faster convergence and 11.5-118% higher BLEU-4 than scratch. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces trainable parameters by 99.3%, but with 28.0-52.2% loss of BLEU-4 compared to full-parameter fine-tuning.
title: IsharaBART: An efficient BART-Based Framework for Low-Resource Bangla Sign Language Translation

title_translated: IsharaBART：面向低资源孟加拉手语翻译的高效BART框架
summary_translated: 数百万孟加拉手语（BdSL）使用者缺乏可靠的自动翻译工具。现有系统受限于数据稀缺、单向设计以及计算成本高昂的架构，不适合低资源部署。我们提出IsharaBART，一种用于BdSL词形-句子翻译的双向生成框架。IsharaBART采用基于BART的双向与自回归Transformer条件语言建模，并结合去噪学习目标。我们构建了一个包含1,000对专业标注的词形-句子对的并行数据集，涵盖不同时态和结构。通过四种增强技术（基于规则的时态变换、掩码标记替换、反向翻译和单次提示）将数据集扩展至4,831对。我们从六个不同语料库的孟加拉语单语文本中从零开始预训练了一个紧凑的去噪序列到序列模型，随后在标注和增强数据集上进行微调。我们在相同条件下将IsharaBART与四个更大的基线模型进行比较，其表现相当或更优。在词形到句子（G2S）任务上，BLEU-4得分最高达51.7；在句子到词形（S2G）任务上，达到61.40，尽管参数量不足其他多语言模型的10%，仍表现更佳。消融实验表明，预训练使收敛速度提升62.5%-90.4%，BLEU-4提升11.5%-118%。低秩适配（LoRA）将可训练参数减少99.3%，但相比全参数微调，BLEU-4损失28.0%-52.2%。

summary: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require. We find that decision information is concentrated in intermediate layers, with early layers building essential features and the final six layers removable without loss, while independently trained smaller models largely mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision capabilities. These findings suggest that efficiency requires not simply smaller backbones, but shared computation across different depths. Building on this, we propose \method{}, which jointly trains a full model with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation. A lightweight gate reads the hidden state at each exit to determine whether additional computation is needed, allowing one model to operate at multiple layers. Across seven decision benchmarks, our approach matches or outperforms independently trained models at every depth, while achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs through adaptive computation.
title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
title_translated: 通过自适应计算从大语言模型到高效系统一模型的转化
summary_translated: 将大语言模型（LLM）转化为系统一决策模型通常会用决策头替换语言建模头，同时保留完整的主干网络，导致每次决策都要付出所有层的计算开销。然而，决策所需的深度仍不明确。我们发现决策信息集中在中间层，早期层构建了关键特征，而最后六层可移除而不损失性能；独立训练的小型模型大多模仿完整模型，而非发展出专门的决策能力。这些发现表明，效率不仅需要更小的主干，还需跨不同深度共享计算。基于此，我们提出	extmethod{}，该方法联合训练一个完整模型与前缀子模型，通过自蒸馏共享其最终层和决策头。轻量级门控机制读取每个出口处的隐藏状态，以判断是否需要额外计算，使单一模型可在多个层级上运行。在七个决策基准测试中，我们的方法在每个深度均达到或超过独立训练模型的表现，同时通过自适应计算实现了更好的准确率-效率权衡。

summary: Natural Language Inference models can be sensitive to localized lexical changes. We introduce Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning (SMIC), which constructs a single input-dependent multiscale reference and reuses it across Transformer layers. Each layer applies its own multiscale transformation to the shared reference and injects the resulting conditioning feature before the attention update. We instantiate SMIC in a token--context Transformer (TCT) and conduct from-scratch comparisons against decoder-based and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) baselines across all three ANLI rounds. TCT-SMIC attains the highest observed ten-seed mean accuracy on all three ANLI rounds. The ablations further support the contribution of SMIC. We evaluate a real-valued Llama-style plug-in and extend deletion/insertion diagnostics to pretrained ModernBERT encoder and Llama decoder models with and without SMIC. Across the evaluated perturbation protocols, TCT-SMIC exhibits comparatively low pooled-attention redistribution and smaller signed accuracy changes. We further establish a finite-sample bound on average subset-mass redistribution in terms of the mean Jensen--Shannon divergence between the restricted and renormalized attention distributions.
title: SMIC: Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning across Transformer Layers for Natural Language Inference
title_translated: Transformer 层间共享多尺度输入-参考条件化用于自然语言推理
summary_translated: 自然语言推理模型对局部词汇变化敏感。我们引入共享多尺度输入-参考条件化（SMIC），构建一个单一的、依赖于输入的多尺度参考，并在 Transformer 各层中复用。每一层对其自身的多尺度变换应用于共享参考，并在注意力更新前注入相应的条件特征。我们在 token--context Transformer（TCT）中实例化 SMIC，并在 ANLI 三个回合中与基于解码器和多层感知机（MLP）的基线进行从头开始的对比。TCT-SMIC 在所有三个 ANLI 回合中达到了最高的十次种子平均准确率。消融实验进一步支持了 SMIC 的贡献。我们评估了一个实值 Llama 风格插件，并将删除/插入诊断扩展至预训练的 ModernBERT 编码器和 Llama 解码器模型，无论是否包含 SMIC。在所评估的扰动协议中，TCT-SMIC 表现出较低的聚合注意力重分配和较小的符号准确率变化。我们还建立了关于平均子集质量重分配的有限样本界，以受限和重新归一化的注意力分布之间的平均 Jensen-Shannon 散度为依据。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent claims that are unsupported by a given source document, motivating accurate and efficient document-grounded factuality detection. Existing LLM-based evaluators often require repeated inference and incur high computational cost, whereas compact factuality detectors are efficient at inference time but commonly rely on large labeled or synthetically generated corpora. We propose CPIL (Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning), a two-stage Siamese framework that converts a small labeled set into relational supervision without acquiring additional factuality labels. CPIL constructs positive pairs from distinct label-preserving paraphrastic views of the same document-claim instance and negative pairs from opposite-label examples associated with the same source document. It further introduces quantile-aware semi-hard negative mining, which derives a boundary from the positive-pair similarity distribution and balances informative negatives with broader coverage. In the two-stage training procedure, Stage 1 learns an encoder from these task-aware pairs, and Stage 2 jointly fine-tunes the encoder and a linear classification head for binary factuality prediction. At inference time, CPIL requires no paraphrase generation, pair construction, or Siamese comparison and uses only one encoder-classifier forward pass. On the 11-task LLM-AggreFact benchmark, CPIL-2% and CPIL-3% achieve macro-F1 scores of 81.04 and 81.60 while using only 2-3% of the FactCG-released labeled pool. Both settings outperform all compared compact detectors and two vanilla LLM references. Ablations and sensitivity analyses support the contributions of task-aware pair construction, dynamic negative mining, and multi-pivot paraphrasing.
title: Label-Efficient Document-Grounded Factuality Detection via Cross-Paraphrastic Invariance Learning
