title_translated: 基于跨改写不变性学习的标签高效文档基础事实检测
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）能够生成流畅但缺乏源文档支持的陈述，这促使人们需要准确且高效的文档基础事实检测方法。现有的基于 LLM 的评估器通常需要重复推理，计算成本高；而紧凑的事实检测器虽然推理效率高，但通常依赖大规模标注或合成语料库。我们提出 CPIL（跨改写不变性学习），一种两阶段孪生框架，无需获取额外的事实标签即可将少量标注数据转化为关系监督。CPIL 从同一文档-陈述实例的不同保标签改写视角构造正样本对，从同一源文档关联的相反标签示例中构造负样本对。此外，引入了分位数感知的半困难负样本挖掘，从正样本对相似度分布中推导出边界，平衡有信息量的负样本与更广覆盖范围。在两阶段训练过程中，第一阶段从这些任务感知对中学习编码器，第二阶段联合微调编码器和线性分类头以实现二元事实性预测。推理时，CPIL 不需要改写生成、对构建或孪生比较，仅需一次编码器-分类器前向传播。在 11 任务的 LLM-AggreFact 基准上，CPIL-2% 和 CPIL-3% 分别达到 81.04 和 81.60 的宏 F1 分数，仅使用 FactCG 发布标注池的 2-3%。两种设置均优于所有对比的紧凑检测器及两个原始 LLM 参考。消融和敏感性分析支持任务感知对构建、动态负样本挖掘和多枢轴改写的贡献。

summary: A multilingual speech recogniser has heard much speech in its own languages. We ask how much of that it brings to a language it was never trained on, when it is fine-tuned on the little that language has. We score 28 open multilingual models untouched on Low-Language-TTS, 50 low-resource languages in 11 writing systems, and fine-tune 24 of them on at most 1,000 clips a language, 82 hours in all, with a dev set choosing every epoch. Fine-tuning lowers every model's macro character error rate (CER), by 16.6 to 53.1 points, to 9.5 at best, and a word language model takes three CTC models 1.2 to 1.4 points lower; WER is still 34.4 at best. On the 12 languages that no model lists, every model starts at 46 or worse and the best ends at 11.7. The same architectures from random weights stay 60 points or more behind, so the gain is transfer, and an encoder left untouched already gives a Whisper or Qwen decoder most of what it needs. It is the language, not the corpus: on FLEURS recordings that ours do not share, the median model keeps 79% of its gain. It costs the languages the models knew, 5.7 points of CER on English, Spanish, French and German in the median model. Low-rank adapters on 4% of the weights come within 1.1 points of tuning everything, and on 2 of 3 models forget less. Seq2seq and language-model decoders are done within three to five epochs, while a new CTC head is still improving at twenty or thirty. Data beats epochs: 25 clips a language take Qwen3-ASR 0.6B from 60.9 to 39.3, and at equal clips presented, ten times the data is worth 9.7 points. A model that first learned forty of the languages learns the other ten no faster. On a public Malay benchmark, untouched Whisper large-v3 scores 8.9 when it detects the language and 14.9 when told the clip is Malay, because it then translates the English that speakers mix in; trained on the Scicom telephony dataset it scores 6.0.
title: Low Language Transfer Speech-to-Text
title_translated: 低语言迁移语音转文本
summary_translated: 一个多语言语音识别器在其自身语言中听过大量语音。我们探讨当它在从未训练过的语言上进行微调时，能带来多少来自已有语言的知识。我们对 28 个未在低语言语音转文本（Low-Language-TTS）上接触过的开放多语言模型进行了评分，涵盖 50 种低资源语言，分布在 11 种书写系统中，并对其中 24 个模型在每种语言最多 1,000 段语音（总计 82 小时）上进行微调，使用开发集每轮选择最佳模型。微调使所有模型的宏字符错误率（CER）下降 16.6 到 53.1 点，最优情况下降至 9.5；而词语言模型使三个 CTC 模型的 CER 再降低 1.2 至 1.4 点；最优词错误率（WER）仍为 34.4。在 12 种无模型列出的语言中，所有模型初始 CER 均在 46 或以上，最优结果为 11.7。从随机权重开始的相同架构始终落后 60 点以上，因此提升源于知识迁移；未修改的编码器已为 Whisper 或 Qwen 解码器提供了大部分所需内容。这是语言本身的作用，而非语料库：在我们未共享的 FLEURS 录音上，中位模型保持了 79% 的增益。这种迁移代价是模型已知语言的性能下降，中位模型在英语、西班牙语、法语和德语上的 CER 上升 5.7 点。仅对 4% 权重应用低秩适配器即可接近全参数微调的效果，且在 3 个模型中有 2 个遗忘更少。Seq2seq 和语言模型解码器在三到五个周期内完成训练，而新的 CTC 头在二十或三十个周期后仍在改进。数据胜过训练轮次：每语言 25 段语音使 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 的 CER 从 60.9 降至 39.3；在相同段数下，十倍数据相当于 9.7 点提升。一个先学习了四十种语言的模型，并未更快学会其余十种语言。在公开的马来语基准上，未微调的 Whisper large-v3 在检测到语言时得分为 8.9，在被告知片段为马来语时得分为 14.9，因为此时它会翻译说话者混入的英文；在 Scicom 电话数据集上微调后得分降至 6.0。

summary: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 强化学习后印地语任务的收益与退步
summary_translated: 我们在四个环境中使用 GRPO 进行强化学习（RL），起始模型为一个覆盖英语和八种印地语的 30B-A3B 混合专家模型。我们在一次评估活动中对比了 RL 前后模型在 34 个基准上的表现。数学（MATH）成绩提升了 36.07 分，大多数印地语基准也有所提升。然而，XQuAD-Indic 的 F1 分下降了 19.32 分，英语答案占比从 8.7% 上升至 91.7%；IndicQA 下降 8.64，而英语 XQuAD 提升 11.71 F1。第二次 RL 训练从相同的监督微调初始化出发，增加了印地语环境以及语言和重复奖励。相比发布模型，它在段落问答和指令遵循基准上均有提升，并保持了 MATH 性能。但在推理和编码基准上表现退步。由于多个训练选择同时改变，无法隔离任一奖励项的影响。脚本合规性问题仍未解决。增加语言奖励并未确保使用请求的脚本。因此，即使其他基准得分提升，段落问答和脚本合规性仍需直接评估。

summary: Shared history in human dialogue is not merely a repository of facts, but the foundation of evolving relationships and mutual understanding. However, mainstream conversational memory systems rely on passive semantic similarity over external fact stores, frequently retrieving topically similar records while missing relationally pivotal experiences. Inspired by cognitive psychology's Self-Memory System (SMS), we propose MindMem, a mental-state-driven memory framework that asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into source-linked mental states of the character, the user, and their relationship. At each turn, a specialized mental-state reasoner (Mind) contextualizes these persistent states to anticipate latent user needs, form proactive intentions, and recover supporting episodic evidence that surface-level matching overlooks. To evaluate history-sensitive adaptation beyond factual recall, we introduce MemReal-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark grounded in month-long real-user interactions across dyadic and group scenes. By pairing Direct Question Answering (DQA) with Situated Memory Realization (SMR), it tests whether agents bridge the gap between knowing past facts and naturally using shared history, world rules, and relational trajectories. On MemReal-Bench, MindMem reaches 59.03% SMR and 82.58% DQA, exceeding the strongest memory baseline by 24.19 and 9.19 percentage points, respectively, and outperforming oracle target-memory injection on SMR. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jiazhicheng7-ctrl/MindMem.
title: We Are What We Remember: Mental-State-Driven Memory for Long-Term Character Dialogue
comment: Zhicheng Jia, Shuchen Wu, and Zhuoshi Tong contributed equally to this work
title_translated: 我们即是我们所记得的：基于心理状态的记忆机制用于长期角色对话
summary_translated: 人类对话中的共享历史不仅是事实的存储库，更是关系演变和相互理解的基础。然而，主流对话记忆系统依赖于外部事实库中被动的语义相似性，频繁检索主题相关记录，却忽略了具有关系关键意义的经历。受认知心理学中自我-记忆系统（SMS）的启发，我们提出了MindMem，一种由心理状态驱动的记忆框架，能够异步地将共享经历整合为角色、用户及其关系的源关联心理状态。在每一轮对话中，专门的心理状态推理器（Mind）会 contextualize 这些持久状态，以预测潜在用户需求、形成主动意图，并恢复表面匹配所忽略的支持性情景证据。为了评估超越事实回忆的历史敏感适应能力，我们引入了MemReal-Bench，一个基于跨二元和群体场景长达一个月的真实用户互动的纵向基准。通过将直接问答（DQA）与情境化记忆实现（SMR）相结合，它测试智能体是否能弥合知晓过去事实与自然运用共享历史、世界规则和关系轨迹之间的差距。在MemReal-Bench上，MindMem在SMR上达到59.03%，在DQA上达到82.58%，分别比最强的记忆基线高出24.19和9.19个百分点，并在SMR上优于oracle目标记忆注入。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/jiazhicheng7-ctrl/MindMem获取。

summary: Existing large language models typically rely on massive fine-tuning datasets for safety alignment, which results in higher costs for safety alignment and often leads to the problem of over-refusal. We propose Less is Safer (LIS), a compact yet highly effective dataset for safety alignment, constructed through interpretable feature-guided selection and adversarial synthesis. Specifically, we leverage Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) activations to efficiently select prompts that cover diverse and interpretable safety features. Then, we employ a multi-agent adversarial synthesis framework to generate harmless prompts that nevertheless elicit unnecessary refusals. LIS contains only 2.4K samples, yet outperforms much larger datasets, e.g., TRIDENT-Core (26K), TRIDENT-Edge (19K) and WildJailbreak (262K), in overall performance on four safety and five over-refusal benchmarks. Through ablation experiments, we demonstrate that neither safety data nor over-refusal data alone can achieve optimal results. We also used safety features from SAE, annotated by an LLM, for data filtering, but the results were inferior to those obtained using the pipeline proposed in this paper.
title: Data-Efficient LLM Safety Alignment Guided by Interpretable Features
comment: 36 pages, 16 figures
title_translated: 基于可解释特征的数据高效大语言模型安全对齐
summary_translated: 现有的大型语言模型通常依赖大规模微调数据集进行安全对齐，导致安全对齐成本较高，并常引发过度拒绝问题。我们提出Less is Safer（LIS），一种紧凑但高效的用于安全对齐的数据集，通过可解释特征引导选择和对抗合成构建而成。具体而言，我们利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）激活来高效选取涵盖多样且可解释的安全特征的提示。随后，我们采用多智能体对抗合成框架生成无害但引发不必要的拒绝行为的提示。LIS仅包含2.4K样本，但在四个安全基准和五个过度拒绝基准上的整体表现优于更大规模的数据集，如TRIDENT-Core（26K）、TRIDENT-Edge（19K）和WildJailbreak（262K）。通过消融实验，我们证明仅使用安全数据或仅使用过度拒绝数据均无法取得最佳效果。我们还尝试使用LLM标注的SAE安全特征进行数据过滤，但结果不如本文提出的流程。

summary: Spam detection is usually treated as single-message classification, ignoring behavioral patterns that emerge across sequences of messages from the same sender. We study outbound SMS spam detection at the carrier level, where the goal is to predict at send time whether a carrier will flag a message as spam. Using a proprietary production database of 43,741 outbound SMS messages with UTC transmission timestamps and carrier delivery statuses, we report three sets of results. On an 8,749-message held-out test set, a TF-IDF + logistic regression baseline reaches AUC-ROC 0.8721, and a text-only DeBERTa-v3-base classifier reaches AUC-ROC 0.9011 and F1 0.8412. A deployed DistilBERT model augmented with inter-message temporal features reaches accuracy 0.8238, spam-class F1 0.8382, and recall 0.9128 at threshold 0.5 on a separate, class-balanced 20,000-message production evaluation set; these results are not directly comparable with the held-out test results. We also describe TemporalBertSpam, an architecture that encodes each sender's message history with a causal Transformer, and outline the same-split evaluation needed to measure its contribution.
title: Temporal Context-Aware Spam Detection Using Transformer-Based NLP Models
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
title_translated: 基于Transformer的NLP模型的时序上下文感知垃圾信息检测
summary_translated: 垃圾信息检测通常被视为单条消息分类任务，忽略了同一发送者消息序列中浮现的行为模式。我们研究运营商层面的出站短信垃圾信息检测，目标是在发送时预测运营商是否会将某条消息标记为垃圾信息。基于一个包含43,741条出站短信的专有生产数据库，包含UTC传输时间戳和运营商投递状态，我们报告了三组结果。在8,749条消息的独立测试集上，TF-IDF + 逻辑回归基线达到AUC-ROC 0.8721，而仅使用文本的DeBERTa-v3-base分类器达到AUC-ROC 0.9011和F1 0.8412。一个部署的DistilBERT模型结合消息间时序特征，在独立、类别平衡的20,000条消息生产评估集上达到准确率0.8238，垃圾类F1 0.8382，召回率0.9128（阈值0.5），这些结果与独立测试结果不可直接比较。我们还介绍了TemporalBertSpam架构，该架构使用因果Transformer编码每个发送者的消息历史，并概述了需在同一分割下评估其贡献的方法。

summary: We present Fikiria, a two-stage SFT+GRPO recipe for Swahili mathematical reasoning. Its reward multiplies a format gate by a weighted sum of answer accuracy and the ChrF\texttt{++} similarity of the Swahili reasoning to an in-language reference chain of thought, so that training targets the surface fidelity of the reasoning trace and not only the final answer. We train on a 2.3k-problem Swahili dataset created by translating GSM8K with GPT-4.1 and filtering with SSA-COMET. On AfriMGSM Swahili, Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B reaches 79.2\%. Under the same fixed prompt and strict answer-format scoring, GPT-4o reaches 68.0\%, partly because it often fails the required answer format; IrokoBench reports 78.8\% for GPT-4o using a best-per-model prompt, a figure numerically close to ours but not directly comparable. In a small human evaluation with co-author annotators, GPT-4o's outputs were preferred overall. ChrF\texttt{++} measures surface fidelity, not the validity of individual reasoning steps.
title: Show Your Work in Swahili: Reinforcement Learning for Native-Language Mathematical Reasoning
title_translated: 用斯瓦希里语展示你的工作：原生语言数学推理的强化学习方法
summary_translated: 我们提出了Fikiria，一种针对斯瓦希里语数学推理的两阶段SFT+GRPO训练方案。其奖励函数将格式门控与答案准确率及斯瓦希里语推理链与母语参考链之间ChrF++相似度的加权和相乘，从而训练目标不仅关注最终答案，也关注推理过程的表面一致性。我们在一个由GPT-4.1翻译GSM8K并经SSA-COMET过滤生成的2.3k题斯瓦希里语数据集上进行训练。在AfriMGSM斯瓦希里语任务中，Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B达到79.2%的准确率。在相同固定提示和严格答案格式评分下，GPT-4o达到68.0%，部分原因在于其经常不符合要求的答案格式；IrokoBench报告GPT-4o在最佳模型提示下为78.8%，数值接近但不直接可比。在与共同作者标注者的少量人工评估中，GPT-4o的输出总体更受欢迎。ChrF++衡量的是表面一致性，而非单个推理步骤的有效性。

summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on next-token targets from a teacher, a frozen copy of the student that additionally receives privileged information, such as a worked solution, hidden from the student. Whether student gains reflect that information remains unclear. Taking the worked solution as privileged information, we audit four stages across three Qwen3 scales on mathematics: Source, whether the teacher can use the solution; Encoding, whether the resulting token targets are useful; Transmission, whether the student learns from the targets; and Expression, whether the student applies the learned behavior without the solution. With the solution, the teacher solves hard problems and recovers from student errors, yet the teacher does not reliably recognize errors, and its token targets do not favor correct trajectories. Repeated training makes successes within the student's reach more frequent rather than unlocking new ones, and corrections the student learns to predict are not reliably expressed in free generation. To isolate the solution's contribution, we vary its availability separately from teacher and student thinking modes. The largest gains occur when a teacher in thinking mode supervises a student trained and evaluated without an explicit thinking trace, and problem-only teachers often match or exceed privileged-solution teachers: the gain tracks the teacher's thinking mode rather than the solution, a pattern we call reasoning arbitrage. Accuracy gains alone therefore do not establish transfer of reasoning from privileged solutions: bottlenecks lie after Source, across Encoding, Transmission, and Expression. Future evaluations must measure what the solution adds to otherwise identical training.
title: Privileged Information Does Not Guarantee Privileged Guidance: Auditing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Models
comment: Work in progress
title_translated: 特权信息并不保证特权指导：对推理模型在策略内自蒸馏的审计
summary_translated: 在策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）中，学生模型在来自教师模型的下一个词目标上进行训练，该教师模型是学生的一个冻结副本，额外接收学生无法访问的特权信息（如完整解题过程）。学生是否真正受益于这些信息仍不清楚。我们将完整解题过程视为特权信息，对三个Qwen3规模下的数学任务进行了四个阶段的审计：来源（教师能否使用解题过程）、编码（生成的目标token是否有用）、传输（学生是否从目标中学习）和表达（学生在无解题过程情况下是否能正确应用所学）。结果显示，尽管教师在有解题过程的情况下能解决难题并纠正学生错误，但教师并未可靠识别错误，其生成的目标token也不倾向于正确路径。重复训练使学生可达的成功更加频繁，而非解锁新的可能性；学生学会预测的修正行为在自由生成中也未可靠表达。为隔离解题过程的贡献，我们分别改变其在教师和学生思维模式中的可用性。最大增益出现在教师处于思维模式下监督一个无显式思维痕迹的学生（训练和评估均如此）时，而仅问题驱动的教师往往达到甚至超过拥有特权解题过程的教师：增益取决于教师的思维模式而非解题过程本身，这一现象称为推理套利。因此，仅凭准确率提升并不能证明从特权解题过程到推理能力的转移：瓶颈存在于来源之后的编码、传输和表达阶段。未来的评估必须测量解题过程为其他完全相同的训练带来的实际增益。

summary: Listeners can judge an agent's speech on how human it sounds (human-likeness) and on how much they would want to talk to it (conversational preference). Listening tests rarely ask about conversational preference, so the relation between the two judgments is unclear. We compared them in paired-choice tests on 120 turns that actors improvised as customer-service representatives. On each trial, two agents spoke the same turn. In Study 1, both agents came from six commercial text-to-speech systems, each with eight voices. In Study 2, one was the actor's original recording and the other a system. Some systems ranked higher on human-likeness, and others on conversational preference. Listeners chose systems over actors in 19% of human-likeness trials but 36% of conversational preference trials (and 49% for the most preferred system). On both judgments, variation among a system's voices was about three-quarters of that between systems. Of three automatic naturalness scores, two predicted lower human-likeness, and none predicted conversational preference. In this setting, listeners tended to favor faster speech and fewer pauses between clauses on both judgments, and more pitch variation for conversational preference. Thus, measuring only human-likeness or testing one voice per system can misjudge which agents listeners would rather talk to.
title: Human-Likeness and Conversational Preference Diverge for Synthesized Agent Speech in Customer-Service Calls
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures
title_translated: 合成代理语音在客户服务通话中的人类相似性与对话偏好存在分歧
summary_translated: 听众可以判断代理语音的“人类相似性”（即听起来有多像真人）以及他们愿意与之交谈的程度（即对话偏好）。由于听觉测试很少涉及对话偏好，因此这两种判断之间的关系尚不明确。我们在120个由演员即兴扮演客服代表的对话回合中进行了配对选择测试。每轮测试中，两个代理说出相同的句子。在研究1中，两个代理均来自六个商用文本转语音系统，每个系统有八个声音；在研究2中，一个是演员的原始录音，另一个是系统生成的声音。某些系统在人类相似性上排名较高，而另一些则在对话偏好上表现更优。在人类相似性测试中，听众选择系统而非演员的比例为19%，而在对话偏好测试中为36%（对于最受欢迎的系统，该比例高达49%）。在两种判断中，同一系统内不同声音之间的差异约为系统间差异的四分之三。三种自动自然度评分中，有两个预测了较低的人类相似性，但没有一个能预测对话偏好。在此情境下，听众倾向于偏好更快的语速和更少的句间停顿，且在对话偏好上更喜欢更大的音调变化。因此，仅测量人类相似性或每系统测试一个声音可能会错误判断听众更愿意与哪个代理交谈。

summary: Applications built on large language models assign the model a role through its system prompt, intending to shape how it responds for their use case. We introduce a validation framework for extracting and injecting occupational role vectors, activation-level directions that capture how someone in a given occupational role would distinctively respond to a task or question. We validate these vectors through two complementary lenses, on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The interpretability lens asks whether each vector is a stable, separable, domain-consistent representation of its role: extracted vectors are highly reproducible across repeated runs and sampling temperatures, remain separable even for very similar roles, and agree more with themselves across in-domain and out-of-domain questions than with other roles' signal. The control lens asks whether injecting a role vector during generation makes the model express the role, and sustain it over a conversation, as well as a role prompt does. On Qwen, injecting the vector alone makes the model express the intended role substantially more often than unsteered, but at best matches a role prompt; on both models, adding the vector to the prompt strengthens the role in single answers but did not slow the role's decline over 30 turns. Together, the two lenses show why both are needed: out of domain the role is expressed only subtly, yet the activations still encode it; and a vector that is stable and separable can still barely steer the model's behavior.
title: What Roles Do System Prompts Really Assign? Validating and Steering Occupational Role Vectors in LLMs

title_translated: 系统提示究竟分配了哪些角色？验证与引导大语言模型中的职业角色向量
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的应用通过系统提示赋予模型特定角色，以期根据使用场景塑造其回应方式。我们提出了一种验证框架，用于提取和注入职业角色向量——一种激活层方向，捕捉特定职业角色在面对任务或问题时的独特回应模式。我们通过两个互补视角在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上验证这些向量：可解释性视角关注向量是否为稳定、可分离且领域一致的角色表征——提取的向量在重复运行和不同采样温度下高度可复现，即使在非常相似的角色之间仍保持可分离性，并且在域内与域外问题上的自我一致性高于与其他角色信号的一致性；控制视角则考察生成过程中注入角色向量是否能使模型表现出预期角色并维持整个对话过程中的角色一致性。在Qwen模型上，仅注入向量即可显著提升模型表达目标角色的频率，但效果仍不及显式角色提示；在两个模型上，将向量加入提示虽增强了单次回答中的角色表现，但未能延缓角色在30轮对话后的衰退。两者结合表明：在域外情况下，角色仅被微妙地表达，但激活仍编码了该角色信息；即使向量稳定且可分离，仍难以有效引导模型行为。

summary: Punctuation marks often mark phrase boundaries, carrying linguistic information. Therefore, punctuation marks' abundance and feasibility as proxies of linguistic structure has led to suggestions that using punctuation marks to optimise on phrasal structure may help language models (LMs) improve their representations of argument, semantic, and syntactic structures. In this paper, we test the above claim in English across three primary LM architectures: decoder-only, encoder-only, and encoder-decoder LMs, by complementing traditional token prediction with punctuation restoration (PR). Our evidence, collected at the <1B parameter scale, suggests that optimising for boundary prediction does not necessarily guarantee higher-quality structural representation in decoder-only, encoder-decoder, and encoder-only LMs, failing to improve performance on downstream tasks that require understanding structure in linguistic input.
title: Better Boundary Prediction Does Not Guarantee Better Structural Representation

title_translated: 更好的边界预测并不保证更好的结构表征
summary_translated: 标点符号通常标记短语边界，携带语言学信息。因此，标点符号的丰富性和可行性使其被视为语言结构的代理指标，有人建议通过优化短语结构的边界预测来帮助语言模型改善其对论元、语义和句法结构的表征。本文在三种主要语言模型架构（仅解码器、仅编码器、编码器-解码器）中，通过补充传统的词元预测任务引入标点恢复（PR）任务，检验了上述主张。我们在参数量小于10亿的规模下收集证据，结果表明：优化边界预测并不必然带来更高品质的结构表征，且在需要理解语言输入结构的下游任务中并未提升性能。

summary: Even though various speech data sets are available in Hungarian, there is a lack of a general overview about their types and sizes. To fill in this gap, we provide a survey of available data sets in spoken Hungarian in five categories (e.g., monolingual, Hungarian part of multilingual, pathological, child-related and dialectal collections). In total, the estimated size of available data is about 2800 hours (across 7500 speakers) and it represents a rich spoken language diversity. However, the distribution of the data and its alignment to real-life (e.g. speech recognition) tasks is far from optimal indicating the need for additional larger-scale natural language speech data sets. Our survey presents an overview of available data sets for Hungarian explaining their strengths and weaknesses which is useful for researchers working on Hungarian across disciplines. In addition, our survey serves as a starting point towards a unified foundational speech model specific to Hungarian.
title: Is Spoken Hungarian Low-resource?: A Quantitative Survey of Hungarian Speech Data Sets

title_translated: 匈牙利语口语是否属于低资源语言？一项关于匈牙利语语音数据集的定量调查
summary_translated: 尽管已有多种匈牙利语语音数据集，但缺乏对其类型和规模的总体概述。为填补这一空白，我们对匈牙利语口语数据集进行了分类调查，涵盖五个类别（如单语、多语中匈牙利语部分、病理型、儿童相关及方言类集合）。总计估算可用数据量约为2800小时（覆盖约7500名说话者），体现了丰富的口语多样性。然而，数据分布及其与真实应用场景（如语音识别）的匹配程度远未达到理想状态，表明亟需更大规模的自然语言语音数据集。本调查全面介绍了现有匈牙利语数据集的优势与局限，对跨学科从事匈牙利语研究的研究人员具有参考价值。此外，本调查也为构建专属于匈牙利语的统一基础语音模型提供了起点。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as primary interfaces for factual retrieval, yet current evaluation paradigms rely almost exclusively on explicit entity names. In this work, we demonstrate that LLM knowledge is fundamentally lexically anchored: models possess extensive factual information but find it significantly difficult to retrieve without explicit name tokens. To quantify this limitation, we introduce ShadowBench, a rigorously hardened, shortcut-resistant benchmark designed to evaluate Latent Entity Association via a novel Dual-Trait Association (DTA) task. Our evaluation reveals a pervasive "Shadow Gap" across all model scales$\unicode{x2013}$up to the frontier models GPT-5.4 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6$\unicode{x2013}$where removing lexical anchors causes performance drops of over 20%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this lexical dependency exposes a critical vulnerability in AI safety. Applying ShadowBench to Machine Unlearning, we find that state-of-the-art algorithms (e.g., Gradient Difference, NPO) achieve only superficial lexical erasure. While unlearned models fail on direct queries, our novel Latent Entity Leakage Rate (LELR) metric reveals that for popular entities, models explicitly reconstruct the "forgotten" entity in their internal reasoning traces in over 74% of cases, utilizing residual shadow knowledge to solve associative tasks. Conversely, for niche entities, models retain high shadow accuracy (60-90%) via implicit attribute correlation despite 0% LELR. Ultimately, ShadowBench indicates that current unlearning paradigms create an "Illusion of Forgetting," demonstrating that existing methods act as superficial output filters and are not yet reliable for achieving true parametric erasure.
title: ShadowBench: Exposing Lexical Anchoring and the Illusion of Forgetting in Large Language Models

title_translated: ShadowBench：揭示大语言模型中的词汇锚定现象与遗忘幻觉
summary_translated: 大语言模型已成为事实检索的主要接口，但当前评估范式几乎完全依赖于显式的实体名称。本文证明，大语言模型的知识本质上是词汇锚定的：模型虽掌握大量事实信息，但在缺乏显式名称标记时难以检索。为量化这一限制，我们提出了ShadowBench，一个严格强化、抗捷径的基准测试，通过新颖的双特质关联（DTA）任务评估潜在实体关联能力。我们的评估发现，在所有模型规模下——包括前沿模型GPT-5.4和Claude-Sonnet-4.6——移除词汇锚定会导致性能下降超过20%，形成普遍存在的“阴影差距”。此外，我们揭示了这一词汇依赖暴露了人工智能安全中的关键漏洞。将ShadowBench应用于机器遗忘任务，发现最先进的算法（如梯度差、NPO）仅实现表面化的词汇擦除。虽然被遗忘模型在直接查询中失败，但我们的新型潜在实体泄漏率（LELR）指标显示，对于流行实体，模型在内部推理轨迹中重新构建“已遗忘”实体的情况超过74%，利用残留的阴影知识解决关联任务。相反，对于冷门实体，尽管LELR为0%，模型仍通过隐含属性相关性保持60%-90%的阴影准确率。最终，ShadowBench表明，当前遗忘范式制造了“遗忘幻觉”，现有方法仅作为表面输出过滤器，尚未能实现真正的参数级擦除。

summary: Cultural heritage sites are increasingly monitored by sensor networks, but querying their data requires database expertise. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a natural-language interface, yet over raw sensor records they lose track of which sensor, site, and time each value belongs to, and silently miscompute. We present HeriKGQA, a knowledge-graph question-answering method that confines the LLM to interpreting questions and phrasing answers, leaving computation to SPARQL and deterministic code. Questions are parsed into intents constrained by a heritage ontology aligning W3C SOSA/SSN with CIDOC-CRM, compiled into SPARQL, and answered from query results and temporal, spatial, and anomaly facts derived by a grounding layer, with error correction guarding each LLM step. On 500 questions over real data from five heritage sites, HeriKGQA reaches 99.0% accuracy, 18.2 points above the strongest of three baselines using the same LLM and receiving the same anomaly rules and answer conventions, with comparable answer quality while running almost four times faster. Without grounding, accuracy drops by 12.2 points and on anomaly questions from 99% to 66%. We report lessons from development and live deployment.
title: HeriKGQA: Grounded Knowledge-Graph Question Answering over Cultural Heritage Sensor Data

title_translated: HeriKGQA：基于文化遗产传感器数据的实体知识图谱问答
summary_translated: 文化遗产遗址越来越多地通过传感器网络进行监测，但查询其数据需要数据库专业知识。大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了自然语言接口，但在原始传感器记录上，它们会丢失每个数值所属的传感器、地点和时间信息，并无声地产生错误计算。我们提出了HeriKGQA，一种将LLM限制在解释问题和表述答案的基于知识图谱的问答方法，而计算任务则交由SPARQL和确定性代码完成。问题通过遗产本体（对齐W3C SOSA/SSN与CIDOC-CRM）解析为意图，编译成SPARQL，并从查询结果以及由接地层推导出的时间、空间和异常事实中获取答案，每一步都配有错误纠正机制。在五个文化遗产站点的真实数据上进行的500个问题测试中，HeriKGQA达到了99.0%的准确率，比使用相同LLM并接收相同异常规则和答案规范的三个基线模型高出18.2个百分点，同时保持相当的答案质量，运行速度几乎快了四倍。若无接地机制，准确率下降12.2个百分点，异常问题的准确率从99%降至66%。我们报告了开发和实际部署中的经验教训。

summary: Despite their differences, the languages of the world share many deep features when it comes to how they express meaning. These semantic universals are likely to reflect shared aspects of human cognitive, communicative, and social structure. Recent advances in cross-linguistic semantics and computational linguistics allow us to develop explanations of the sources of such properties. This Element presents a body of work doing just that: we explicate a framework for providing computational explanations of semantic universals and then describe several such explanations using principles of ease of learning and efficient communication. Empirical domains include quantifiers, color terms, modals, and indefinites. After providing these explanations, we provide a discussion of future directions for advancing the explanatory power of computational methods in semantic typology.
title: Computational Explanations of Semantic Universals

title_translated: 语义普遍性的计算解释
summary_translated: 尽管世界语言存在差异，但在表达意义方面却共享许多深层特征。这些语义普遍性可能反映了人类认知、交流和社会结构的共性。近年来跨语言语义学和计算语言学的进步使我们能够探索这些特性的来源。本文呈现了一项工作，旨在提供语义普遍性的计算解释：我们阐明了一个提供此类解释的框架，并利用学习简便性和高效沟通原则描述了若干解释。实证领域包括量词、颜色词、情态动词和不定词。在提供这些解释后，我们还讨论了未来推进计算方法在语义类型学中解释力的方向。

summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families. For the capability spectrum, SO-Arena offers evidence-grounded evaluation through reliable sources and manual verification of reference labels against model-visible inputs; fine-grained capability assessment through domain-specific difficulty criteria; and realistic interactive evaluation, where models iteratively execute actions in sandboxes. Reasoning-intensive tasks further enable system one-two comparison. Beyond accuracy, SO-Arena assesses decision reliability through two complementary measures: decision stability under controlled option-set changes and missing-answer recognition when no valid option is available. Evaluations across 21 models reveal that the benefits of scaling and additional reasoning vary substantially across domains. More importantly, strong overall performance does not necessarily imply reliable decision-making: the best-performing System One model ranks only seventh in reliability. Together, these findings highlight the need to characterize capability spectrum and decision reliability as complementary dimensions, providing a systematic view of the strengths and limitations of System One models.
title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models

title_translated: SO-Arena：系统一模型能力谱与可靠性基准测试
summary_translated: 系统一模型承诺在无需长时间生成token的情况下实现快速、通用的决策。然而，理解其能力谱和决策可靠性需要超越当前基准的聚合性能。现有评估往往难以揭示模型能力的广度及其决策的可靠性。我们引入SO-Arena，一个涵盖11个领域和五大能力类别的基准，用于刻画系统一模型的能力谱和决策可靠性。在能力谱方面，SO-Arena通过可靠来源和人工验证参考标签与模型可见输入的一致性，提供基于证据的评估；通过领域特定的难度标准实现细粒度能力评估；并通过沙箱中模型迭代执行动作的现实交互式评估。推理密集型任务进一步支持系统一与系统二的对比。除了准确率，SO-Arena还通过两个互补指标评估决策可靠性：在可控选项集变化下的决策稳定性，以及当无有效选项时的缺失答案识别能力。对21个模型的评估表明，扩展规模和额外推理带来的收益在不同领域间差异显著。更重要的是，整体表现优异并不意味着决策可靠：表现最佳的系统一模型在可靠性上仅排名第7。这些发现强调，必须将能力谱和决策可靠性视为互补维度，以系统化地认识系统一模型的优势与局限。

summary: Knowing when a large language model's (LLM's) response can be trusted is critical for its safe use. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) can help LLMs recognize if their responses may be unreliable. Existing taxonomies organize UQ methods by uncertainty source or estimation mechanism. They leave unresolved the question of where uncertainty is observed in the model's computation. The answer matters because the observation point determines whether an estimator has access to enough information to recover a given target, and how well it can recover it. Drawing on mechanistic interpretability, we define four mechanistic observation lenses: the structural lens observes component updates, the representational lens observes hidden states, the distributional lens observes token probabilities, and the semantical lens observes distributions over meanings. We relate these lenses through the residual stream and order them by the information they carry, which gives a principle for selecting UQ methods for different targets. We survey existing methods through the four lenses. Furthermore, we distinguish evaluation targets, criteria, and metrics to clarify different UQ evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open problems and research directions to connect uncertainty estimation to the internal computation and downstream use of LLMs.
title: Where Is Uncertainty Observed? A Mechanistic Understanding of Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
title_translated: 不确定性在何处被观测？大语言模型中不确定性量化机制的机理理解
summary_translated: 了解大语言模型（LLM）的响应何时可信赖，对于其安全使用至关重要。不确定性量化（UQ）有助于LLM识别其响应可能不可靠的情况。现有的分类体系按不确定性来源或估计机制组织UQ方法，但未解决不确定性在模型计算中被观测的位置这一关键问题。该答案至关重要，因为观测点决定了估计器是否能获得足够信息来恢复目标，以及恢复效果如何。基于机理可解释性，我们定义了四种机理观测视角：结构视角观察组件更新，表征视角观察隐藏状态，分布视角观察标记概率，语义视角观察意义分布。我们通过残差流关联这些视角，并按其所携带的信息量排序，从而为针对不同目标选择UQ方法提供原则。我们通过这四个视角综述了现有方法。此外，我们区分了评估目标、标准和度量，以澄清不同的UQ评估协议。最后，我们指出了开放问题和研究方向，以建立不确定性估计与LLM内部计算及下游应用之间的联系。

summary: Post-training can improve rewarded behavior while weakening capabilities users still need. We study two GRPO branches from a shared supervised checkpoint in a multilingual mixture-of-experts model. The released branch gains 36.07 points on MATH but loses 19.32 F1 points on XQuAD-Indic, while XQuAD-English improves under the same scoring rule. An independently trained sibling adds Indic instruction following and language-aware shaping. It recovers the regressing Indic task scores and preserves MATH, but does not restore script compliance and trades off competition mathematics and code. In a later round, judge training is followed by a sharp extraction decline from the Indic branch; reward-free distillation from its earlier checkpoint restores most of the lost F1. A MATH score decomposition associates most of the measured gain with increased boxed-answer emission; accuracy among boxed answers changes little. These results show why benchmark scores should be read alongside the response forms they reward.
title: Outside the Purview of the Reward: Capability Drift in Multilingual Post-Training
comment: Accepted at the Foundations of LLM Post-Training in Changing Environments, NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: 奖励之外的范畴：多语言后训练中的能力漂移
summary_translated: 后训练可以在提升受奖励行为的同时削弱用户仍需的能力。我们研究了一个多语言混合专家模型中从同一监督检查点分叉出的两个GRPO分支。释放的分支在MATH上提升了36.07分，但在XQuAD-Indic上损失了19.32 F1分，而XQuAD-English在同一评分规则下有所提升。一个独立训练的兄弟分支增加了印地语指令遵循和语言感知塑造。它恢复了退化的印地语任务得分并保留了MATH成绩，但未能恢复脚本合规性，并在竞赛数学与代码任务之间做出权衡。在后续一轮中，裁判训练后，印地语分支出现明显的提取下降；而从其早期检查点进行无奖励蒸馏，恢复了大部分丢失的F1分数。对MATH得分的分解分析表明，大部分提升源于框选答案的增加；而框选答案内的准确率变化不大。这些结果说明，基准分数应结合其所奖励的响应形式一同解读。

summary: Low-resource, agglutinative languages challenge low-latency ASR, as fixed lookahead windows fail when grapheme order diverges, suffixes cross code-switch boundaries, or code-switching data is imbalanced. We present the first comprehensive study of streaming ASR for intra-sentential Bangla-English code-switching, identifying a mismatch between strict causal streaming and long-range morphological dependencies. We introduce a Dynamic Block-Online framework with VAD-aligned inference that balances semantics, latency, and context, enabling global bidirectional attention to preserve morphological integrity. To mitigate data scarcity, we propose Script-Anchored Loanword Injection, augmenting training text with English loanwords to model phonotactic transitions. We introduce CS-WER to diagnose switch, root, and suffix errors, and show that flexible latency budgets enhance recognition of agglutinative and mixed-language speech, with successful transfer to menstrual-medical domains.
title: Dynamic Block-Online Streaming ASR for Low-Resource Agglutinative Code-Switching Speech with Morphology-Aware Evaluation

title_translated: 面向低资源黏着语代码混杂语音的动态块-在线流式ASR及其形态感知评估
summary_translated: 低资源黏着语对低延迟自动语音识别构成挑战，因为固定前瞻窗口在字符顺序偏离、词尾跨越代码切换边界或代码切换数据不平衡时会失效。我们首次系统研究了句内孟加拉语-英语代码混杂语音的流式ASR，揭示了严格因果流式处理与长程形态依赖之间的不匹配。我们提出动态块-在线框架，结合语音活动检测对齐推理，在语义、延迟和上下文之间取得平衡，支持全局双向注意力以保持形态完整性。为缓解数据稀缺问题，我们提出脚本锚定借词注入方法，通过在训练文本中加入英语借词来建模音位过渡。我们引入CS-WER用于诊断切换、词根和词缀错误，并表明灵活的延迟预算能提升对黏着语和混合语言语音的识别效果，且成功迁移至月经-医疗领域。

summary: Medieval French is one of the Romance vernacular languages with a significant history of transmission and an enormous influence on other vernacular languages of the time. The sources convey valuable knowledge about all aspects of culture. The study of Medieval French has, over the last few years, increasingly benefited from NLP-based methods. There have been numerous efforts to parse medieval French; however, these efforts use corpora comprising legal texts and -- primarily -- literary texts as their foundation and training data. This means that, except for juridical resources, scientific literature is overlooked.   We present ALMeD, an annotated, semantically rich corpus (work-in-progress) of medical and surgical treatises produced in medieval French, i.e., Old and Middle French, including Anglo-Norman. Our semantically disambiguated gold standard goes beyond existing resources, focusing on medical terminology, and accounts for morphological development, evolving syntactical structures and the lack of spelling normalisation in these languages.
title: ALMeD: Medieval French Gold-Standard
title_translated: ALMeD：中世纪法语黄金标准语料库
summary_translated: 中世纪法语是罗曼语族中具有重要传播历史并深刻影响其他同时期方言的语言之一。其文献资料蕴含了文化各方面的宝贵知识。近年来，自然语言处理方法在中世纪法语研究中日益发挥重要作用。尽管已有大量语法分析工作，但这些研究主要基于法律文本和文学文本构建语料库和训练数据，导致科学文献被忽视。我们提出ALMeD，一个正在建设中的标注丰富、语义丰富的医学与外科手稿语料库，涵盖中世纪法语（包括盎格鲁-诺曼语）。该语义消歧的黄金标准超越现有资源，聚焦医学术语，并考虑这些语言的形态演变、句法结构变迁以及拼写未标准化的问题。

summary: As memory-augmented agents increasingly support long-term and personalized interactions, reliable recall of emotional experiences while preserving their associated affect becomes necessary. However, existing evaluations usually assess emotion accuracy and factual memory grounding separately, overlooking event-affect correspondence. In this work, we formulate Affective-Episodic Retrospection (AER) as a task that explicitly evaluates the recovery of past events, associated affects, and their correspondence, and define Event-Affect Decoupling as a failure mode where the correct emotion is recalled but associated with the wrong episode. To diagnose Event-Affect Decoupling, we propose EM-TRACE, a stage-wise framework that decomposes AER into retrieval, affect recovery, and realization. On a controlled GoEmotions-based benchmark, Emotion-only retrieval achieves 28.65% affect recovery but retrieves the target episode for only 4.44% of queries, yielding a UAR of 24.21%. Further analysis reveals that event retrieval and affect assignment introduce distinct binding failures. These findings show that reliable AER requires grounded recall of emotional experiences, where episode retrieval, affect recovery, event-affect binding, and generation quality should be evaluated jointly. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/A412/.
title: Can Agents Relive Past Experiences? Diagnosing Event-Affect Decoupling in Affective-Episodic Retrospection
title_translated: 智能体能否重温过往经历？情感-情景回溯中的事件-情感解耦诊断
summary_translated: 随着记忆增强型智能体越来越多地支持长期个性化交互，可靠地回忆带有相应情感体验的过去事件变得至关重要。然而，现有评估通常将情绪准确性与事实记忆基础分开评估，忽略了事件与情感之间的对应关系。本文将情感-情景回溯（AER）定义为一项任务，明确评估过去事件、相关情感及其对应关系的恢复能力，并将事件-情感解耦定义为一种失败模式：正确回忆情绪但关联到错误事件。为诊断该解耦现象，我们提出EM-TRACE框架，将AER分解为检索、情感恢复和生成三个阶段。在基于GoEmotions的受控基准上，仅情绪检索的准确率仅为28.65%，而目标事件检索率仅为4.44%，综合UAR为24.21%。进一步分析显示，事件检索与情感分配分别引入不同的绑定失败。这些发现表明，可靠的AER需要基于情境的体验回忆，必须联合评估事件检索、情感恢复、事件-情感绑定及生成质量。代码已公开于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/A412/。

summary: Backpack language models predict with a strictly linear combination of non-contextual per-word sense vectors, weighted by non-negative contextualization scores. We show that non-negativity conflates two properties: the linear readout, which carries the interpretability, and the conic combination, which merely restricts it. We relax the latter by computing the sense weights with differential attention, a difference of two softmax maps with a learned per-sense gain, so context can actively inhibit a sense; we call the result a differential Backpack. At equal parameters on WikiText-103 this cuts the Backpack's perplexity gap to a Transformer by 31%, improves over the softmax Backpack at every sense count, persists with a shrinking margin up to 350M parameters on OpenWebText, and is localized at the sense layer by ablations and controls. The learned inhibition is directly interpretable (a financial context drives the river sense of bank to -0.50), and the preserved per-sense attribution predicts counterfactual removals exactly. We tested a number of combination rules, showing the linear interface is nearly free. Making the readout nonlinear gains only 0.43 perplexity points while invalidating two thirds of the decomposition. The differential Backpack's senses are also better representations, improving zero-shot sentence similarity by up to 33%.
title: Differential Backpack Language Models: Sense Inhibition via Signed Contextualization Weights
title_translated: 差异背包语言模型：通过带符号上下文权重实现意义抑制
summary_translated: 背包语言模型通过非上下文化词义向量的严格线性组合进行预测，权重为非负的上下文化得分。我们指出非负性混淆了两个属性：线性输出带来的可解释性，以及锥形组合带来的限制。我们通过差分注意力放松后者——即使用两个softmax映射的差值并引入每种意义的可学习增益，使上下文能够主动抑制某种意义；由此产生的模型称为差分背包模型。在WikiText-103上参数相等的情况下，该模型将背包模型与Transformer之间的困惑度差距降低了31%，在所有词义数量下均优于原始softmax背包模型，并在OpenWebText上持续表现良好，直至参数量达3.5亿时仍保持优势。消融实验和对照测试表明其效果集中在词义层。所学抑制机制具有直接可解释性（如金融语境使bank的river义降至-0.50），且保留的词义归因能精确预测反事实移除效果。我们测试了多种组合规则，发现线性接口几乎无代价。使输出非线性仅带来0.43个困惑度提升，却破坏了三分之二的分解结构。此外，差分背包模型的意义表示也更优，零样本句子相似度最高提升33%。

summary: With the rapid development of LLMs, increasing attention has been paid to whether they can reliably generate complete and legally valid judicial documents. This calls for a benchmark capable of evaluating whether models can accurately apply statutes and resolve outcome-critical issues, including claims, charges, penalties, and monetary obligations. However, existing benchmarks typically focus on isolated legal tasks or coarse-grained evaluation. We introduce ChJGBench, a benchmark for generating the reasoning and dispositive sections of Chinese judgments across civil, criminal, and administrative cases. Built from 3,462 real-world judgments, ChJGBench provides a case-type-aware diagnostic evaluation framework comprising 13 metric types and adopts a hybrid paradigm. Experiments reveal no uniform advantage for legal-domain models over general-purpose models, with model strengths varying across diagnostic dimensions. Performance is generally stronger on criminal cases, while civil and administrative cases continue to present substantial challenges.
title: ChJGBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Legal Judgment Generation with Diagnostic Evaluation
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Published in EMNLP 2026 (main conference)
title_translated: ChJGBench：面向中文法律判决生成的综合性基准与诊断评估
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，人们越来越关注其是否能可靠生成完整且合法有效的司法文书。这要求建立一个能够评估模型是否能准确适用法律条文并解决关键判决问题（包括诉讼请求、指控、处罚及金钱义务）的基准。然而，现有基准通常聚焦孤立的法律任务或粗粒度评估。我们提出ChJGBench，一个用于生成民事、刑事和行政案件中裁判文书的推理部分与裁决部分的基准。该基准基于3,462份真实判决构建，提供一种案例类型感知的诊断评估框架，包含13类评估指标，并采用混合范式。实验表明，法律领域模型在整体上并无统一优势，其性能在不同诊断维度间差异显著。总体而言，模型在刑事案件上的表现较强，而在民事和行政案件中仍面临重大挑战。

summary: Contracts, technical manuals, and online communities often give familiar words special meanings and define them in one place. A language model that reads a passage without that definition may use the usual meaning and give an answer that sounds right but is wrong. We study this with multiple-choice questions whose correct answers depend on a local definition. The questions come from a synthetic vocabulary, commercial contracts, Reddit community glossaries, and the documentation of a decentralized exchange. We ask three language models each question with and without the definition. Without using the answer key, we then test whether their repeated answers and stated confidence reveal their own errors. Separately, we give a small open model the answer key and test whether it can predict which questions larger models get wrong. We report three findings. (1) Familiar words that a source redefines cause the most errors. Models often repeat the same wrong answer, and neither repeated answers nor stated confidence reliably flag it. (2) The source definition fixes most errors on synthetic questions, but a definition drawn from the model's own prior knowledge does not. In real contracts, the source definition fixes only about half of the errors. (3) Given an answer key, a small model can rank questions by how likely larger models are to get them wrong. These results call for tests that check answers against the full source, including its local definitions.
title: When Local Definitions Are Missing: Stable Errors in Language Models
title_translated: 当局部定义缺失时：语言模型中的稳定错误
summary_translated: 合同、技术手册和在线社区经常为常见词汇赋予特殊含义，并在某处进行定义。若语言模型阅读的段落中缺少该定义，可能使用常规含义作答，导致看似合理实则错误的答案。我们通过多选题研究这一现象，其正确答案依赖于局部定义。题目来源于合成词汇、商业合同、Reddit社区术语表以及去中心化交易所的文档。我们让三个语言模型在有无定义的情况下回答同一问题，不借助答案键，测试其重复回答和信心声明是否能揭示自身错误。此外，我们给一个小的开源模型提供答案键，测试其能否预测大模型在哪些问题上会出错。研究发现：(1) 源头重新定义的熟悉词汇导致最多错误；模型常重复相同错误答案，而重复回答和信心值无法可靠识别错误。(2) 源定义可修复大部分合成题的错误，但模型自身先验知识中的定义无效；在真实合同中，源定义仅修复约一半错误。(3) 给定答案键后，小模型可按大模型出错概率对问题排序。这些结果呼吁设计更全面的测试，需检查答案与完整来源（包括局部定义）的一致性。

summary: We present VWEN, a 0.8B-parameter model for Vietnamese paraphrasing at a requested level of change and for five related tasks: generating several paraphrases, simplification, gist, register transfer and paraphrase judgement. VWEN is Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tuned on about 7k samples chosen by a four-stage pipeline: rules and deduplication, a bidirectional entailment filter, a divergence score that assigns low and high paraphrase levels, and selection for coverage and instruction-following difficulty. We compare it with paraphrase-only recipes from the same pipeline and with training on the ViSP corpus under matched and larger step budgets. On high-divergence paraphrasing, VWEN reaches a success rate (requested level reached and meaning preserved) of 0.61 against 0.46 for the ViSP model at matched compute, a difference that holds on inputs resembling ViSP. Given four times more training examples, the ViSP model closes the gap on such inputs but not on questions, which ViSP lacks and which it often turns into statements. Across all comparisons the entailment filter is the most effective stage. Training on paraphrases alone erases abilities of the base model that the multi-task data preserves.
title: VWEN: A Curated Small Language Model for Vietnamese Paraphrasing
title_translated: VWEN：面向越南语改写任务的精选小型语言模型
summary_translated: 我们提出VWEN，一个0.8B参数的小型语言模型，用于在指定改写程度下完成五项相关任务：生成多个改写句、简化文本、提取要点、语体转换和改写判断。VWEN基于Qwen3.5-0.8B，在约7,000个样本上进行微调，这些样本通过四阶段筛选流程选出：规则与去重、双向蕴含过滤、差异度评分（区分低/高改写程度）、覆盖度与指令遵循难度选择。我们将其与同流程生成的仅改写训练集模型，以及在ViSP语料库上以匹配和更大训练预算训练的模型进行比较。在高差异度改写任务中，VWEN的成功率（达到目标改写程度且语义保留）为0.61，高于匹配算力下ViSP模型的0.46，该优势在类似ViSP输入上依然存在。当训练样本增加四倍时，ViSP模型在类似输入上缩小差距，但在问题类输入上仍表现不佳——因ViSP缺乏问题形式，常将其转化为陈述句。所有对比中，蕴含过滤阶段最有效。仅用改写数据训练会抹除基础模型的能力，而多任务数据能保留这些能力。

summary: A benchmark score is commonly read as a proxy for model capability. We study the inverse problem: can a model be driven to a target score, and do its failures resemble those of a naturally weaker model? We operationalize believable performance reduction along three axes: target calibration, item-difficulty structure, and error-distribution similarity to a real weak reference. We introduce CapLadder, an IRT-calibrated suite of 1,985 items spanning mathematics, code, multiple-choice reasoning, and tool use. A simple weak-teacher LoRA dial reaches unseen target levels on reasoning with a 1.9-point held-out calibration error, whereas prompting, temperature, and weight noise cannot combine comparable range and precision. Yet on multiple choice, the dial converges to an answer-token attractor: up to 97% of its newly introduced errors land on one letter, with the attractor changing from D in Qwen to A in Llama. Logit interventions identify a dominant near-constant shift: subtracting the estimated shift on held-out items recovers 52 to 59% of lost accuracy and removes the dominant attractor, while option permutation confirms that the bias tracks token position rather than option content. With high inter-annotator agreement ($κ=0.94$), human-coded error-category distributions nonetheless match the weak reference on reasoning (JS = 0.00), showing that local plausibility and aggregate detectability differ. Structured tool calls exhibit more natural degradation in the Qwen family (JS = 0.09), while a globally calibrated dial transfers poorly across benchmarks (14.2-point error on two usable benchmarks). Precise score control, therefore, does not imply a portable or believable reduction in skill.
title: Can We Make an LLM Dumber, or Is It Just Playing Dumb? An Empirical Study of Believable Performance Throttling
title_translated: 我们能让大模型变笨吗？还是它只是假装笨？关于可信性能降级的实证研究
summary_translated: 基准分数通常被视为模型能力的代理指标。我们研究反向问题：能否将模型驱动至目标分数，且其失败模式是否类似于自然较弱模型？我们从三个维度操作化“可信性能降低”：目标校准性、题目难度结构和错误分布与真实弱参考模型的相似性。我们引入CapLadder，一个基于项目反应理论（IRT）校准的1,985道题套件，涵盖数学、代码、多选推理和工具使用。一个简单的弱教师LoRA旋钮可在推理任务中实现未见目标分数，持有样本校准误差仅为1.9分；而提示、温度调整和权重噪声无法同时达到同等范围与精度。然而在多选题中，该旋钮收敛至答案标记吸引子：高达97%的新错误落在单一字母上，且吸引子从Qwen的D变为Llama的A。对数空间干预识别出主导性的近似恒定偏移：在持有样本上减去估计偏移可恢复52%至59%的准确率损失，并消除主要吸引子；选项排列实验确认偏差源于标记位置而非选项内容。尽管人类标注者间一致性高（κ=0.94），但人类编码的错误类别分布与弱参考模型在推理任务上高度匹配（JS=0.00），表明局部合理性与整体可检测性存在差异。结构化工具调用在Qwen系列中表现出更自然的退化（JS=0.09），而全局校准旋钮在跨基准迁移中表现差劲（两个可用基准上误差达14.2分）。因此，精确的分数控制并不意味着技能的可移植或可信降低。

summary: Retrieval-augment generation is a prevalent strategy to mitigate hallucinations of LLMs. The attributable RAG (RAGQ) generates quotes for its answers. The quotes indicate which input contexts support the RAG to derive the answers, enhancing the answer's verifiability and trustworthiness. However, existing RAGQs exhibit significant degradation when dealing with questions that require multi-hop reasoning and multi-modal understanding, suffering from over-citation, implicit entity identification failure, and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel RAGQ framework, namely QDRAG. QDRAG breaks down the input question into atomic subquestions to identify the implicit entities. Then, the reranker prunes context distractors to eliminate the downstream over-citation. To facilitate query decomposition, we propose two zero-shot approaches: QD-C and QD-R, which guide the QD MLLM to decompose the question based on context knowledge and retrieval rewards, respectively. One interesting finding is that finetuning on the QD task shows better generalizability compared to directly finetuning on the downstream RAGQ task. Experiments on four multi-modal QA benchmarks demonstrate QDRAG's efficacy in grounding answers and generating faithful citations. The framework significantly outperforms all the baselines on both in-domain and out-of-domain tests, even surpassing Gemini-Pro.
title: Faithful in Steps: Improving Generalization and Citation in RAG via Query Decomposition
comment: Accepted by AAAI 2026
title_translated: 步步忠实：通过查询分解提升RAG的泛化能力与引用准确性
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）是缓解大语言模型幻觉的常用策略。可归因RAG（RAGQ）会为答案生成引用，标明支持答案的输入上下文，从而增强答案的可验证性和可信度。然而现有RAGQ在处理需要多跳推理和多模态理解的问题时表现显著下降，存在过度引用、隐含实体识别失败和泛化能力差等问题。本文提出一种新型RAGQ框架QDRAG：将输入问题分解为原子子问题以识别隐含实体；再通过重排序器剔除上下文干扰项，防止下游过度引用。为支持查询分解，我们提出两种零样本方法：QD-C和QD-R，分别基于上下文知识和检索奖励引导QD MLLM进行问题分解。一个有趣发现是：在QD任务上微调比直接在下游RAGQ任务上微调具有更好的泛化能力。在四个多模态问答基准上的实验表明，QDRAG在答案定位和忠实引用方面均显著优于所有基线模型，甚至超越Gemini-Pro。

summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation depends on the quality of the knowledge graph (KG) it retrieves over, yet schema-free LLM-based extraction pipelines typically produce flat graphs: deduplicated entities and relations with no type hierarchy and no domain/range constraints. We present AutoOntic, a pipeline that automatically constructs an ontology from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing a hierarchy over the canonicalized types, and mining relation-level domain and range constraints. Its hierarchy induction procedure prioritizes types using corpus-derived relation-argument profiles and places them through local, LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, allowing newly inserted types to trigger reassignment of existing parent-child links. The resulting hierarchy constrains entity deduplication and supports the induction of relation-level domain/range constraints. For intrinsic evaluation, we introduce a reference-based protocol that classifies induced ontology types as exact, broader, narrower, or unrelated to reference domain and range classes. On the Wikidata-TekGen and DBpedia-WebNLG subsets of Text2KGBench, over 90% of AutoOntic's induced endpoint types are semantically aligned with the reference classes across two LLM backbones: about half match exactly, while most remaining differences concern granularity. On MINE, knowledge graphs organized using an ontology built by AutoOntic achieve 88% retrieval accuracy. AutoOntic is available at https://github.com/screemix/AutoOntic.
title: AutoOntic: Automatic Ontology Induction from Text for Knowledge Graph Construction
title_translated: AutoOntic：从文本自动构建本体以支持知识图谱构建
summary_translated: 基于图的检索增强生成依赖于所检索知识图谱（KG）的质量，但基于LLM的无模式提取流程通常生成扁平图：去重后的实体与关系，缺乏类型层次结构及领域/范围约束。我们提出AutoOntic，一个自动从文本构建本体的流程：对开放词汇实体类型和关系进行规范化，推导出规范类型间的层次结构，并挖掘关系级别的领域与范围约束。其层次结构推导过程利用语料库衍生的关系参数特征优先排序类型，并通过本地LLM仲裁的父子关系检查进行放置，允许新插入类型触发已有父子链接的重新分配。由此产生的层次结构约束实体去重，并支持关系级别领域/范围约束的推导。在内部评估中，我们引入基于参考的协议，将推导出的本体类型分类为与参考领域/范围类完全一致、更广、更窄或无关。在Text2KGBench的Wikidata-TekGen和DBpedia-WebNLG子集上，超过90%的AutoOntic推导终点类型在语义上与参考类对齐，其中约一半完全匹配，其余差异主要涉及粒度。在MINE数据集上，使用AutoOntic构建的本体组织的知识图谱达到88%的检索准确率。AutoOntic已开源：https://github.com/screemix/AutoOntic。

summary: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. On ESCI and Amazon C4, SimRec improves the NDCG@100 of a Qwen3-4B agent from 32.23% to 35.42% and from 22.94% to 24.72%}, outperforming training-free agents on far larger backbones and task-aligned baselines on NDCG. Analysis shows that the trained agent verifies candidates, uses preferences, and recovers from rejected recommendations far more often than its untrained counterpart. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec .
title: SimRec: Learning to Search, Ask, and Recommend from Simulated Interaction

title_translated: SimRec：从模拟交互中学习搜索、提问与推荐
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的推荐智能体能够搜索商品目录、检查产品、向用户提问并修正被拒绝的推荐。然而，这些行为通常由人工设计的工作流程控制，而现有的训练方法仅优化查询重写或列表排序等孤立组件，而非整体的交互策略。我们提出SimRec，一种强化学习框架，用于训练工具集成推荐智能体的完整交互策略。SimRec引入两个核心组件：任务锚定的用户模拟器，根据当前任务需求而非用户画像提供反馈，可为外部大模型或推荐系统自身在自对弈模式下运行；任务对齐的奖励机制结合GRPO算法，对整个交互轨迹进行优化，不仅奖励最终命中结果，还奖励自然检索质量与有效工具使用，并通过仅在训练阶段注入目标来应对大规模目录中的稀疏命中问题。在ESCI和Amazon C4数据集上，SimRec将Qwen3-4B智能体的NDCG@100从32.23%提升至35.42%，从22.94%提升至24.72%，优于无需训练的大型基线模型以及任务对齐的基准模型。分析表明，训练后的智能体比未训练版本更频繁地验证候选项、利用用户偏好并从被拒绝的推荐中恢复。代码已开源：https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/SimRec。

summary: Arabic cryptocurrency discourse on social media is communicatively heterogeneous: a single post may report prices, explain protocols, promote investment, warn of scams, or invoke Islamic jurisprudence. Yet no annotated resource captures this functional diversity. We introduce AraCrypto-ML, a 10,000-post multi-label corpus of Arabic Facebook cryptocurrency discourse (2014-2024) from 2,898 public pages using a set of related keywords. Collected posts are annotated into six categories: Market Commentary, Educational, Promotional, Skeptical-Warning, Religious Framing, and Other/Unclear, using Fanar-2-27B under a prompt-only multi-label protocol. We validate 1,000 posts against adjudicated gold labels (macro kappa = 0.74) and apply Rogan-Gladen calibration to correct labelling bias. The two annotators agree with each other at macro kappa = 0.62 before adjudication, below the model's agreement with either of them (0.70 and 0.69). Reaction profiles differ strongly by function: Love is about 70% of reactions per post on Educational and Promotional posts but about 33% on Skeptical-Warning, which draws the largest Haha share (about 39%).
title: AraCrypto-ML: A Multi-Label Corpus of Communicative Functions in Arabic Facebook Cryptocurrency Discourse
title_translated: AraCrypto-ML：阿拉伯语Facebook加密货币话语中交际功能的多标签语料库
summary_translated: 社交媒体上的阿拉伯语加密货币讨论具有高度的交际多样性：一条帖子可能同时报告价格、解释协议、推广投资、警告诈骗或引用伊斯兰法理。然而，目前尚无标注资源能捕捉这种功能多样性。我们提出了AraCrypto-ML，一个包含10,000条来自2,898个公开页面的阿拉伯语Facebook加密货币讨论的多标签语料库（2014–2024年），基于一组相关关键词收集。所选帖子被标注为六大类别：市场评论、教育性内容、推广性内容、怀疑性警告、宗教框架和其他/不明确内容，采用Fanar-2-27B模型在仅提示的多标签标注协议下完成。我们对1,000条帖子进行了金标验证（宏平均Kappa=0.74），并使用Rogan-Gladen校准方法纠正标注偏差。两名标注者之间的宏观Kappa值为0.62（未仲裁前），低于模型与任一标注者的共识（分别为0.70和0.69）。不同功能内容的反应特征差异显著：教育性和推广性内容每帖约70%的反应为“喜欢”，而怀疑性警告类内容中“喜欢”占比约为33%，但“哈哈”反应占比最高，达约39%。

summary: In the legal domain, LLMs can improve reliability and interpretability by generating explicit reasoning traces. However, training LLMs to produce high-quality reasoning traces remains challenging. Existing supervised fine-tuning methods struggle when reasoning traces are significantly longer than final answers, as the learning signal for the answer becomes diluted. Meanwhile, reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization also have several limitations, including costly reward design, performance plateaus, and reward hacking. We therefore propose a two-stage training framework. In Stage I, JurisCoT-SFT employs a length-normalized dual objective to balance learning signals between reasoning traces and final answers. In Stage II, Lifecycle-Aware Backtrackable Policy Optimization dynamically evaluates and retires auxiliary reward signals based on their impact on final evaluation objectives, enabling efficient reward utilization. Our framework substantially improves legal reasoning performance on relevant tasks selected from multiple legal benchmarks, including ChJGBench, LawBench, and LegalBench. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in both reasoning trace quality and final answer accuracy, while our models remain competitive with larger models.
title: Towards Better Legal Reasoning LLMs: Signal Balancing and Reward Scheduling

title_translated: 迈向更好的法律推理大模型：信号平衡与奖励调度
summary_translated: 在法律领域，大语言模型可通过生成显式的推理链条来提升可靠性与可解释性。然而，训练模型生成高质量推理链条仍具挑战性。现有监督微调方法在推理链条远长于最终答案时面临学习信号稀释的问题。而强化学习方法如组相对策略优化（GRPO）也存在诸多局限，包括奖励设计成本高、性能停滞及奖励滥用等问题。为此，我们提出两阶段训练框架。第一阶段，JurisCoT-SFT采用长度归一化的双目标策略，平衡推理链条与最终答案的学习信号。第二阶段，生命周期感知的可回溯策略优化（Lifecycle-Aware Backtrackable Policy Optimization）动态评估并淘汰对最终评估目标影响较小的辅助奖励信号，实现奖励的高效利用。该框架在多个法律基准测试任务（包括ChJGBench、LawBench和LegalBench）上显著提升了法律推理性能。实验结果表明，推理链条质量与最终答案准确率均持续提升，且模型表现仍可与更大规模模型竞争。

summary: Multi-domain capabilities are critical for practically applicable Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). Therefore, Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) has become a crucial part of the post-training process, integrating the capabilities of multiple domain-specific teacher models into a single student model. However, the student usually fails to acquire multi-domain capabilities simultaneously due to undesirable domain heterogeneity. Existing works have address this problem in view of temporal uneven efficiency and spatial hard allocation in external multi-teacher supervision. While in broader multi-domain training, varying degrees of performance degradation is still largely unexplained. In this paper, we shift the focus on how the student learns and integrates multi-domain capabilities internally, and then propose \textbf{\textsc{Janus-MOPD}}, a general learning dynamics framework of geometric representations for LRMs. Specifically, our main focus is on the internal performance of multi-domain capabilities on both temporal and spatial dimensions within the student. Temporally, our study shows that the student exhibits a Expansion-Consolidation-Optimization (ECO) three-phase learning dynamics, together with inherent limitations in learning efficiency and scaling. Spatially, we summarize two types of subspace locking within and across domains by tracing the representation space of the student, while explaining its clear learning directions but inherent cross-domain conflict. Therefore, \textsc{Janus-MOPD} yields a unified learning dynamics formulation, a geometric tracing methodology, and systematic findings of how the student learns and integrates multi-domain capabilities. Overall, we provide a \textsc{Janus} perspective to internally trace the continual evolution of the multi-domain capabilities within the model itself.
title: Janus-MOPD: Tracing the Student Learning Dynamics in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

title_translated: Janus-MOPD：多教师在线蒸馏中学生学习动态的追踪
summary_translated: 多领域能力对于实际可用的大推理模型至关重要。因此，多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）已成为后训练过程中的关键环节，旨在将多个领域专用教师模型的能力整合到单一学生模型中。然而，由于领域异质性带来的不利影响，学生模型往往无法同时习得多领域能力。现有研究主要关注外部多教师监督中的时间效率不均与空间硬分配问题。而在更广泛的多领域训练中，性能退化程度各异的现象仍缺乏充分解释。本文聚焦于学生模型内部如何学习与整合多领域能力，提出	extbf{	extsc{Janus-MOPD}}——一种面向大推理模型的几何表示学习动态框架。具体而言，我们从时间和空间两个维度考察学生模型的内部性能表现。时间上，研究发现学生模型呈现出‘扩展-巩固-优化’（ECO）三阶段学习动态，且存在学习效率与可扩展性的内在限制；空间上，通过追踪学生模型的表示空间，总结出域内与域间两种子空间锁定现象，揭示了清晰的学习方向但存在固有的跨域冲突。因此，	extsc{Janus-MOPD} 提供了统一的学习动态建模、几何追踪方法以及关于学生如何学习与融合多领域能力的系统性发现。总体而言，我们为模型内部多领域能力的持续演化提供了	extsc{Janus}视角的洞察。

summary: Small open models suit private customer-service deployments but trail frontier models in two ways: they miss what the written policy requires in a given situation, and they act inconsistently on what they know. We study whether such a model can close both gaps from its own deployment logs and their reference outcomes, without a stronger teacher model. Our starting point is a Gemma 4 12B agent that reads its domain policy from on-demand skills rather than from its system prompt. In each round, the deployed system serves a fresh batch of tasks; the base model diagnoses failed conversations and writes rules into the skills, and a rule survives only if it passes code checks, counterexample self-review, a paired retest, and a noise-calibrated validation gate. Reinforcement learning (GRPO) then trains a LoRA adapter on complete multi-turn, tool-using conversations. On the retail and airline domains of $τ^2$-bench, without training or selecting on official tasks, the agent after two rounds improves on this starting point by 12.5 pass$^1$ points in retail and 19.5 in airline, and by 18.4 and 22.0 pass$^4$ points. It also exceeds the benchmark's reference agent, which runs the same model with the whole policy in its system prompt, by 11.8 and 8.0 pass$^1$ points and by 22.8 and 16.0 pass$^4$ points, closing most of the gap to three frontier models under the same protocol. A $2\times2$ ablation shows that the rules rescue tasks the agent never solved and carry policy knowledge that RL with the rules in context does not internalize, whereas the trained weights make solved tasks reliable.
title: Knowledge in the Harness, Reliability in the Weights: Teacher-Free Co-Evolution of an LLM Agent

title_translated: 知识在驾驭中，可靠在于权重：无需教师的LLM智能体共进化
summary_translated: 小型开放模型适用于私有客户服务部署，但在两个方面落后于前沿模型：一是无法理解特定情境下的书面政策要求，二是对其已知信息的执行不一致。我们研究该模型是否能仅通过自身的部署日志及其参考结果，在没有更强教师模型的前提下，同时弥合这两项差距。我们的起点是一个Gemma 4 12B智能体，它从按需调用的技能中读取领域政策，而非系统提示中预设。在每轮中，部署系统处理一批新任务；基础模型诊断失败对话，并将规则写入技能库；只有通过代码检查、反例自审、配对重测以及噪声校准验证门控的规则才能留存。随后，强化学习（GRPO）在完整的多轮、工具使用对话上训练LoRA适配器。在$τ^2$-bench的零售与航空领域，无需在官方任务上进行训练或选择，经过两轮迭代后，该智能体在零售领域提升12.5 pass$^1$分，在航空领域提升19.5分；在pass$^4$指标上分别提升18.4和22.0分。其表现还超越了基准参考智能体（该智能体将完整政策置于系统提示中运行相同模型），在零售和航空领域分别领先11.8和8.0 pass$^1$分，以及22.8和16.0 pass$^4$分，基本缩小了与三个前沿模型在相同协议下的差距。2×2消融实验表明，规则挽救了智能体从未解决的任务，并携带了RL在上下文中无法内化的政策知识；而训练后的权重则使已解决任务更加可靠。

summary: One way to study language-model introspection is to test whether models can identify where their activations have been perturbed. We train a simple linear classifier to identify the perturbed sentence from the model's activations, then compare its predictions with the model's own answers across pretraining and injection strengths. This tests whether the model is being asked to report information that is already easy to recover. If so, successful localization may be less demanding than it first appears and may not extend to the broader uses that motivate introspection research, such as faithfully explaining a model's reasoning or helping researchers assess the reliability of its answers. With an injection four times the typical activation norm at layer 0 and probe readout at layer 24 in OLMo~3 32B, the supervised probe reaches 98.3\% accuracy after 8.4 billion training tokens, while the model's zero-shot answer remains at chance (11.1\%). At the released base checkpoint, these accuracies reach 99.1\% and 89.6\%, respectively. Across 7B and 32B, location is already decodable in randomly initialized networks, showing that the architecture can support these traces without pretraining. In these experiments, location information lies close enough to the surface for a simple linear probe to recover it, so successful reporting need not imply broader access to the model's internal computation.
title: A Closer Look at Language Model Introspection: Probing Information and Reporting
title_translated: 对语言模型内省的深入考察：探测信息与报告
summary_translated: 研究语言模型内省的一种方法是测试模型能否识别其激活值被扰动的位置。我们训练了一个简单的线性分类器，从模型的激活值中识别出被扰动的句子，并将其预测结果与模型自身的回答进行比较，涵盖预训练和注入强度的变化。这检验了模型是否被要求报告那些已易于恢复的信息。如果是这样，成功定位可能比最初看起来更简单，且未必能扩展到内省研究所驱动的更广泛用途，例如忠实解释模型推理过程或帮助研究人员评估其答案的可靠性。在OLMo~3 32B模型中，层0的注入强度为典型激活范数的四倍，探针读出位于层24时，监督探针在84亿训练标记后达到98.3%的准确率，而模型的零样本回答仍处于随机水平（11.1%）。在发布的基础检查点上，这些准确率分别达到99.1%和89.6%。在7B和32B模型中，位置信息在随机初始化网络中即可解码，表明架构本身就能支持这些痕迹而无需预训练。在这些实验中，位置信息足够接近表面，使得简单的线性探针即可恢复，因此成功的报告并不意味着模型具备对其内部计算的广泛访问能力。

summary: Stack Overflow banned answers generated by ChatGPT five days after the model's release, and many other Stack Exchange sites announced similar rules. I measure the vocabulary of the answers posted afterwards, 3.8 million answers on 170 sites from 2019 to 2024. A fixed list of 56 words that language models overuse rose about 14 percent above its pre-2023 trend, while the highest of 1,000 frequency-matched lists of ordinary words rose about 7 percent. In a screen of 15 site traits measured before the release, the strongest predictor of where the rise happened was the share of answers that received a body edit within 30 days of posting. On the least edited third of sites the list rose about 29 percent relative to matched controls, and on the most edited third it did not change. The gradient is also present among answers that were never edited. It follows the share of answers edited by their own authors, and the share edited by others adds little once that share is held fixed. Use of the model is unobserved, so these results cannot separate lower use on sites with a high self-edit share from any effect of editing on what the vocabulary records. Any vocabulary-based estimate for the network as a whole therefore pools sites where the marker vocabulary rose sharply with sites where it did not change.
title: Where Language-Model Vocabulary Rose on Stack Exchange

title_translated: 语言模型词汇在Stack Exchange上的兴起
summary_translated: Stack Overflow在模型发布五天后禁止使用ChatGPT生成的答案，许多其他Stack Exchange站点也宣布了类似规则。我测量了此后发布的答案的词汇量，涵盖2019至2024年间170个站点的380万条答案。一个固定列表中的56个语言模型过度使用的词语相比2023年前的趋势上升约14%，而1000个频率匹配的普通词语最高上升约7%。在对15个发布前测量的站点特征进行筛选后，最能预测词汇上升位置的因素是发布后30天内收到正文编辑的答案比例。在编辑最少的三分之一站点中，该列表上升约29%，而在编辑最多的三分之一站点中则无明显变化。这一趋势在从未被编辑过的答案中同样存在，其变化趋势与作者自编辑的比例一致，而他人编辑的比例在控制作者自编辑比例后贡献甚微。由于模型使用情况未被观测，这些结果无法区分高自编辑比例站点上模型使用较少的影响，或编辑行为对词汇记录的影响。因此，任何基于词汇的全网估计都会混合那些标记词汇显著上升的站点与词汇未发生变化的站点。

summary: LLM workloads sometimes ask many independent questions about the same long document, as in document QA, data labeling and LLM-based evaluation. Prefix caching removes the redundant prefill shared by these queries, but each decode step still reads the document's key-value (KV) cache once per question, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and scales with the number of questions. We present Parallel Prompting, which decodes P questions as P independent streams of a single request all at once, fixing this issue. In our method, every step reads the shared document once for all P streams, and a stream-id attention mask, evaluated inside the attention kernel, keeps each answer conditioned only on the document and its own question. We implement Parallel Prompting in SGLang by adding about 80 lines to three existing files and a small engine package; the mask needs no dense tensor, and every decode step has a fixed shape that is captured as a CUDA graph. With CodeLlama-7B, 8k-16k-token documents and 64-256 questions per document, Parallel Prompting is 3.7x faster than stock SGLang with its FlashInfer backend on an A100 and 5.9-6.0x faster on an RTX A6000, on two SGLang releases, including the most recent release. Timed on identical inputs, it is faster than stock SGLang in all 144 runs (2 GPUs x 2 releases x 6 workloads x 6 input sets). Code: https://github.com/jlab-nlp/parallel-prompting
title: Read Once, Answer Many: Parallel Prompting for Shared-Context LLM Inference
