title_translated: Metal Sandbox：适用于Apple Silicon上GPU编码智能体的隔离执行与命令调度
summary_translated: 设备端推理需要高效利用本地加速器的内核。高效训练和评估生成Apple Metal内核的模型，得益于原生macOS工具和并发智能体会话。这些会话在模型请求、开发命令和GPU执行之间交替，导致大部分时间GPU处于空闲状态。我们提出Metal Sandbox，一种结合实例级文件访问限制、原生命令执行和跨互联Mac的命令级调度的基础设施。每个智能体保持其工作区和私有开发环境。并行命令可并发运行，串行命令则每节点共享一个执行槽；符合条件的等待命令可迁移至可用Mac，并将结果返回原始智能体。与Harbor集成支持任务执行、自动验证和通过统一工作流的回放收集。在四台Mac mini M4节点上的受控实验显示，在集中需求下命令吞吐量提升1.68倍至2.05倍。十六个静态智能体轨迹估算表明，每节点四会话相比一会话，持续吞吐量提升2.14倍，假设会话持续补充且均值时长不变。在动态调度下重放测量轨迹，平均工具等待时间减少18.8%，批处理完成时间减少22.3%，假设各阶段时长不变。Metal Sandbox及其Harbor集成已在GitHub上开源。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.
title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight)
title_translated: 仅负样本策略优化：面向单边可验证奖励的强化学习
summary_translated: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常依赖于能够可靠判断采样解是否正确的验证器。然而，在许多现实场景中，完整验证通常不可用，而低成本检查只能否定失败。我们将此情形形式化为单边可验证性（OSV）：已验证的负例是可靠的反例，但已验证的正例仅为未被否定的候选，可能包含大量假阳性。这种不对称性使得标准RLVR不可靠，因为强化已验证正例可能直接奖励通过部分检查的捷径。为解决此问题，我们提出仅负样本策略优化（NOPO），将已验证正例视为未标记样本，仅通过抑制可信的已验证负例来更新策略。具体而言，NOPO结合参考相对的负例抑制损失与组级适配器，按未被否定响应的比例缩放每次更新。在单元测试、约束检查和LLM自验证器上，当真实奖励不可用时，NOPO在代码、逻辑和数学基准上均优于基线方法。这些优势在推理时缩放和跨基准迁移下依然保持。

summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of $λ=0.01$ lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least $16$ relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most $0.02$ in all but one model-rank comparison. Single-task and scheduling experiments further show that the balance between learning and retention depends on the configuration. We also observe that several LoRA variants in the literature also suffer from the identified capacity issue, and our approach provides a complementary axis of improvement to LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These results suggest that effective rank is not only a post-hoc diagnostic of adapter quality, but a trainable objective for improving the learning-forgetting frontier. Our code is available at https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization
title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
title_translated: 最大化LoRA适配器的容量利用率以缓解学习-遗忘权衡
summary_translated: 低秩适应（LoRA）在异构和持续学习场景中常表现不如全微调，尤其在出现显著遗忘的情况下。通常，它在不同微调设置中面临不利的学习-遗忘权衡。我们识别出一个潜在原因：LoRA适配器，尤其是高秩适配器，往往无法充分利用配置的秩所赋予的容量。具体而言，我们发现标准LoRA更新的有效秩远低于其配置秩，限制了更新能量的分布范围。因此，我们提出了一种训练机制，在优化原始目标的同时最大化适配器的有效秩。我们的主要方法是在语言建模损失中加入一个简单、稳定、可微且无需SVD的Rényi-2有效秩正则化项。我们还建立了容量最大化与范数有界更新之间的联系。在三个模型上进行多随机种子的混合域秩扫描实验中，惩罚权重λ=0.01在所有测试秩≥16的情况下均降低了平均Wiki困惑度；除一次模型-秩比较外，平均训练困惑度改善或最多增加0.02。单任务和调度实验进一步表明，学习与保留之间的平衡取决于配置。我们还观察到文献中的多个LoRA变体也存在此容量问题，而我们的方法为基于LoRA的参数高效微调提供了互补的改进维度。这些结果表明，有效秩不仅是适配器质量的后验诊断指标，更是一个可训练的目标，用于提升学习-遗忘边界。代码已公开于https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization

summary: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
title_translated: 演员、裁判还是教师？理解长时程智能体中的决策模型
summary_translated: 决策模型以类型化输出回答问题，例如在选项之间做出选择并给出每个选项的概率，因此一个模型可以决定智能体的行为、评估已采取的动作，或对所有动作进行评分以通过强化学习指导策略。以往研究主要将它们视为演员，并通过其行为表现来评估其有用性。我们探讨一个问题：一个表现不佳的决策模型是否仍能有效教学？我们在ALFWorld上比较了三种决策模型和三种通用大语言模型作为演员和裁判的表现，并使用JEV作为教师在ALFWorld和WebShop上进行实验。作为演员时，所有六种模型都会被更容易的任务吸引而偏离必须优先完成的子目标。作为观察完整轨迹的裁判，相同模型会认可朝向该子目标的步骤，并通过询问每一步是否有助于达成目标而非任务是否会成功，从而区分有用与无用动作。作为教师，JEV将Qwen2.5-1.5B策略在GRPO上的成功率从ALFWorld的72.8%提升至82.9%，WebShop从56.8%提升至71.4%。这些结果表明，即使一个表现差的演员仍可能具备良好的教学能力，因为任务结束后对动作的评判揭示了行动必须预判的后果。代码已公开于https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents。

summary: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
title: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables
title_translated: CapLite：无需模型编写安全构件的小型语言模型智能体提示注入防御
summary_translated: 针对提示注入的强制性防御方法（如CaMeL、Progent、IPIGuard和DRIFT）要求智能体自身的模型生成安全构件（程序、权限策略、依赖图或约束列表），然后由代码执行强制。我们质疑小型语言模型（SLM）智能体是否可信地生成这些构件。在15个开源权重模型中，13个参数介于1.7B至12B之间，结果显示它们不可信：智能体模型生成的策略、图谱和约束在14个（Progent）、13个（IPIGuard）和11个（DRIFT）模型中均允许攻击成功，而CaMeL的程序在高达68%的回合中无法运行。我们提出CapLite，其策略源自工具模式，承诺在读取任何工具结果前执行写入调用，并仅当决定影响对象或接收方的所有参数均明确出现在用户请求中时才允许写入。这保证了写入完整性：注入文本无法添加新写入操作，且任何写入都无法到达用户未声明的接收者、数量、对象或目的地。在13,935次受攻击的AgentDojo回合中，无一攻击成功。CapLite在攻击下的实用性与CaMeL相当（29.0% vs. 27.2%），但使用的token数少于其他所有强制性防御方法以及未防御的智能体：每回合仅17.1k token，仅为CaMeL的18%，且是所有强制性防御中单位token实用率最高的。

summary: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).
title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
comment: 6 pages, 1 reference page, 5 figures
title_translated: LazyWeights：按需解码的边缘大语言模型
summary_translated: 内存决定了边缘设备运行哪些大语言模型及其速度：在4GB Jetson Nano上受限于容量，在8GB Jetson Orin Nano Super上受限于带宽。现有部署格式（GPTQ、AWQ、llama.cpp的K-和I-量化）对矩阵中的每个整数编码分配相等比特，尽管这些编码分布极不均匀。LazyWeights保留这些格式，但调整GPTQ使编码可压缩，采用霍夫曼编码在交错通道中无损压缩，并在DRAM与L2之间的小型单元中按需解码，从而使GPU内核保持不变，且DRAM仅传输编码字节。在1%和3.5%困惑度预算下，编码后的Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B和SmolLM-1.7B比最佳的llama.cpp格式小5.7%-31.4%。一个比特精确的0.21 mm² ASIC解码单元（1 GHz，7 nm）可将Orin的延迟和每token能耗降低最多36%和38%（使用提示查找推测时分别降低54%和44%）。在Nano上，LazyWeights比CPU上的llama.cpp节省58%-64%的时间和53%-57%的能量，且在3.89 bit/weight下以6.6倍速度流式运行Mistral-7B。霍夫曼解码器在同等吞吐量下速率和面积表现优于rANS解码器；ASIC解码单元可在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA（AMD ZCU102）上实现比特精确运行。

summary: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.
title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
title_translated: LoRA领域自适应中的推理监督与能力保留
summary_translated: 在金融数据上微调基础模型具有广泛的应用，包括从新闻中识别事件类型、监控风险与合规语言，以及回答文件和财报电话会议中的问题。在此场景中，主要挑战是在不损害模型泛化能力的前提下提升任务性能。本文针对Qwen3-8B进行了广泛的消融实验，采用低秩适应（LoRA）进行微调。我们比较了三种训练方案：(1) 仅响应LoRA，其中监督响应仅为标签本身；(2) 单适配器推理，将教师模型生成的推理轨迹与标签一同纳入训练损失；(3) 双适配器复合训练，分别对轨迹和标签训练独立的LoRA适配器。仅响应LoRA提升了域内性能，同时保持通用能力接近冻结模型水平。域内变化最大的是校准和argmax准确率。在单适配器推理下，域内指标仍落后于仅响应方案，而MMLU-Pro略有上升，其他保留基准维持在正常波动范围内。双适配器复合训练与此类似，未带来进一步增益。最后，我们通过在训练前对教师轨迹进行摘要压缩，发现较短的摘要使校准向仅响应方案靠拢，但未完全达到。

summary: Watermark detectors decide whether one document came from a watermarked language model. Auditors often need a different number: the share of a corpus that did. We study this share for Gumbel-max and green-list (KGW) watermarks when every document may have been edited by an unknown amount. Without restrictions on the edits, the upper end of the identified set is 1. Combining a known least-favourable next-token distribution with a sequential coupling, we derive a power envelope indexed by three budgets: a retention floor, an entropy budget, and a budget for in-place substitutions, which for Gumbel-max make edited positions look less watermarked than human text. The envelope gives an identified set that is sharp for the alternatives it dominates, finite-sample bounds on the realized share of a fixed corpus with either the exact null or a null calibrated on an independent human sample, and confidence sequences for streams. In Gumbel-max simulations where the envelope binds, the bounds cover, and the threshold that maximizes the gap between envelope and null is generally as tight as twelve thresholds. On text from OPT-1.3B and Qwen3-1.7B, 12,000 fresh human documents scored under three keys show no robust departure from the exact null, and all bounds covered in resampling trials from finite pools of documents with random edits, substitutions and paraphrases; at a share of 0.2 the exact-null bound is about [0.14,0.38]. These results are fragile in two ways we make precise. LLM-paraphrased KGW pools fall below the envelope, yet at 2000 documents the bounds still covered in these trials. A simulated null error of 0.01, comparable to the largest deviation we observed at our thresholds, is likewise harmless at 2000 documents but breaks exact-null coverage at 100,000; a null calibrated on an independent human sample keeps coverage there, but needs a large reference sample to stay narrow.
title: Prevalence Bounds for Edited Watermarked Text: Power Envelopes and Calibration Sensitivity
comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code and results: this https URL
title_translated: 编辑水印文本的普遍性界限：功率包络与校准敏感性
summary_translated: 水印检测器判断某文档是否来自带有水印的语言模型。审计人员通常需要的是：一个语料库中有多大比例的文档是经过水印处理的。我们研究了在每篇文档可能被未知程度编辑的情况下，Gumbel-max和绿色列表（KGW）水印的这一比例。在无编辑限制时，识别集合的上限为1。结合已知的最不利下一个词分布与序列耦合，我们推导出一个由三个预算参数决定的功率包络：保留下限、熵预算以及原位替换预算；对于Gumbel-max而言，这些编辑位置看起来比人类文本更不具有水印特征。该包络给出了对所主导替代方案具有紧致性的识别集合，对固定语料库实际占比的有限样本边界（基于精确零假设或独立人类样本校准的零假设），以及对数据流的置信序列。在Gumbel-max模拟中，当包络起作用时，边界覆盖良好，且使包络与零假设之间差距最大的阈值通常与十二个阈值相当。在OPT-1.3B和Qwen3-1.7B生成的文本上，12,000条新的人类文档在三个密钥下评分均未显示出对精确零假设的稳健偏离；在包含随机编辑、替换和改写的小规模文档池重采样试验中，所有边界均被覆盖；在占比为0.2时，精确零假设边界约为[0.14, 0.38]。这些结果在两种方式上表现出脆弱性，我们进行了精确分析。LLM改写的KGW语料库低于包络线，但在2000条文档时边界仍能覆盖；模拟零假设误差为0.01（与我们在阈值处观察到的最大偏差相当）在2000条文档时仍无害，但在10万条文档时会破坏精确零假设的覆盖性；而基于独立人类样本校准的零假设在此情况下仍能保持覆盖，但需要大量参考样本以维持边界狭窄。

summary: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably. We propose a codebook-based watermarking scheme that maps an $n$-bit payload to a longer $u$-bit codeword and embeds it during generation through token-level logit biasing. During extraction, the received bit sequence is matched to the nearest codeword in a precomputed secret codebook using Hamming or Levenshtein distance. Experiments show that our method achieves near-perfect recovery for 16-24 bit payloads on 200-token generations and strong performance on 127-token generations for base models. Results are weaker on some instruction-tuned models with very short texts, where low-entropy output distributions reduce embedding reliability. We also study a BCH-based variant that avoids codebook storage but generally reduces robustness. The Levenshtein variant improves resilience to deletions and light paraphrasing, while insertions and stronger rewrites remain challenging. We analyze collision probability, codeword separation, extraction time, tokenization consistency, and text quality, highlighting both the practicality and limitations of codebook-based watermarking for short-form attribution.
title: Look It Up: Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Codebook Search
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 查找它：通过码本搜索实现多比特大语言模型水印
summary_translated: 现有多种比特水印方法在将短文本归因于特定来源方面仍具挑战性，通常需要长生成序列或高成本解码才能可靠恢复信息。我们提出一种基于码本的水印方案，将n比特的有效载荷映射为更长的u比特码字，并通过逐标记的logit偏置嵌入生成过程。在提取阶段，接收到的比特序列通过汉明距离或莱文施泰因距离与预先计算的秘密码本中的最近码字匹配。实验表明，我们的方法在200-token生成中对16-24比特有效载荷实现了近乎完美的恢复，在基础模型上对127-token生成也表现出强劲性能。但在某些指令微调模型的极短文本上表现较弱，因为低熵输出分布降低了嵌入可靠性。我们还研究了一种基于BCH的变体，避免了码本存储，但通常降低了鲁棒性。莱文施泰因变体增强了对删除和轻度改写的抗性，而插入和强重写仍具挑战。我们分析了碰撞概率、码字分离度、提取时间、分词一致性及文本质量，突显了基于码本水印在短文本溯源中的实用性和局限性。

summary: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share of tokens just before the onset that it flags, largely by flagging degenerate responses long before the onset, and no untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms. We release the probes with calibrated thresholds at https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes
title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science. 30 pages (10 main text), 6 figures, 16 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 检测并非早期预警：评估语言模型失败中的令牌级警报
summary_translated: 许多语言模型的失败始于某个特定令牌，即“起始点”。监控器在生成过程中读取模型，可对完成的响应进行分类，检测失败的发生，或在失败开始前发出预警；只有预警能提供时间来终止或引导生成。目前监控器通常使用响应级指标（如AUROC）进行评估，忽略了警报触发的时间点。我们引入PREWARN评估协议，适用于任何具有标注起始点的失败场景。该协议在验证数据上校准每个监控器的阈值至应用所需的错误率，运行监控器，并根据起始点对三种任务（分类、检测、预警）的警报进行评分。作为案例研究，我们将该方法应用于三个开源语言模型中的重复退化问题，以早期预警为主要任务，使用激活值上的线性探测器和六个未经训练的基线。响应级指标在此失败上趋于饱和，仅依赖响应长度的规则几乎完美得分，而AUROC排名相近的探测器在PREWARN下预警行为差异显著。探测器在其中两个模型的多数退化响应中于起始点之前发出预警；低秩适配器在探测器之下使起始点前仅几个令牌被标记的比例翻倍，主要通过在起始点前很久就标记退化响应；所有未经训练的基线发出的预警频率远低于随机警报。我们已在Hugging Face发布校准阈值的探测器集合：https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes

summary: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than $a/(1-a)$ times as often as correct ones, where $a$ is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. The expert label, a prestige cue, adds reversals for four of the five models, yet its effect on accuracy ranges from a 5.2-point loss to a 2.4-point gain, so reversal counts are a poor proxy for harm. With identical arguments from both sources, the label still raises reversal for three proprietary models and in a pooled analysis of four newer models. Models also respond to stated source reliability. Revision pipelines should therefore be evaluated with paired, conditional metrics, per model and protocol.
title: When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages, 7 figures, 36 tables. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 专家分歧何时有害？大语言模型决策修订中的声望与选择性
summary_translated: 当语言模型在另一代理不同意后修订其决策时，反转次数和最终准确率无法判断其是在修正错误还是放弃了正确答案。我们引入一种受控的双阶段审计，固定问题、证据和模型初始答案，仅改变修订上下文：中立反思、匿名分歧或归因于领域专家的分歧。对于二元决策，计算是精确的：只有当修订具有足够选择性时，准确率才会提升——即反转错误答案的频率需超过正确答案的a/(1-a)倍，其中a为初始准确率（在90%准确率时为九倍）。在医学、科学和法律领域的五种模型共1,989个基于证据的决策中，没有任何模型在专家分歧下达到此标准，准确率下降最多达16.1个百分点。专家标签作为一种声望线索，使四种模型增加了反转次数，但其对准确率的影响范围从5.2个百分点的损失到2.4个百分点的增益，因此反转次数是伤害的不良代理。即使双方论据相同，标签仍使三种专有模型的反转增加，在四个较新模型的合并分析中亦然。模型也对声明的来源可靠性作出反应。因此，修订管道应采用成对的条件指标，按模型和协议分别评估。

summary: Social scene datasets label people at two levels: what each person is doing and what the group is there for. Training on both levels at once is often assumed to help each of them. We test this assumption for vision-language models (VLMs) on JRDB-Social, treating person actions as the details and group intent as the whole. We fine-tune Qwen3.5 4B under eight training arms with three seeds, repeat the core arms on Qwen3.5 9B and Qwen3-VL 4B, and judge every arm with a verdict rule fixed before testing. Writing each member's actions before the intent raises intent macro-F1 from 30.1 to 31.0, and writing the intent first reaches 31.2, while action F1 stays within 0.2 points of an action-only model. Under the selected recipe, no arm trained with intent improves actions. The gain requires correct, image-grounded actions: empty action lists or actions borrowed from another group with the same intent lower intent F1. Forced-prefix tests, occlusion, member masking, linear probes and component grafting show that the intent follows the written actions, relies more on people and partly resides in the vision tower. Supplying actions as input instead of as targets hurts both levels.
title: Do the Details Help the Whole? One-Way Transfer from Person Actions to Group Intent in VLMs on JRDB-Social
title_translated: 细节有助于整体吗？从个体行为到群体意图的一向迁移在JRDB-Social上的视觉语言模型研究
summary_translated: 社交场景数据集在两个层次上标注人物：每个人在做什么，以及整个群体的目的。通常假设同时训练这两个层次会对两者都有帮助。我们针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）在JRDB-Social数据集上检验了这一假设，将个体行为视为细节，群体意图视为整体。我们在Qwen3.5 4B上进行八种训练策略的微调，每种策略使用三个种子，核心策略在Qwen3.5 9B和Qwen3-VL 4B上重复测试，并在测试前使用固定的裁决规则评估每种策略。先写出每个成员的行为再写意图，使意图的宏F1从30.1提升至31.0，而先写意图则达到31.2，同时行为F1与仅训练行为的模型相比波动不超过0.2分。在选定的训练方案下，任何包含意图训练的策略均未改善行为表现。意图性能的提升依赖于正确的、图像相关的个体行为：空的行为列表或借用其他具有相同意图群体的行为会降低意图F1。强制前缀测试、遮挡、成员掩码、线性探测和组件嫁接显示，意图跟随书写的行为，更依赖于人物信息，并部分存在于视觉塔中。将行为作为输入而非目标提供反而损害了两个层次的表现。

summary: LLMs have quickly evolved from models used in isolation to agentic systems that delegate tasks to external tools and other LLMs to solve complex assignments. This agentic augmentation has led to impressive capability gains. However, when and how delegation improves performance remains poorly understood. For example, it is unclear whether delegation helps when tasks involve post-cutoff information that the orchestrating LLM cannot reliably resolve from its own knowledge. In this work, we use purpose-built datasets with pre- and post-cutoff splits to compare various delegation modes. We find that delegation provides no consistent accuracy improvement over non-delegated setups, with effects varying across models and tasks. When tasks involve knowledge unavailable to the orchestrator, delegation can substantially degrade accuracy, while direct tool use with the same LLM performs much better. Our analysis identifies distorted delegated queries, inefficient tool use, and failures to preserve and use information between agents as recurring failure modes. These findings suggest that effective orchestration requires both well-calibrated delegation decisions and effective exchange of information between agents.
title: Lost in Delegation: Studying the Effectiveness of Task Orchestration in Generative Search
title_translated: 委托中的迷失：研究生成式搜索中任务编排的有效性
summary_translated: 大语言模型已从独立使用的模型演变为能够将任务委派给外部工具或其他大语言模型以解决复杂任务的智能体系统。这种智能体增强带来了显著的能力提升。然而，委托何时以及如何提升性能仍不明确。例如，当任务涉及委托模型无法可靠从自身知识中解决的截止后信息时，委托是否有效尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们使用专门构建的、包含截止前和截止后划分的数据集，比较了多种委托模式。结果发现，与非委托设置相比，委托并未带来一致的准确率提升，其效果在不同模型和任务间存在差异。当任务涉及委托模型无法获取的知识时，委托可能导致准确率大幅下降，而直接使用相同模型的工具表现更好。我们的分析识别出扭曲的委托查询、低效的工具使用以及代理间信息保存与利用失败是反复出现的故障模式。这些发现表明，有效的编排需要经过良好校准的委托决策以及代理间高效的信息交换。

summary: Planning agents and benchmarks treat a user's initial specification as fixed. Yet the requests users write exclude plans they would gladly take, since they rarely discover the possible trade-offs they would accept until seeing the options. Agents already revise requests through interaction, but whether this helps planning is unknown. We formalize this step as the ReSHAPE task, which judges a revision by whether its search space matches the acceptable plans and a planner finds one there. Using ReSHAPE Planter, which builds instances from planning benchmarks with a human-validated simulated user, we analyze 5,800 agent-revised specifications in travel and shopping. We find that reshaping matters: one correct trade-off makes the same planner reach an acceptable plan up to 4.6x as often, and search space quality predicts what the planner finds. Current agents, however, admit at most 32% of the acceptable plans, where that trade-off alone admits over 52%, because they ask about preferences instead of showing plans; in travel, showing plans raises F1 by 9.7 points over asking, with two model families. Planning agents should thus treat a request as a hypothesis to test against the user's reactions to concrete plans to recognize user trade-offs.
title: How Should Planning Agents ReSHAPE Their Search Space?
title_translated: 规划智能体应如何重塑其搜索空间？
summary_translated: 规划智能体和基准测试通常将用户的初始需求视为固定不变。然而，用户撰写的请求往往排除了他们实际上愿意接受的计划，因为他们在看到选项之前很少意识到自己愿意接受的权衡。智能体虽可通过交互修订请求，但这种修订是否有助于规划仍未知。我们将这一过程形式化为ReSHAPE任务，该任务通过判断修订后的搜索空间是否包含可接受的计划，并且规划器能否在其中找到一个来评估修订效果。我们使用ReSHAPE Planter（基于人类验证的模拟用户构建实例的规划基准）分析了旅行和购物场景中的5800个智能体修订的需求。结果表明，重塑搜索空间至关重要：仅一个正确的权衡就能使同一规划器找到可接受计划的概率提高最多4.6倍，且搜索空间质量能预测规划器最终找到的结果。然而，当前智能体最多只能涵盖52%以上的可接受计划，而它们仅能接纳其中32%，原因是它们询问偏好而非展示计划；在旅行场景中，展示计划比询问偏好将F1得分提高9.7分，两种模型家族均如此。因此，规划智能体应将请求视为一个待验证的假设，通过用户对具体计划的反应来识别其真实权衡。

summary: We describe the RMIT-ADM+S team's participation in the TREC 2026 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) track using the ClimbMix corpus. We submitted seven research-agent runs using proprietary OpenAI and open-weight models, exploring different retrieval strategies, writer models, and agent workflows. Pre-submission ablations identified writer selection and adjacent-chunk expansion as the main factors affecting answer quality. In the official NIST evaluation, six of seven runs exceeded the track median across all three rubric/nugget collections. Our best-performing run, brief-hybrid, achieved the highest all-item coverage among our submissions and tied the track maximum (0.892) for Batch-1 vital coverage. Human side-by-side preferences differed across evaluation batches: the open-weight owa-glm5 led Batch 1 despite lower automated coverage, while sol-research-first led Batch 2. These findings highlight differences between automated coverage measures and human preferences, as well as the potential of lower-cost open-weight models for research-agent systems.
title: RMIT-ADM+S at TREC RAG 2026: Research Agents, Retriever Ablations, and Open-Weight Replication
title_translated: RMIT-ADM+S 参与 TREC RAG 2026：研究智能体、检索消融实验与开放权重复现
summary_translated: 我们描述了RMIT-ADM+S团队在TREC 2026检索增强生成（RAG）赛道中使用ClimbMix语料库的参与情况。我们提交了七次研究智能体运行，使用专有的OpenAI模型和开源权重模型，探索不同的检索策略、写作者模型和智能体工作流。提交前的消融实验表明，写作者选择和相邻块扩展是影响答案质量的主要因素。在NIST官方评估中，七次运行中有六次在所有三个评分/要点集合中超过赛道中位数。我们表现最佳的运行（brief-hybrid）在所有提交中实现了最高的全项覆盖率，并在Batch-1关键覆盖率上达到0.892，与赛道最高分持平。人工对比评估显示，不同评估批次的偏好存在差异：尽管自动化覆盖率较低，但开源权重模型owa-glm5在Batch-1中更受青睐；而在Batch-2中，sol-research-first更受欢迎。这些发现突显了自动化覆盖率指标与人类偏好之间的差异，也展示了低成本开源权重模型在研究智能体系统中的潜力。

summary: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.
title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
title_translated: 用于递归自我改进的经验交接强化学习
summary_translated: 通常使用标量奖励进行强化学习（RL）来训练大语言模型（LLMs）执行智能体任务。然而，这种方法会丢弃智能体在试运行过程中所经历的环境细节信息（如错误日志）。为了利用这些丰富的信息，近期工作通过封装框架，让智能体通过反思或压缩来优化自身输入，并将过往经验传递给未来的运行，但传递的成果（如操作手册）本身并未被学习。我们希望兼得两者优势：既保留标量奖励带来的梯度更新，又能利用环境信息实现经验的传递。作为具体测试平台，我们固定了Agentic Context Engineering（ACE）框架，并训练一个模型同时承担行动、反思和任务局部手册维护的角色。我们的方法	exttt{ACERL}通过评估候选经验交接成果对未来执行者运行的影响来评价其有效性，并在固定架构下共同优化角色特定行为（动作生成器、洞察反思器和手册维护者）。在多个智能体基准测试中，	exttt{ACERL}的表现优于基线方法。结果表明，智能体训练不仅应优化当前运行的动作，还应优化未来运行所继承的模型生成经验。

summary: Language models rely on finite token contexts, limiting access to earlier interactions. We introduce Recursive State-Augmented Language Models (Recursive SALM), a framework in which a persistent latent state evolves with each observation and generates adaptations of a pretrained language model. A modular read-transition-write architecture separates observation encoding, latent dynamics, and predictor adaptation. We develop deterministic and stochastic formulations.   The experiments evaluate only deterministic SALM with frozen GPT-2 small and exclude earlier evidence from its decoder context. On a four-turn hypothesis-inference task, latent-gated LoRA reaches 89.1% accuracy, comparable to 88.0% for a trained full-context LoRA baseline, with earlier evidence available solely through a 64-dimensional state. Zeroing or shuffling the state substantially reduces accuracy. In a two-turn task with codewords unseen in training, several interfaces improve candidate ranking over chance, but rarely generate the exact codeword under the evaluated training schedule. These experiments show that persistent latent-conditioned adaptation can support sequential inference when earlier evidence is absent from the decoder context.
title: Recursive State-Augmented Language Models: Persistent Latent-State Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Preprint
title_translated: 递归状态增强型语言模型：预训练语言模型的持久潜在状态自适应
summary_translated: 语言模型依赖有限的标记上下文，限制了对早期交互的访问。我们提出递归状态增强型语言模型（Recursive SALM），一种框架，其中持久的潜在状态随每次观察演化，并生成预训练语言模型的适应版本。采用模块化的读-转移-写架构，分离观察编码、潜在动态和预测器适应。我们开发了确定性和随机性两种形式。实验仅评估确定性SALM，使用冻结的GPT-2 small模型，并排除解码器上下文中早期证据。在一个四轮假设推理任务中，潜在门控LoRA达到89.1%的准确率，与训练完整的上下文LoRA基线（88.0%）相当，且早期证据仅通过一个64维状态提供。将状态置零或打乱会显著降低准确率。在一个两轮任务中，针对训练中未见过的代码词，几种接口提升了候选排序效果，但极少能在给定训练调度下生成精确代码词。这些实验表明，当解码器上下文中缺乏早期证据时，持久的潜在条件适应仍可支持序列推理。

summary: Deep Knowledge Tracing (DKT) is a knowledge tracing (KT) model that updates a shared latent state from sequences of interactions, each pairing a knowledge component (KC) with a response. An interaction with one KC can therefore affect predictions for other KCs. We ask: Are the KC relations learned by DKT semantic? We construct text-derived semantic KC representations using nine pipelines to test whether the conclusions hold across alternative ways of constructing those representations.   The first test compares DKT-derived KC relation graphs with semantic relation structures induced by pairwise cosine similarities among the KC representations. Across the evaluated datasets, embedding models, and pipelines, the two structures align only weakly and inconsistently. The second test introduces semantic information into DKT; the pretrained text-derived representations do not consistently outperform the standard DKT baseline.   In the reduced-data experiments, semantic initialization yields a higher test area under the ROC curve (AUC) than the baseline at eight of nine nested sample sizes for ASSISTments 2017. KC-supervised fine-tuned BERT produces small positive AUC differences in some matched comparisons, but the study does not establish their stability across runs. These effects remain limited and inconsistent. The findings suggest that behavioral, temporal, structural, or psychometric signals may also shape DKT's learned relations. DKT-derived relations are not primarily semantic: the tested text-derived semantic structures do not strongly recover the DKT-derived relation structure.
title: Does Deep Knowledge Tracing Learn Semantic Relations Between Knowledge Components?
title_translated: 深度知识追踪是否学习了知识组件之间的语义关系？
summary_translated: 深度知识追踪（DKT）是一种知识追踪（KT）模型，通过序列化的交互更新共享的潜在状态，每次交互将一个知识组件（KC）与一个回答配对。因此，对一个KC的交互可能影响其他KC的预测。我们提出问题：DKT所学习的KC关系是否具有语义性？我们使用九种不同的文本衍生语义KC表示方法构建测试用例，以检验这些结论在不同表示构造方式下是否成立。第一个测试将DKT生成的KC关系图与基于KC表示之间成对余弦相似性的语义关系结构进行比较。在评估的数据集、嵌入模型和管道中，两者仅表现出微弱且不一致的对齐。第二个测试将语义信息引入DKT；预训练的文本衍生表示并未持续优于标准DKT基线。在减少数据的实验中，语义初始化在ASSISTments 2017数据集中八组嵌套样本大小下均优于基线，AUC更高。KC监督微调的BERT在某些匹配比较中产生小幅正向AUC差异，但研究未证明其跨运行的稳定性。这些效应仍有限且不一致。研究结果表明，行为、时间、结构或心理测量信号也可能塑造DKT所学习的关系。DKT生成的关系并非主要为语义性：所测试的文本衍生语义结构无法有效恢复DKT生成的关系结构。

summary: Coding agents often fail to meet all requirements in the task description. In some of these failures, the agent considers an implementation choice that meets a requirement, but later decides to commit to another one that does not meet the requirement for a reason it finds acceptable. We call this specification satisficing. It is challenging to identify and mitigate specification satisficing because the agent accepts such choices for its own reasons, and existing self-correction methods are biased toward them. We propose SatisFix, which guides a coding agent to report these choices and their reasons, and then check each choice against the task description. We evaluate SatisFix on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Pro with five LLMs as backbones and two different agent frameworks, and compare it with three self-correction methods. SatisFix improves the pass@1 of the base agent by an average of 5.09% on DeepSWE and 7.06% on the hard subset of SWE-bench Pro. On DeepSWE, it outperforms the best baseline by 3.98%. Our ablation study shows that both steps of SatisFix contribute to the improvement.
title: Eliciting and Mitigating Specification Satisficing in Coding Agents
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables
title_translated: 诱发与缓解编码代理中的规范满足现象
summary_translated: 编码代理常常无法满足任务描述中的所有要求。在部分失败中，代理会考虑一种满足要求的实现选择，但随后因自身认为合理的理由而决定采用另一种不满足要求的选择。我们称这种现象为‘规范满足’。由于代理基于自身理由接受此类选择，且现有自我修正方法对此类行为存在偏差，因此识别和缓解规范满足极具挑战性。我们提出SatisFix，引导编码代理报告这些选择及其理由，并逐一检查每项选择是否符合任务描述。我们在DeepSWE和SWE-bench Pro上使用五种LLM作为骨干网络及两种不同的代理框架对SatisFix进行了评估，并与三种自我修正方法进行对比。SatisFix在DeepSWE上平均提升基线pass@1达5.09%，在SWE-bench Pro的困难子集上提升7.06%。在DeepSWE上，其表现优于最佳基线3.98%。消融实验证明，SatisFix的两个步骤均对性能提升有贡献。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on different steps, preserving model's inherent valid behavior while correcting its errors. On two agentic tool-use benchmarks, AppWorld and AutomationBench, JudgeMix demonstrates consistent superior performance to existing methods, with improvements up to 10 pass@1 points.
title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
title_translated: JudgeMix：由裁判指导的混合回溯数据合成用于大语言模型代理
summary_translated: 在专家轨迹上的监督微调（SFT）是训练大语言模型代理的标准范式。然而，该方法存在众所周知的训练-推理分布不匹配问题，亟需能够将训练数据锚定于目标模型本征状态分布的目标感知数据合成策略。为弥合这一差距，现有方法要么将专家用于指导与目标模型并行的混合回溯，要么提供密集的逐步监督。但现有方法在应用专家协助时忽视了目标模型的内在行为：它们要么使用次优的随机干预启发式方法破坏回溯过程，要么施加无差别均匀监督，从而不必要的覆盖了模型已正确的动作。我们提出JudgeMix，一种由裁判指导的数据合成框架，根据逐步语义评估动态交错目标模型与专家。JudgeMix仅在目标模型遇到困难时查询专家指导，确保高轨迹成功率的同时保持状态分布与目标模型一致。此外，它利用裁判评估对不同步骤的专家监督进行重加权，保留模型固有的正确行为，同时纠正其错误。在两个代理工具使用基准测试AppWorld和AutomationBench上，JudgeMix表现出持续优于现有方法的表现，pass@1最高提升达10分。

summary: AI is being deployed across a vast range of application domains, cultural environments, and human stakeholders. Safe and responsible AI development requires continuously accounting for diverse perspectives. We develop and test pluralistic agents, AI agent representatives that deliberate on behalf of individuals to align AI systems with diverse human perspectives. Pluralistic agents could help people contribute to many more discussions than they could directly participate in, on technical topics that would require training, and on policy choices that rely on private information that corporations and governments cannot readily share. Our experiments identify opportunities, risks, and perceptions of pluralistic agents. Agents were able to reliably shift policies in the direction of their represented persona's preferences, but the extent of each agent's influence was sensitive to the instructions from its persona, such as having more influence when instructed to be more verbose or less cooperative. This suggests that influence in AI-assisted deliberation could vary based on how participants prompt their agents and how the system is designed. In a preregistered study, 746 humans participated in the pluralistic agents process. Participants viewed pluralistic agents as useful and fair, preferring agents over the baseline of providing input to a single AI reasoning model. Most participants preferred participating themselves over either pluralistic agents or the baseline, but pluralistic agents recovered 68% of the baseline-direct gap in reported satisfaction and 82% in fairness. Because pluralistic agents can be used in many real-world contexts where direct discussion is not, they could be a promising tool to scale AI safety policy development. We encourage cautious exploration of this method, playing to its strengths as an amplifier of human input rather than a replacement.
title: Scaling public input on AI policy with pluralistic agents
title_translated: 通过多元代理扩展公众对AI政策的参与度
summary_translated: 人工智能正在广泛应用于各种应用领域、文化环境和人类利益相关方中。安全且负责任的人工智能发展需要持续纳入多样化的观点。我们开发并测试了多元代理——代表个体进行协商的AI代理，旨在使人工智能系统与多样化的人类观点对齐。多元代理可帮助人们参与远超其直接参与能力的讨论，涵盖需要专业知识的技术议题，以及依赖私人信息的政策决策，而这些信息企业与政府难以轻易共享。我们的实验揭示了多元代理的机遇、风险与感知。代理能够可靠地将政策导向其所代表人物偏好的方向，但每个代理的影响程度受其角色指令的影响，例如当被指示更冗长或更不合作时，影响力更大。这表明，在AI辅助协商中，影响力可能取决于参与者如何提示其代理以及系统设计方式。在一项预先注册的研究中，共有746名人类参与者参与多元代理流程。参与者认为多元代理有用且公平，更倾向于使用代理而非直接向单一AI推理模型输入意见。尽管大多数参与者更愿意亲自参与，但多元代理弥补了基线直接输入在满意度方面68%的差距，在公平性方面弥补了82%的差距。由于多元代理可在直接讨论不可行的许多现实情境中使用，它们可能是扩展AI安全政策制定的有前景工具。我们鼓励谨慎探索此方法，充分发挥其作为人类输入放大器的优势，而非替代品。

summary: Aerial imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) plays a vital role in applications such as surveillance, disaster response, and large-scale environmental monitoring. Automatic generation of textual descriptions for such imagery is essential for reducing manual inspection overhead and enabling better downstream decision-making. However, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), despite their impressive captioning capabilities, are prone to hallucination, producing descriptions that are inconsistent with the visual input. This problem is significantly amplified in aerial imagery due to its unique challenges such as extreme viewpoint variation, small objects, class imbalance, and ambiguous visual entities. Existing hallucination detection approaches either rely on computationally expensive large external models such as GPT-4, which perform poorly on aerial domains, or treat the problem as a rigid binary classification task, ignoring the inherent uncertainty in ambiguous cases. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight, reference-free framework for hallucination detection and correction in free-form aerial image captioning. Our method leverages state-of-the-art MLLMs, specifically InternVL3 and Qwen2.5-VL, to detect hallucinated content in generated captions with minimal computational overhead. Detected hallucinations are corrected through a dedicated refinement module that improves the factual consistency of the original captions. Extensive experiments on the Labelled Illusion Dataset (LID) demonstrate that our framework significantly reduces hallucination rates while remaining practical for real-time deployment in resource-constrained environments. Code is available at: https://github.com/Debolena7/Hal_Detect.
title: Fine-Grained Generative Hallucination Detection and Correction for Aerial Image Captioning

title_translated: 面向航拍图像描述的细粒度生成幻觉检测与修正
summary_translated: 无人机（UAV）捕获的航拍影像在监控、灾害响应和大规模环境监测等应用中起着至关重要的作用。自动生成此类影像的文本描述对于降低人工检查负担并支持下游决策至关重要。然而，尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备出色的描述能力，却容易产生幻觉，生成与视觉输入不一致的描述。这一问题在航拍影像中尤为严重，因其面临极端视角变化、小物体、类别不平衡和视觉实体模糊等独特挑战。现有幻觉检测方法要么依赖计算成本高昂的大型外部模型（如GPT-4），在航拍领域表现不佳；要么将问题视为刚性的二分类任务，忽略了模糊情况下的固有不确定性。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种轻量级、无需参考的航拍图像自由描述幻觉检测与修正框架。我们的方法利用最先进的MLLMs（如InternVL3和Qwen2.5-VL），以极低的计算开销检测生成描述中的幻觉内容。检测到的幻觉通过专用精炼模块进行修正，从而提升原始描述的事实一致性。在Labelled Illusion Dataset（LID）上的大量实验表明，该框架显著降低了幻觉率，同时在资源受限环境中仍具备实时部署的可行性。代码已公开：https://github.com/Debolena7/Hal_Detect。

summary: Two rewards with the same expected payoff at the start of training can end a reinforcement-learning run in opposite places, with an honest model or one that bluffs. We study rewards that pay $b$ for a verdict that a checker cannot verify ("this program is correct") and $r$ for a certificate that it accepts (an input revealing a bug). To first order, a GRPO step makes the model more honest exactly when $\tilde{p}\,r/b>1+κ$. Here $\tilde{p}$ is the rate at which the checker accepts the model's certificates, weighted toward the items on which the model still gives both verdicts, and $κ$ is the pull of the items on which the unverifiable verdict is right. Both terms move during training. A checker raises $\tilde{p}$, so near the threshold honesty is a race, which a run just below the threshold can win and a run under a lottery (random pay with the same mean) cannot. The term $κ$ starts large and falls as the other items settle, so a run just above the threshold first dips toward bluffing, on code nearly to zero, before climbing back. Paying the honest verdict also pulls the other items toward it, which predicts a ceiling on the payoff ratio, above which the model gives the honest verdict where it is wrong. On propositional Datalog, two code models, and abstention on grade-school math, with $p$ the model's success rate before RL, no run above $pr/b=1$ ends collapsed, and runs under the checker can survive slightly below it. At $pr/b=3$, above the ceiling, both code models call about half of correct programs buggy. On depth-3 Datalog, training generously under the checker and then cutting the payoff keeps the model at least 67% honest in three seeds, at a ratio where the same model trained from the start falls to 4-15% and is at most 47% honest after 160 steps. On depth-2 Datalog, when honesty collapses, a linear probe fit before RL still reads the truth.
title: Honesty Is a Race: Predicting When Verifiable-Reward RL Teaches a Model to Bluff

title_translated: 诚实是一场竞赛：预测可验证奖励强化学习何时使模型撒谎
summary_translated: 在训练初期具有相同期望回报的两种奖励，可能在强化学习过程中导致完全相反的结果，即模型保持诚实或开始撒谎。我们研究了两种奖励机制：一种是对检查器无法验证的断言（如“该程序正确”）支付金额$b$，另一种是对检查器接受的证明（揭示漏洞的输入）支付金额$r$。一阶近似下，GRPO步骤使模型更诚实的条件是$	ilde{p} rac{r}{b} > 1 + κ$。其中$	ilde{p}$是检查器接受模型证明的速率，权重偏向于模型仍能给出两种判断的项目；$κ$是那些不可验证断言正确的项目带来的拉力。这两个参数在训练过程中都会变化。检查器会提升$	ilde{p}$，因此在阈值附近，诚实成为一场竞赛——略低于阈值的训练可能获胜，而随机奖励（均值相同）的训练则无法胜出。$κ$初始较大，随着其他项目趋于稳定而下降，因此略高于阈值的训练最初会倾向于撒谎（针对几乎无错误的代码），之后再回升。奖励诚实断言也会将其他项目拉向诚实方向，这预测了回报比率的上限：超过该上限后，模型会在错误时仍给出诚实判断。在命题Datalog、两个代码模型以及小学数学中的弃权任务中，以$p$表示RL前模型的成功率，所有$pr/b > 1$的训练都不会崩溃，而使用检查器的训练可在略低于该值时存活。当$pr/b=3$（超过上限）时，两个代码模型约一半正确程序被标记为有缺陷。在深度3 Datalog上，通过在检查器下充分训练后再削减回报，三个种子下的模型至少保持67%的诚实性，而在相同比率下从头训练的模型仅降至4-15%，最多47%诚实性。在深度2 Datalog上，当诚实性崩溃时，RL前的线性探测仍能读取真实情况。

summary: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.
title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
title_translated: Curiosity-0826-4B：跨儿童与成人人群的生成式医疗事件序列建模
summary_translated: 我们介绍了Curiosity-0826-4B，这是基于Epic Cosmos数据集训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型的更新版本，能够模拟患者时间线以实现零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B涵盖了更广泛的患者群体和更丰富的临床事件表示，整体表现与前代最大模型Curiosity-0226-1B相当或更优。实验室值预测性能显著提升，MAE较Curiosity-0226-1B降低18%-46%。我们在2至17岁儿童队列中评估了疾病事件预测，新哮喘诊断（AUROC 0.742–0.785）和哮喘加重（AUROC 0.829–0.852）的表现与成人参考队列相当，但镰状细胞危机预测（AUROC 0.820–0.847）低于成人水平（0.915）。通过显式表示记录死亡，实现了成人患者在临终关怀、住院及门诊环境中的新死亡率预测任务（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。基于缩放定律分析，指导了计算最优的初始预训练，并通过上下文扩展进行持续预训练。最终的Curiosity-0826-4B模型参数量更大（43亿 vs 10亿），上下文窗口更长（16K vs 8K），训练token减少56%，但所需浮点运算量（FLOPs）为前代的2.2倍。通过将通用零样本预测策略扩展至儿童患者和更多结局，Curiosity-0826-4B拓宽了无需训练专用模型即可开发临床与运营应用的机会。未来需进一步验证局部校准性、不同患者亚组与事件频率下的表现、时间线完成率，以及在新场景中的泛化能力，并开展前瞻性临床与运营效用评估。

summary: A decision head reads a state and a list of options and returns a probability per option in one forward pass. Once deployed, it usually observes only whether the option it chose was right: logged bandit feedback. We adapt such a head, LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B-Base and 1.7B-Base, from that feedback and report three results. First, the Brier or log score of the sampled action's own probability is not a usable REINFORCE reward: every wrong action earns at least gold's reward, with a mean baseline the lowest-probability wrong action gets the largest advantage, and at two options the signal is zero; in one run it cut accuracy on ordered-scale questions from .636 to .111. Scoring the probability as a loss by the pathwise gradient avoids the collapse, as do the REINFORCE rewards r and r minus p. Second, with full labels, none of four tested bandit arms beat cross-entropy plus one temperature on mean expected calibration error (ECE) over four unseen label schemas. Third, from logged feedback alone, Chosen-Action Proper Scoring (CAPS), the direct method with a proper score on the chosen action's probability, beats fine-tuning on confirmed answers only, which discards negatives: on Banking77 by 2.6 accuracy points, .053 lower ECE and lower selective risk (three seeds against one baseline seed), and by 21.7 points on one seed on emotion data with an often-wrong logger. At N 5000, CAPS stays 1.5 points below full-label training at 0.6B and .6 points at 1.7B against one full-label seed, and propensity weights add nothing on this log. Under feedback flipped at a known rate, one seed per rate, CAPS's confidence tracks the noisy channel on average, backward correction recovers most of the clean calibration, and early stopping on held-out logged outcomes prevented memorising noisy draws in all three runs. Code, adapters, logs and per-record results are public.
title: Learning a calibrated decision head from logged bandit feedback

title_translated: 从日志化的带宽反馈中学习校准的决策头部
summary_translated: 一个决策头部接收状态和一组选项，在一次前向传播中返回每个选项的概率。部署后，通常只能观察到所选选项是否正确：即日志化的带宽反馈。我们基于此反馈对LoRA微调的Qwen3-0.6B-Base和1.7B-Base模型进行了适应，并报告了三项发现。第一，采样动作自身概率的Brier或对数评分不能作为可用的REINFORCE奖励：所有错误动作至少获得黄金奖励，且平均基线使得最低概率的错误动作获得最大优势；在两个选项情况下信号为零；在一次实验中，有序尺度问题的准确率从0.636骤降至0.111。通过路径梯度将概率作为损失进行评分可避免崩溃，同样有效的还有REINFORCE奖励$r$和$r - p$。第二，在完整标签条件下，四种测试的带宽臂均未超越交叉熵加温度系数在四个未见标签模式上的平均期望校准误差（ECE）。第三，仅从日志反馈出发，直接方法Chosen-Action Proper Scoring（CAPS）优于仅基于确认答案的微调（丢弃负例）：在Banking77上准确率高出2.6个百分点，ECE降低0.053，选择性风险更低（三种子对比一个基准种子），在情绪数据上单种子提升21.7分，且日志常出错。在N=5000时，CAPS在0.6B模型上比全标签训练低1.5分，在1.7B模型上低0.6分（对比一个全标签种子），且在此日志上倾向权重无增益。在反馈以已知速率翻转的情况下，每种速率一个种子，CAPS的置信度平均跟踪噪声通道，反向修正恢复了大部分清洁校准，且在所有三次运行中，基于保留日志结果的早停防止了对噪声抽样的记忆。代码、适配器、日志和每条记录结果均已公开。

summary: Emerging personal AI agents raise fundamental scalability and privacy concerns for centralized multi-agent systems (MASs), which rely on a global orchestrator with broad access to agents, resources, and communication. In decentralized environments, global visibility is unavailable. Agents need to proactively discover non-local resources (e.g. tools, skills), and collaborate with other agents to solve tasks. We study decentralized multi-agent collaboration under graph-constrained communication, a natural reflection of human structures. Each agent observes only its local state and can interact only with neighboring agents. We introduce a benchmark with synthetic scalable distributed tool calling with 100K+ tools. Our experiments reveal that recent LLM agents struggle to discover non-local relevant resources and collaborate in decentralized setting. Moreover, standard reinforcement learning fails to reliably overcome this limitation, suggesting that decentralized MAS needs more explicit harness mechanisms for effective collaboration, even using SOTA LLMs. We then present a strong baseline \textbf{GraphHarness}, combining topology-aware warmup with self-improving LLM-based routing. Results show that GraphHarness substantially improves task success (+48.5) and produces higher quality collaboration (+30.6), while using fewer costs (+34.0) than baselines.
title: DecArena: Evaluating Large-Scale Decentralized Multi-Agent Collaboration
title_translated: DecArena：评估大规模去中心化多智能体协作
summary_translated: 新兴的个人AI智能体引发了对集中式多智能体系统（MAS）在可扩展性和隐私方面的根本担忧，这类系统依赖于拥有全局访问权限的中央协调器。在去中心化环境中，全局可见性不可用。智能体需要主动发现非本地资源（如工具、技能），并与其它智能体协作解决问题。我们研究了在图结构通信约束下的去中心化多智能体协作，这自然反映了人类组织结构。每个智能体仅观察其局部状态，且只能与邻近智能体交互。我们引入了一个基准测试，包含超过10万种合成可扩展的分布式工具调用。实验表明，当前LLM智能体在去中心化环境下难以发现非本地相关资源并有效协作。此外，标准强化学习无法可靠克服这一局限，表明即使使用最先进的LLM，去中心化MAS也需要更明确的协作机制。随后我们提出一个强基线方法	extbf{GraphHarness}，结合拓扑感知预热与基于LLM的自改进路由。结果表明，GraphHarness显著提升了任务成功率（+48.5）和协作质量（+30.6），同时成本更低（+34.0）相比基线。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to post-training large language models (LLMs). However, popular RL methods like GRPO incur non-negligible overhead by computing both old-policy and current-policy likelihoods to form importance sampling ratios. In this work, we propose Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization (LGPO), which enforces a soft trust region constraint via likelihood-based gating, eliminating the need to compute old-policy likelihoods. Empirically, we show that removing the importance sampling correction term does not harm training stability, whereas removing the trust region mechanism can lead to collapse. Moreover, ratio-based clipping can fail in fully on-policy training: the importance ratio stays at 1, so the ratio-based trust region constraint never activates. Under standard training settings where GRPO is stable, LGPO achieves comparable training stability and peak performance while reducing training time by ~18% on average relative to a standard implementation that recomputes old-policy likelihoods. In fully on-policy training, where GRPO fails, LGPO remains stable, enabling more efficient and robust LLM RL post-training across training regimes.
title: Is the Importance Ratio Necessary for Stable Reinforcement Learning in LLMs?

title_translated: 在大语言模型的强化学习中，重要性比率是否必要以保证稳定？
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLMs）后训练的核心方法。然而，流行的RL方法如GRPO通过计算旧策略和当前策略的似然来形成重要性采样比率，带来了显著开销。本文提出似然门控策略优化（LGPO），通过基于似然的门控施加软信任区域约束，从而无需计算旧策略似然。实证表明，移除重要性采样修正项不会损害训练稳定性，而移除信任区域机制则可能导致训练崩溃。此外，在完全在线策略训练中，基于比率的裁剪可能失效：重要性比率恒为1，因此信任区域约束从未激活。在GRPO稳定的常规训练设置下，LGPO实现了相当的训练稳定性和峰值性能，同时平均训练时间比标准实现（重新计算旧策略似然）减少约18%。在GRPO失败的完全在线策略训练中，LGPO仍保持稳定，使LLM RL后训练在各种训练范式下更加高效和鲁棒。

summary: Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) aims to retrieve individuals with texts in multiple languages. Despite its practical importance, it has been overlooked by existing research, which mainly focuses on English-only retrieval. The only prior attempt at multilingual TBPR suffers from (1) the absence of a large-scale, multilingual pretraining dataset and (2) a suboptimal model architecture for multilingual text encoding and cross-modal alignment, which employs a shared encoder that overlooks linguistic heterogeneity and relies on English as a pivot for cross-modal alignment, introducing English-centric bias. For this, we contribute MultiPedes, the first large-scale, pedestrian-centric multilingual pretraining dataset. It contains 10 million image-text pairs across four languages, constructed by a multilingual quality-aware data construction pipeline. We also propose ViSeLA (Vision-grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment), a novel framework featuring: (1) a semantic-aware multilingual learning module that extends the mixture-of-experts architecture by routing language-invariant semantics to specialized experts for improved multilingual feature learning; and (2) a vision-grounded cross-modal alignment module that employs a semantic probe to capture fine-grained semantics across modalities, enabling direct cross-modal alignment without relying on a pivot language. Extensive experiments on both multilingual and English-only TBPR datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ViSeLA. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Flame-Chasers/ViSeLA
title: Vision-Grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment for Scalable Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval

title_translated: 面向可扩展多语言文本型人员检索的视觉基础语义学习与对齐
summary_translated: 多语言文本型人员检索（TBPR）旨在通过多种语言的文本检索特定个体。尽管其具有实际重要性，但现有研究主要聚焦于仅英语的检索，忽视了多语言场景。此前唯一尝试多语言TBPR的研究存在两个问题：(1) 缺乏大规模多语言预训练数据集；(2) 模型架构在多语言文本编码和跨模态对齐方面表现不佳，采用共享编码器忽略了语言异质性，并依赖英语作为跨模态对齐的枢纽，引入了以英语为中心的偏差。为此，我们提出了MultiPedes，首个大规模、以行人为核心的多语言预训练数据集，包含四种语言共一千万张图像-文本对，由多语言质量感知的数据构建流程生成。我们还提出了ViSeLA（视觉基础语义学习与对齐）框架，包含：(1) 语义感知的多语言学习模块，通过将语言无关语义路由至专用专家来扩展专家混合架构，提升多语言特征学习能力；(2) 视觉基础的跨模态对齐模块，采用语义探测器捕捉跨模态的细粒度语义，实现无需依赖枢纽语言的直接跨模态对齐。在多语言及仅英语TBPR数据集上的大量实验验证了ViSeLA的有效性。数据集与代码已公开于 https://github.com/Flame-Chasers/ViSeLA

summary: Sequential block schedules can make token commitment in masked diffusion language models appear strongly left-to-right even when within-block order is random or reversed. For equal contiguous blocks processed without interleaving in positional order, with untied irreversible commitments, we use a Spearman-rank identity to express global position-commitment correlation as a deterministic schedule reference plus a weighted mean within-block correlation. In a reported paired study of LLaDA-8B-Instruct on 500 math and code prompts with 256 generated positions and updates, increasing block size from 64 to 128 lowers mean global correlation from 0.9845 to 0.9149. Uniform-random within-block references are already 0.9375 and 0.7500. After calibration, mean within-block correlations are 0.751 and 0.660, so the larger raw residual at block size 128 does not indicate stronger local positional ordering. We give sharp bounds and derive calibrated intervals from reported summaries, while documenting the limitations of the aggregate-only empirical release. The analysis supports schedule-aware interpretation of commitment order; its empirical scope is one checkpoint and two schedules, without evaluation of output quality or inference speed.
title: Schedule-Calibrated Commitment Order in Blockwise Masked Diffusion Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Includes appendices and ancillary code for algebraic verification
title_translated: 块状掩码扩散语言模型中的时序校准承诺顺序
summary_translated: 顺序块调度会使掩码扩散语言模型中的标记承诺表现出强烈的从左到右特性，即使块内顺序是随机或逆序的。对于未交错处理的等长连续块，在位置顺序中无连接的不可逆承诺下，我们使用Spearman秩恒等式将全局位置-承诺相关性表示为确定性调度参考加上块内相关性的加权均值。在对LLaDA-8B-Instruct模型在500个数学与代码提示上进行的配对研究中，块大小从64增加到128时，平均全局相关性从0.9845降至0.9149。块内均匀随机参考的相关性分别为0.9375和0.7500。经校准后，块内平均相关性为0.751和0.660，表明块大小为128时更大的原始残差并不反映更强的局部位置排序。我们给出了严格的界限并推导出校准区间，同时记录了仅基于聚合结果的经验发布所存在的局限性。该分析支持对承诺顺序进行时序感知的解释；其经验范围限于一个检查点和两种调度，未评估输出质量或推理速度。

summary: Window-based next-act evaluation often aims to measure generalisation across dialogues, yet overlapping windows and similarity retrieval can expose labelled examples from the test dialogue. The nearest such example is the target's labelled predecessor, whose act is correct when the target continues it and wrong when the target changes act; a model that copies it can gain and lose in two subgroups that one aggregate averages. We induce this exposure under controlled designs on SGD, STAR and AMI, whose official splits are clean. Randomly including the predecessor's row in training raises a lexical classifier's continuation scores and lowers its transition scores in all three corpora, and purging the adjacent rows removes most of the gain. With TF-IDF-retrieved demonstrations, two 7B instruction-tuned models show the same opposite pattern in all eight model-corpus-sample arms (some single-cell intervals include zero; one replication is partial), while natural-weight accuracy changes by only -0.05 to +0.04. Exposure frequency depends on the retrieval pipeline. We evaluate two diagnostic comparisons without model retraining and find that excluding the test dialogue does not detectably reduce accuracy on SGD. All exposure is induced; no published system was re-evaluated.
title: The Neighbour's Label: Opposite Subgroup Effects of Same-Dialogue Exposure in Next-Act Evaluation
title_translated: 邻居的标签：同一对话暴露对下一行为评估中对立子组效应的影响
summary_translated: 基于窗口的下一行为评估通常旨在衡量跨对话的泛化能力，但重叠窗口和相似性检索可能导致测试对话中的标注示例被暴露。最近的此类示例是目标的标注前驱，当目标延续其行为时正确，改变行为时错误；一个复制该前驱的行为模型在两个子组中可能获得收益和损失，而整体平均值会掩盖这种差异。我们在SGD、STAR和AMI数据集上通过受控设计诱导这种暴露，这些数据集的官方划分是干净的。在训练中随机包含前驱行会提高词汇分类器的延续得分并降低其转换得分，而在所有三个语料库中清除相邻行可消除大部分增益。使用TF-IDF检索的示范样本，两个7B指令微调模型在全部八个模型-语料库-样本组合中表现出相同的相反模式（部分单细胞区间包含零；一次复现不完整），而自然权重准确率仅变化-0.05至+0.04。暴露频率取决于检索流程。我们进行了两项无需重新训练模型的诊断比较，发现排除测试对话并未显著降低SGD上的准确率。所有暴露均为人为诱导；无已发表系统被重新评估。

summary: Mathematical proof assistants such as Coq, Agda, and Lean 4 build proof irrelevance into definitional conversion ($p \equiv q$ for $p, q : P$ with $P : Prop$), erasing which derivation established a theorem. While natural for mathematics over fixed axioms, judgmental proof irrelevance is incompatible with verified scientific stores, which must inspect and compare independent derivations of the same claim to assess consilience and compute counterfactual retractions when an assay, reagent, or model is invalidated. Moreover, combining definitional proof irrelevance with subsingleton elimination breaks strong normalization and renders algorithmic conversion non-transitive.   We present the type-theoretic and institutional foundations of Eigenius, a verified knowledge substrate for science. First, we formulate a dependent kernel with cumulative universes ($Prop, Set, Type_k$), impredicative $Prop$, inductive families with index-forced subsingleton elimination, and intensional identity types, where definitional equality $\equiv$ is untyped joinability under an orthogonal CRS and proof irrelevance is a witnessed propositional axiom ($irrel : ΠP{:}Prop.\,Πp,q{:}P.\,Id\,P\,p\,q$). Second, we unify universe cumulativity, codomain-covariant $Π$-subtyping, and ontology class inclusions in a coercion-free subsumption judgment whose bidirectional fragments ($\mathcal{K}_0, \mathcal{K}_1$) satisfy subject reduction and are sound and complete for declarative typing. Third, we organize external verifiers into a three-level institutional hierarchy with explicit axiom policies (Adopt, Discharge, Relativize), internalize a justification logic with Why-provenance semiring support $supp(j,P)$, and embed Cooper's Type Theory with Records (TTR) to type open-world knowledge graphs. Finally, we prove consistency in Grothendieck universes and mechanize the metatheory in Lean 4 with zero sorry axioms.
title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions: A Proof-Relevant Type Theory for Verified Science
title_translated: 建构性制度中的类型化知识：用于验证科学的证明相关类型论
summary_translated:
数学证明助手如Coq、Agda和Lean 4将证明无关性嵌入定义转换中（对于P : Prop，有p ≡ q，其中p, q : P），从而擦除哪一种推导建立了定理。虽然这对固定公理下的数学自然适用，但判断层面的证明无关性与验证性科学存储不兼容，后者必须检查和比较同一主张的独立推导以评估一致性，并在检测到实验、试剂或模型失效时计算反事实撤回。此外，将定义性证明无关性与子单例消除结合会破坏强正规化性，并使算法转换失去传递性。我们提出了Eigenius的类型论与制度基础，这是一个用于科学的验证知识底座。首先，我们构建了一个带有累积宇宙（Prop, Set, Type_k）、非预设性Prop、索引强制子单例消除的归纳族以及外延等价类型的依赖核，其中定义相等性≡是在正交CRS下的无类型可合并性，而证明无关性是一个有见证的命题公理（irrel : ΠP{:}Prop.
Πp,q{:}P.
Id
P

q）。其次，我们在无强制转换的隶属判断中统一了宇宙累积性、余域协变Π-子类型和本体类包含，其双向片段（K₀, K₁）满足主题还原性，且在声明式类型系统中是可靠且完备的。第三，我们将外部验证者组织成三级制度层级，包含明确的公理策略（采纳、释放、相对化），内化了一种理由逻辑，支持Why-溯源半环supp(j,P)，并嵌入Cooper的带记录类型论（TTR）以对开放世界知识图谱进行类型化。最后，我们在Grothendieck宇宙中证明了系统的一致性，并在Lean 4中以零sorry公理机制化了元理论。

summary: LLMs are increasingly used for forecasting, and the best forecasting systems retrieve news as evidence to strengthen their predictions. This also opens them to attack. We study the weakest attacker of this kind, who knows only the forecasting question and publishes fabricated news articles, with no access to the model, the retriever or its queries. We evaluate how far this attack reaches on stock questions and real prediction-market questions. Once the article is in the model's context, it reverses 74% to 82% of the forecasts that opposed it, on every frontier model we tested. The model cannot verify the fabrication and follows it anyway. Retrieval is the attack's entry point, and the systems built to retrieve well are the most exposed: the architectures of two leading deployed forecasting systems, whose agents search for every related article, retrieve the fabricated one in about 90% of runs. Accuracy cannot reveal this harm: the attacked forecaster is right when the attacker's direction turns out right and wrong otherwise, so its average accuracy barely changes while its forecasts follow the attacker's guess. We also propose a second attacker, who publishes two articles that argue opposite directions to make the forecaster unsure. The model does not hedge; it returns a confident forecast in a direction the attacker no longer controls. We then evaluate the two strongest published retrieval-time defenses, passage filtering and partitioned retrieval. Each stops the one-article attack but is bypassed by a one-prompt change to the attack. Together they stop both bypasses at four articles, but sixteen distorted copies beat them, and they change 29% of clean decisions and discard 39% of the genuine news. Partitioned retrieval also requires control of the retrieval index. Systems that search the open web have no such control and are left with the filter alone. For them, the attack still works.
title: One Fabrication Is Enough: A Fake News Article Changes the Forecasts of LLM Forecasting Systems

title_translated: 一次伪造即足够：一篇假新闻文章改变了大语言模型预测系统的预测
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于预测任务，最佳预测系统通过检索新闻作为证据来增强其预测。但这也使其面临攻击风险。我们研究了此类攻击中最弱的攻击者：他仅知晓预测问题，发布伪造新闻文章，但无模型、检索器或其查询的访问权限。我们评估该攻击在股票问题和真实预测市场问题上的影响范围。一旦文章进入模型上下文，它便逆转了我们测试的所有前沿模型中74%至82%与其立场相反的预测。模型无法验证伪造内容，仍会遵循该信息。检索是攻击入口，那些为良好检索而构建的系统最为脆弱：两个领先部署的预测系统，其代理会搜索每一篇相关文章，约在90%的运行中检索到该伪造文章。准确性无法揭示此危害：当攻击者的方向最终正确时，被攻击的预测者是正确的，否则就是错误的，因此其平均准确率几乎不变，但预测却跟随攻击者的意图。我们还提出第二种攻击者，发布两篇方向相反的文章，使预测者陷入不确定。模型不会采取保守策略；它仍返回一个自信的预测，而该方向已不再受攻击者控制。随后我们评估了两种最强的已发表检索时间防御措施：段落过滤和分区检索。每种都能阻止单篇文章攻击，但可通过一次提示更改绕过。两者结合可阻止两种绕过方式，但需四篇文章才能实现，而十六个扭曲副本即可突破，且它们改变了29%的正常决策并丢弃了39%的真实新闻。分区检索还需控制检索索引。那些搜索开放网络的系统没有此类控制，只能依赖过滤器。对他们而言，攻击依然有效。

summary: Humanity has long sought to explain natural phenomena. Reliable prediction of experimental outcomes is a central test of our understanding of the processes that produce them. If artificial general intelligence (AGI) is to surpass human scientific capabilities, it must also predict experimental outcomes more reliably than humans. Such capabilities could accelerate scientific discovery across disciplines, help address humanity's most pressing challenges, and improve human well-being. We introduce Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of hidden experimental outcomes with 100 public verified tasks from chemistry, materials science, biology and medicine, and 16 private tasks from unpublished wet-lab experiments. Given an experimental setup and candidate conditions, an agent works with any resources it needs to rank the candidates by a measured outcome.   We evaluate thirteen agent configurations spanning twelve frontier models across two harnesses (Codex and Claude Code). Current agents remain far from saturating wet-lab outcome prediction, with substantial performance disparities across models: on the public benchmark, configurations separate into two distinct tiers, with task-adjusted Spearman correlations ranging from 0.227 for the lowest-performing configuration to 0.478 for the best. Analysis of 1,155 scored public trajectories (227,103 tool calls) suggests that the bottleneck lies in scientific judgment rather than tool execution: agents rely on shared monotone priors, agreeing far more with one another than with experimental reality (0.52 vs. 0.33), and frequently compute trivial physical or chemical proxies that do not influence the final outcome.
title: Science Prediction Universe

title_translated: 科学预测宇宙
summary_translated: 人类长期以来致力于解释自然现象。对实验结果的可靠预测是检验我们对其产生过程理解的核心标准。如果人工智能要超越人类的科学能力，就必须比人类更可靠地预测实验结果。这种能力可以加速跨学科的科学发现，帮助应对人类最紧迫的挑战，并提升人类福祉。我们提出了科学预测宇宙（SPU），一个包含100个公开验证任务的隐藏实验结果基准，涵盖化学、材料科学、生物学和医学领域，以及16个来自未发表湿实验的私有任务。在给定实验设置和候选条件的情况下，智能体可使用任意资源对候选方案按测量结果进行排序。我们评估了十三种智能体配置，覆盖十二个前沿模型及两种工具链（Codex和Claude Code）。当前智能体距离完全掌握湿实验结果预测仍有很大差距，不同模型间性能差异显著：在公开基准上，配置分为两个明显层级，任务调整后的斯皮尔曼相关系数从最低配置的0.227到最佳配置的0.478不等。对1,155条已评分公开轨迹（227,103次工具调用）的分析表明，瓶颈在于科学判断而非工具执行：智能体依赖共享的单调先验，彼此之间的一致性远高于与实验现实的一致性（0.52 vs. 0.33），且频繁计算不影响最终结果的平凡物理或化学代理。

summary: Mechanistic localization does not by itself yield usable control: causal sensitivity may occupy little activation energy, an accurate local direction may fail at finite scale, and a reachable numeral target may be wrong. We introduce AROMA (Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation), a frozen-VLM control framework separating where to intervene, which geometry and gain to use, how to reach a target, which target to pursue, and when to act. In Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, four dimensions of a causally validated cross-attention head explain 89.82% of cardinality sensitivity but only 9.52% of median activation energy; magnitude-normalized causal subspace actuation converts this mismatch into finite control, improving exact-count accuracy on untouched procedural data by +8.00 pp. Iterative Minimal-Effort Actuation (MEA) reaches 81.25% of oracle targets versus 15.18% for a frozen direction under matched step budgets. With target and gate frozen before evaluation, targeted MEA improves the previous frozen policy from 34.444% to 38.730% on a new natural Stage-2 cohort (N=630; paired p=4.63e-7) and yields 65.741% versus 65.153% over all 7,992 examples while editing only 63 inputs. Prospective routing, replication across heads and models, and comparisons with attribution-steering baselines further characterize each stage, separating localization, actuation, reachability, target quality, and selective deployment as distinct control problems.
title: AROMA: Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation for Vision-Language Model Control

title_translated: AROMA：面向视觉-语言模型控制的自适应表示导向多模态操作
summary_translated: 机制定位本身并不能带来可用的控制：因果敏感性可能仅占据极少激活能量，精确的局部方向在有限尺度下可能失效，而可达的目标数值也可能是错误的。我们提出了AROMA（自适应表示导向多模态操作），一种冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM）控制框架，将干预位置、几何形状与增益选择、目标到达方式、目标追求策略以及行动时机分离处理。在Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct中，一个因果验证的交叉注意力头的四个维度解释了89.82%的基数敏感性，但仅解释了9.52%的中位激活能量；通过幅度归一化的因果子空间操作，将这一不匹配转化为有限控制，在未接触的程序数据上使精确计数准确率提升了+8.00个百分点。迭代最小努力操作（MEA）在相同步数预算下达到81.25%的最优目标命中率，远超冻结方向的15.18%。在评估前冻结目标与门控的情况下，针对性MEA将先前冻结策略的准确率从34.444%提升至38.730%（N=630；配对p=4.63e-7），并在全部7,992个样本上达到65.741%对比65.153%，同时仅修改了63个输入。前瞻性路由、跨头与跨模型的复现，以及与归因引导基线的比较进一步刻画了每个阶段，将定位、操作、可达性、目标质量与选择性部署区分为独立的控制问题。

summary: Machine learning models are often trained on labeled data produced by multiple human annotators. When those annotators disagree, their labels are commonly collapsed into a single majority vote, which discards information about the underlying disagreement. We examine the cost of this practice for cyberbullying severity, a subjective judgment on which annotators disagree heavily. In the corpus we study, all 5 annotators assigned the same severity label to only 4.1% of comments. Turning 5 judgments into one label hides this disagreement and obscures how much the annotators differed in their assessments. In this paper, we ask whether a model can preserve this information by predicting the distribution of annotator judgments instead of a single majority label. We find 3 main results. First, accuracy against the majority label cannot tell competent models apart: 2 models with similar accuracy can differ greatly in how well they match the distribution of annotator judgments. Second, predicting the full distribution requires little extra effort. Calibrating an existing model, which adjusts its output probabilities after training, captures most of the improvement without retraining, across 3 datasets covering severity, abuse, and irony, while training on label distributions adds a small further gain. Third, we examine a dataset that includes annotator demographics, where a single shared model has one advantage and one limit. The advantage is that a model predicting the distribution of judgments matches each demographic group's judgments significantly better than a model trained on majority labels, so both groups gain. The limit is that it does not narrow the gap in performance between the groups, because one shared model cannot encode which group is right on a given comment. Preserving annotator disagreement is therefore a low-cost step toward fairer moderation, though not a complete one.
title: Calibrate, Don't Retrain: Decomposing the Value of Annotator Disagreement in Cyberbullying Severity
