title_translated: 校准而非重训练：分解标注者分歧在网络欺凌严重性判断中的价值
summary_translated: 机器学习模型通常基于多个标注者提供的标注数据进行训练。当标注者存在分歧时，其标签常被合并为单一多数票，从而丢弃了潜在分歧信息。我们研究了这一做法在网络欺凌严重性判断中的代价，该判断具有高度主观性，标注者间分歧极大。在所研究语料库中，所有5名标注者对同一评论给出相同严重性标签的情况仅占4.1%。将5个判断简化为一个标签会掩盖这种分歧，并模糊标注者评估之间的差异程度。本文探讨模型是否可通过预测标注者判断分布而非单一多数标签来保留此类信息。我们发现三个主要结果：第一，对多数标签的准确率无法区分能力强弱模型：两个准确率相近的模型在匹配标注者判断分布方面可能差异巨大。第二，预测完整分布所需额外成本极低。通过校准现有模型（训练后调整输出概率）即可捕获大部分改进，无需重新训练，涵盖严重性、滥用和讽刺三类数据集，而基于标签分布的训练仅带来小幅提升。第三，我们考察了一个包含标注者人口统计信息的数据集，单一共享模型具有一项优势和一项局限。优势在于，预测判断分布的模型能显著优于多数标签训练模型，更好地匹配各群体的判断，使双方均受益；局限在于，它无法缩小群体间的性能差距，因为单一模型无法编码某一评论中哪个群体更正确。因此，保留标注者分歧是一种低成本实现更公平内容审核的途径，但并非完全解决方案。

summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are compared mainly by accuracy averaged across findings, a summary that can hide complete failure on a single diagnosis. We audit five open medical VLMs (MedGemma-4B, Lingshu-7B, HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and MedVLM-R1) on 6,048 ChestX-ray14 questions balanced by sex, age, finding, and label. On the 432 pneumothorax-positive X-rays, HuatuoGPT-Vision and Qwen2.5-VL detect zero cases while MedGemma and Lingshu detect 38% and 67% of the same images. The two failing models answer "no" to all 864 pneumothorax cases (balanced accuracy 0.500, chance), yet produce fluent, anatomically specific explanations that name the signs of a collapsed lung and then deny them, with no hedge or abstention. This failure is not an artifact of prompting, image resolution, label ambiguity, or model scale. It persists across four prompt formats, at native resolution, and on single-label cases. A within-model control shows the same forced prompt gives HuatuoGPT 79% recall on nodule but only 6% on pneumothorax. It survives a tenfold scale increase (Qwen2.5-VL-72B detects 4%) and replicates on SIIM-ACR, an independent dataset with radiologist-drawn masks, where the failing models detect 0 of 432 confirmed pneumothoraces, including 0 of the 144 largest lesions. Reading the models' logits and internal states shows this is not blindness. The two failing models are highly confident yet no better than chance and a linear probe recovers pneumothorax from their hidden representations even where recall is zero, so the finding is represented internally but suppressed at the output. Aggregate accuracy therefore cannot establish that a medical VLM can see a given finding, because a model that misses one can still describe it convincingly. Reporting per-finding recall and specificity on balanced cases is needed to tell the difference.
title: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Diagnosis-Specific Failure in Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Medical Reasoning with Vision Language Foundation Models (Med-Reasoner). 16 pages including NeurIPS checklist, 1 figure, 5 tables
title_translated: 聚合准确率掩盖了医疗视觉-语言模型在诊断上的特定失败
summary_translated: 医疗视觉-语言模型（VLMs）主要通过跨发现的平均准确率进行比较，这一汇总指标可能掩盖单个诊断上的彻底失败。我们在6,048个ChestX-ray14问题上审计了五款开源医疗VLM（MedGemma-4B、Lingshu-7B、HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B和MedVLM-R1），这些问题是按性别、年龄、发现类型和标签平衡的。在432张气胸阳性X光片中，HuatuoGPT-Vision和Qwen2.5-VL未能检测出任何病例，而MedGemma和Lingshu分别检测到38%和67%的相同图像。这两个失败模型对全部864个气胸病例均回答“否”（平衡准确率为0.500，即随机水平），却生成流畅且解剖学具体的解释，提及塌陷肺的征象后又予以否认，且无任何保留或回避。这种失败并非提示工程、图像分辨率、标签模糊性或模型规模所致。它在四种提示格式、原始分辨率及单标签情况下均持续存在。模型内对照显示，相同的强制提示下，HuatuoGPT在结节检测中召回率达79%，但在气胸检测中仅为6%。即使扩大十倍规模（Qwen2.5-VL-72B检测到4%），该失败依然存在，并在SIIM-ACR独立数据集（放射科医生绘制掩码）上复现，失败模型在432例确诊气胸中检测为0，包括144个最大病灶也全漏检。分析模型logits和内部状态表明，这不是盲视。两个失败模型高度自信，但表现仅相当于随机水平；线性探测器可在其隐层表示中恢复气胸信号，即使召回率为零，说明该发现已在内部表征，但被输出阶段抑制。因此，聚合准确率无法证明医疗VLM能够识别某一特定发现，因为一个遗漏某发现的模型仍可令人信服地描述它。报告平衡案例下的每诊断召回率和特异性才是区分关键。

summary: Coding agents can solve a task well before they stop working on it. We characterize \emph{termination lag}--the number of steps between an agent's first correct patch and the end of its run--across five models, two agent frameworks, and three SWE-bench datasets by recording and testing every distinct repository patch generated during execution. Our analysis reveals that 38--82% of successful runs achieve a correct solution on their initial source-code edit. However, agents continue to expend substantial effort after correct patches, with post-solution steps accounting for a median of 35--37% for Qwen3-Coder and 54--60% for Laguna-XS.2 in successful runs on SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual. Agents spend most of these additional steps verifying their work and exploring the repository. In a small fraction of cases (1--8%), this continued activity leads agents to undo their earlier correct patch, leaving the final solution incorrect.
title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
title_translated: 终止延迟：编码智能体提前解决但过晚停止
summary_translated: 编码智能体可以在停止工作之前很早就完成任务。我们通过记录并测试执行过程中生成的每一个独立代码仓库补丁，对五个模型、两种智能体框架和三个SWE-bench数据集中的终止延迟——即智能体首次生成正确补丁与运行结束之间的步骤数——进行了刻画。分析显示，38%至82%的成功运行在其首次源代码编辑时就已获得正确解。然而，智能体在生成正确补丁后仍继续投入大量精力，其中后续步骤占成功运行的中位数为35%–37%（Qwen3-Coder）和54%–60%（Laguna-XS.2）在SWE-bench Verified和Multilingual数据集上。智能体大多将这些额外步骤用于验证自身工作和探索代码仓库。在极少数情况（1%–8%）下，这种持续活动导致智能体撤销早期正确的补丁，最终解变为错误。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates across heterogeneous domains, but existing editing methods fail when applied sequentially to multi-task settings. We trace this collapse to inter-domain null-space misalignment: heterogeneous tasks induce distinct Jacobian geometries, causing their common null space to shrink dramatically and leaving insufficient admissible directions for conflict-free updates. We propose the Conflict Index to quantify this geometric interference, and introduce Mu-Edit, which mitigates multi-task conflicts via (1) conflict-aware ordering to minimize cumulative interference, and (2) dynamic low-rank approximation to expand the null space when ordering alone is insufficient. Experiments across five functional domains and three backbones show that Mu-Edit significantly outperforms existing baselines in multi-task editing performance while preserving general capabilities, and remains effective under incremental task arrival.
title: MuEdit: An efficient multi-task editing method towards inter-domain knowledge conflicts
comment: 30 pages,accepted by NeurIPS 2026
title_translated: MuEdit：一种针对跨域知识冲突的高效多任务编辑方法
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）需要在异构领域中频繁更新知识，但现有编辑方法在多任务设置下顺序应用时会失效。我们发现这一问题源于跨域零空间错位：不同任务诱导出不同的雅可比几何结构，导致其公共零空间大幅缩小，从而缺乏足够的无冲突更新方向。我们提出了冲突指数来量化这种几何干扰，并引入Mu-Edit方法，通过（1）冲突感知的排序以最小化累积干扰，以及（2）动态低秩近似以在排序不足以解决问题时扩展零空间。在五个功能领域和三种骨干模型上的实验表明，Mu-Edit在多任务编辑性能上显著优于现有基线，同时保持了通用能力，并在任务增量到达时仍具有效性。

summary: Forward-KL language-model distillation normally computes dense teacher and student scores over the full vocabulary at every supervised position, making training and stored teacher targets expensive. We instead distill from the teacher's highest-probability vocabulary fraction, renormalizing the retained mass as we sweep support from 100% to 0.01%. Our main study distills Qwen3 4B -> 1.7B. We confirm the broader support-reduction finding on larger Qwen3 8B -> 4B and Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B pairs and under answer-only supervision. We evaluate generation primarily on MMLU-Pro and secondarily on GPQA-Diamond. Across the Qwen3 settings, retaining 0.01% of the vocabulary causes no observed MMLU-Pro degradation relative to full-vocabulary distillation, although disagreement with the complete teacher distribution increases. Nemotron Nano matches full-vocabulary MMLU-Pro at 0.1%, but smaller fractions fail to emit the closing reasoning tag, showing that the reliable cutoff depends on the model family. At 0.01% support, caching the retained next-token scores from the teacher forward pass cuts training step time by 38%, while restricting student output computation to those tokens cuts peak memory by 24%; neither causes observed MMLU-Pro degradation.
title: Effective Teacher Support for Reasoning Distillation
title_translated: 有效教师支持下的推理蒸馏
summary_translated: 前向KL语言模型蒸馏通常在每个监督位置对完整词汇表计算密集的教师与学生得分，导致训练和存储教师目标成本高昂。我们改为从教师最高概率的词汇子集进行蒸馏，并在支持范围从100%降至0.01%的过程中重新归一化保留的质量。主要研究基于Qwen3 4B -> 1.7B的蒸馏。我们在更大的Qwen3 8B -> 4B和Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B对以及仅答案监督下验证了更广泛的支持缩减现象。生成评估主要在MMLU-Pro上进行，次要在GPQA-Diamond上。在Qwen3设置中，保留0.01%的词汇量相对于全词汇蒸馏未观察到MMLU-Pro性能下降，尽管与完整教师分布的差异增加。Nemotron Nano在0.1%支持下达到全词汇MMLU-Pro水平，但更小的分数无法输出结束推理标签，表明可靠截止点依赖于模型家族。在0.01%支持下，缓存教师前向传播中保留的下一个词得分可使训练步骤时间减少38%，限制学生输出计算范围可将峰值内存降低24%；两者均未造成可观测的MMLU-Pro性能下降。

summary: People are increasingly using conversational AI systems to make decisions despite concerns around their reliability. How well do people calibrate to AI systems' accuracy in multi-turn conversations? We measure how people's reliance on LLMs' advice changes across repeated interactions, varying whether the AI assistant is helpful (100% accurate), unhelpful (0% accurate), or mixed (50% accurate). Across 4 experiments, we find people learn to trust helpful models more than unhelpful ones (67% vs 21% of the time), but only when they receive external feedback on the models' accuracy. Without feedback, people continue to be persuaded 48% of the time by a consistently unhelpful model (vs 38% for helpful). Rather than gaining trust in helpful models, participant reliance on LLM advisors tended to be high in early trials and only fell with evidence of inaccuracy. Participants trusted LLM advisors more than they trusted human advisors (83% vs 65%, Experiment 4), and LLMs benefited more from having a helpful track record than humans did. In contrast with previous work, we find limited evidence of an advantage for arguing for the truth (versus a falsehood). Truth advantages emerged only when participants were already very confident in their position, and did not emerge at all for static hints. Collectively, the results suggest that people may be swayed by LLM advice, even when it is consistently false, unless they have access to timely ground-truth feedback. Unfortunately, in many domains such feedback may not be available, leading to overreliance on AI.
title: Do People Trust AI Assistants Even When They Are Consistently Wrong?
comment: 51 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Preprint, not peer reviewed
title_translated: 即使AI助手始终错误，人们还会信任它吗？
summary_translated: 尽管对可靠性存在担忧，人们越来越多地使用对话式AI系统来做决策。人们在多轮对话中如何校准对AI系统准确性的认知？我们测量了人们在重复交互中对LLM建议依赖程度的变化，考察AI助手是否始终有用（100%准确）、无用（0%准确）或混合（50%准确）。在四项实验中，我们发现人们能更好地信任有用的模型（67% vs 21%的时间），但前提是他们获得了关于模型准确性的外部反馈。没有反馈时，人们仍会在48%的情况下被一个始终无用的模型说服（而有用模型为38%）。人们并非真正建立对有用模型的信任，而是早期试验中对LLM顾问的依赖度较高，只有在出现不准确证据后才下降。参与者对LLM顾问的信任度高于对人类顾问（83% vs 65%，实验4），且LLM从良好记录中获益更多。与以往研究相反，我们未发现主张真相相比虚假具有明显优势的证据。只有当参与者已非常自信时，真相优势才显现，而在静态提示条件下则完全不存在。总体而言，结果表明，除非人们能获得及时的真实反馈，否则可能被LLM建议所影响，即使其内容一贯错误。遗憾的是，在许多领域这种反馈可能不可得，导致对AI的过度依赖。

summary: Proof-step verification rewrites a solver's answer into typed steps and uses LLM judges to certify or decline. We evaluate this pipeline on open-weight models across GPQA, AIME-2025, and a MATH-500 subset. Certification raises answer-key-match precision by 31 percentage points on the strong GPQA configuration and 46 on AIME, while answering only 35% and 21% of attempts. On near-ceiling MATH-500, gains are at most 5 points at a loss of 13-27 points of coverage. An output-token-matched self-consistency selector obtains 82.9% precision at 35% coverage, compared with the verifier's pooled 87.6% (paired difference: +4.8 points, 95% interval [-8.2, 18.5]). A diagnostic sample reveals a distinct failure mode: 52 of 88 completed problems end in invalid proof construction without ever reaching a judge. Finally, external-LLM acceptance of rendered certified chains is 61.0-67.6%, compared with 87.6% answer-key match. These audits lack human or formal-kernel ground truth. Open-weight auditor pairs show near-zero chance-corrected agreement, which measures consistency rather than accuracy against proof truth. These results motivate separate reporting of execution failures, selected-answer precision, and independently assessed proof validity. We provide per-configuration results and evaluation details in the supplement.
title: When Is Proof-Step Verification Worth Its Cost? Operating Requirements of Certify-or-Decline Verification for Open-Weight Mathematical Reasoning
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 13 tables. Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI) at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 证明步骤验证是否值得其代价？开放权重数学推理中‘认证或拒绝’验证的操作要求
summary_translated: 证明步骤验证将求解器的答案重写为带类型的步骤，并使用LLM裁判进行认证或拒绝。我们在开放权重模型上对GPQA、AIME-2025和MATH-500子集进行了评估。认证在强GPQA配置下使答案匹配精度提升31个百分点，在AIME上提升46个百分点，但仅回答了35%和21%的尝试。在接近天花板的MATH-500上，收益最多仅为5分，却损失了13-27分的覆盖率。输出词匹配的自一致性选择器在35%覆盖率下实现82.9%的精度，而验证器的合并结果为87.6%（配对差异：+4.8分，95%置信区间[-8.2, 18.5]）。诊断样本揭示了一种独特失败模式：88个完成的问题中有52个因无效证明构建而从未到达裁判阶段。外部LLM对已渲染认证链的接受率为61.0%-67.6%，低于87.6%的答案键匹配率。这些审计缺乏人工或形式内核的真值。开放权重审计对之间的机会修正一致性接近零，这衡量的是内部一致性而非对证明真实性的准确性。这些结果促使分别报告执行失败、选定答案精度和独立评估的证明有效性。我们在附录中提供了各配置的结果和评估细节。

summary: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. But how do humans use temporal cues for dynamic, fine-grained social coordination? And can AI systems do the same, without ``experiencing'' continuous real-time as humans do? We study these questions using a cooperative card game task called The Mind, which requires players to achieve a shared goal across repeated interactions but forbids explicit communication: the only available signal is the passage of time. We evaluate 150 humans, and two classes of AI models which reflect different ways of operationalizing time in artificial systems: computer-use agents (CUAs), and standard text-prompted LLMs. We find that human behavior is best captured by a Bayesian strategy that infers a partner's belief from their timing---and similarly for frontier models. However, unlike humans, none of the tested models seem to efficiently adapt their behaviors to their partners' over the course of the game. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that humans perform implicit probabilistic reasoning about continuous-time signals in dynamic social settings, and that such reasoning mechanisms may emerge without real-time experience. Practically, our study highlights new challenges for AI systems to coordinate efficiently with other agents by learning to interpret and adapt to their implicit signals in dynamic settings.
title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
comment: 30 pages, 16 figures
title_translated: 人类与AI在社会协调中的时间理性使用
summary_translated: 所有社会互动都发生在时间之中。先前研究表明，人类能够利用隐含的时间线索（如停顿持续时间）推断他人的心理状态。但人类如何利用时间线索进行动态、精细的社会协调？AI系统能否做到这一点，而无需像人类一样‘经历’连续实时？我们通过一种名为《心灵》的合作卡牌游戏任务来研究这些问题，该任务要求玩家在重复互动中达成共享目标，但禁止显式沟通：唯一可用信号是时间的流逝。我们评估了150名人类，以及两类反映人工智能系统中时间操作方式不同的AI模型：计算机使用代理（CUAs）和标准文本提示LLMs。我们发现，人类行为最符合一种贝叶斯策略，即根据对方的时机推断其信念——前沿模型也表现出类似行为。然而，与人类不同，所有测试模型似乎都无法在游戏过程中有效适应其伙伴的行为。从认知角度看，我们的发现表明人类能够在动态社会环境中对连续时间信号进行隐含的概率推理，而这种推理机制可能无需真实时间体验即可产生。从实践角度，本研究突出了AI系统在动态环境中学习解读并适应其他智能体隐含信号方面的全新挑战。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. Across three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks, we find that LLMs can produce highly consistent code explanations in several settings. Code explanations are also 6$\times$ to 100$\times$ shorter than CoT, and better align with model behavior in 9 out of 24 settings. However, consistency is significantly lower on tasks with more complex linguistic components, where generated programs reproduce model outputs no more frequently than an uninformative explanation baseline, and these programs often rely on longer hard-coded patterns. In experiments with Claude Opus 5.5, providing the model with consistency feedback and code execution improves explanation consistency across tasks, but consistency remains significantly lower on more complex tasks. Our findings establish executable code as a novel, verifiable, and compact approach to explaining LLM behavior and highlight verification feedback as a promising direction for improving explanation consistency. The code for this paper is at https://github.com/rajesh-lab/code-as-explanations.
title: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables, The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
title_translated: 代码作为解释：可执行且可验证的大型语言模型解释
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地独立做出重要决策并协助人类解决问题，理解模型如何得出结论变得至关重要。理解LLM的行为需要在多个输入上观察其表现，但传统的自由文本解释（如思维链CoT）是针对单个实例生成的，难以在新输入上进行验证。我们提出使用‘代码解释’来解决LLM解释生成方式与评估方式之间的不匹配问题：一个程序可以跨数据集输入解释LLM行为，其执行过程支持自动验证。我们定义了‘一致性’度量标准，用于衡量程序在多少输入上能复现LLM的输出，并据此评估和选择候选程序。在三个开源代码能力LLM和八个任务中，我们发现LLM在某些场景下能够生成高度一致的代码解释。代码解释比CoT短6至100倍，并且在24个场景中的9个里与模型行为更一致。然而，在涉及复杂语言成分的任务上，一致性显著降低，生成的程序复现模型输出的频率并不优于无信息基线，且这些程序往往依赖于较长的硬编码模式。在Claude Opus 5.5的实验中，向模型提供一致性反馈和代码执行结果能提升各任务上的解释一致性，但在更复杂任务上仍显著偏低。我们的研究确立了可执行代码作为一种新颖、可验证且紧凑的LLM行为解释方法，并强调验证反馈是提升解释一致性的一个有前景方向。本文代码见：https://github.com/rajesh-lab/code-as-explanations。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard stage of language model post-training, and the compute devoted to it is growing rapidly. While it has been shown to improve capabilities, particularly for tasks with verifiable rewards, it can also change behaviours and internal properties that the reward does not explicitly target. We present a formalism to describe the evolution of "traits" during RL post-training and, in doing so, recover the Price equation from evolutionary biology. We use this to develop a mathematical model for what we call "trait hitchhiking": the amplification or suppression of non-targeted traits as training redistributes probability across completions. We evaluate this Price update expression on language models trained with GRPO and show that the Price estimates closely track the sampled trait dynamics. These results identify trait hitchhiking as a mechanism by which RL post-training can silently amplify undesirable traits.
title: Trait Hitchhiking in LLM Post-Training
title_translated: 大语言模型后训练中的特质搭便车现象
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）如今已成为语言模型后训练的标准阶段，投入的计算资源正迅速增长。尽管已有研究表明RL能提升模型能力，特别是在具有可验证奖励的任务中，但它也可能改变那些奖励并未明确指向的行为和内部属性。我们提出了一个形式化框架来描述RL后训练过程中‘特质’的演化，并在此过程中重新推导出进化生物学中的Price方程。基于此，我们构建了一个数学模型，描述我们称之为‘特质搭便车’的现象：在训练过程中，概率在不同完成结果间重新分配，导致非目标特质被放大或抑制。我们在使用GRPO训练的语言模型上评估了这一Price更新表达式，发现Price估计值与采样到的特质动态高度吻合。这些结果表明，特质搭便车是RL后训练中无声放大不良特质的一种机制。

summary: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.
title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error

title_translated: 当世界仍保留错误时，清理代理的历史反而有害
summary_translated: 使用工具的语言模型代理会积累自身错误的历史记录，而一个对历史进行压缩、修复或移交的系统，决定了它如何表述这些错误，但这些错误的影响仍存在于外部世界中。以往工作通常在固定的世界状态下清理历史，即展示修正步骤并声称已完成，二者同步进行。我们探讨的是：同样的正确内容，根据历史如何表述以及世界状态如何，可能带来帮助或损害。我们冻结代理在任务中途的精确世界状态，编辑历史或世界，然后让接收模型继续执行。在AgentCE-Bench上，代理犯错后，我们保持世界不变，通过两种自然编辑添加正确值：一种是在保留错误旁添加真实说明，另一种是代理自身完成的动作。前者提升了恢复率（接收模型正确完成剩余目标的比例），从匹配中性说明下的51%提升至66%；后者则使其下降至44%，低于未编辑历史的50%，说明仅存在正确值并不能预测其效果。在AppWorld中，数据库写入后，我们改变其接收是否报告成功或失败，以及其影响是否仍存在。当影响不存在时，成功报告使整体任务成功率从45%降至28%；一旦影响存在，则从38%升至49%。两个效应在两名接收者中合计差异达27个百分点，其中六名接收者在97.5%置信水平下为正，七名在95%水平下为正。因此，历史编辑的效果取决于其所描述的世界状态；当历史看似已清理，但世界仍保留错误时，代理反而可能比完全不编辑更差。

summary: Sharing research data is essential to promote transparency, enable reproducibility, and fuel scientific discoveries. To ensure consistent sharing, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and other funding agencies require applicants to submit data management plans (DMPs) with their proposals. They aim to encourage researchers to consider their data management and sharing strategies early on. However, researchers often face challenges when developing DMPs due to a lack of knowledge about data-sharing practices. Here, we evaluated the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in drafting DMPs compliant with the 2023 NIH guidelines. The goal was to investigate whether LLM-supported DMP creation could reduce the burden on researchers and librarians. We compared Llama and GPT performance against NIH-provided DMP samples. We also asked domain experts to evaluate LLM-generated DMPs. Overall, we found that LLMs can accelerate the creation of initial drafts but still require expert review before submission to ensure clarity and completeness. Moreover, open-source LLMs may not be as ready off-the-shelf as commercial ones for drafting funder-compliant DMPs.
title: Evaluating the Performance of LLMs in Drafting NIH Data Management Plans
title_translated: 评估大型语言模型在撰写NIH数据管理计划中的表现
summary_translated: 共享研究数据对于促进透明性、实现可重复性以及推动科学发现至关重要。为确保数据共享的一致性，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）及其他资助机构要求申请人在提交提案时附上数据管理计划（DMP）。其目的是鼓励研究人员尽早考虑数据管理与共享策略。然而，由于缺乏对数据共享实践的知识，研究人员在制定DMP时常面临挑战。本文评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在撰写符合2023年NIH指南的DMP方面的表现。目标是探究LLM辅助DMP创建是否能减轻研究人员和图书馆员的负担。我们将Llama和GPT的表现与NIH提供的DMP样本进行比较，并邀请领域专家评估LLM生成的DMP。总体而言，我们发现LLMs能够加速初始草稿的生成，但仍需专家审查以确保清晰性和完整性。此外，开源LLMs在起草符合资助方要求的DMP方面，可能不如商用模型即开即用。

summary: Survey estimates for population segments, such as media use by sex and age, rest on few respondents per cell, and a growing literature offers synthetic respondents generated by large language models to fill the gap. That literature has not tested them against the small-area estimators a methodologist would otherwise use. We ran ten estimators, preregistered, on identical household-clustered splits of a Korean media panel across five calibration budgets and three holdout regimes. A multilevel partial-pooling model of the MRP family led every calibration-only estimator at every budget, matching at one hundred respondents what direct estimation reaches with roughly four times as many. On unobserved segments, information fixed as a per-segment prior was inert for synthetic panel and previous wave alike; attached as a bias correction it transferred, at the price of estimation noise. No registered synthetic advantage over MRP survived the paired decision rule. Entered instead as a covariate inside the multilevel model, an exploratory hybrid, the same panel improved on MRP on unobserved segments: the information survives where the registered constructions did not. Interval coverage stayed below nominal throughout and worsened with budget for partial pooling, contrary to prediction.
title: Partial pooling beats synthetic respondents as estimators, not as covariates: a preregistered small-sample tournament

title_translated: 部分分组优于合成受访者作为估计器，而非协变量：一项预注册的小样本竞赛
summary_translated: 针对人口子群体（如按性别和年龄划分的媒体使用情况）的调查估计，常因每单元样本量过少而面临挑战，现有文献提出使用大型语言模型生成的合成受访者来填补空白。然而，该文献尚未将其与方法学家通常使用的小区估计器进行对比测试。我们进行了十种估计器的预注册实验，使用韩国媒体面板数据，在五个校准预算和三种保留方案下，采用相同的家庭聚类分割。结果显示，属于MRP家族的多层次部分分组模型在所有预算下均优于仅校准的估计器，仅用一百名受访者即可达到直接估计约四倍样本量的效果。在未观测子群体上，作为每个子群体先验信息固定的条件在合成面板和前一周期中均无效；若作为偏差校正附加，则可传递信息，但代价是增加估计噪声。在配对决策规则下，没有注册的合成优势能持续存在。然而，当将同一合成面板作为协变量引入多层次模型中作为探索性混合模型时，其在未观测子群体上的表现优于MRP：信息得以保留，而注册构造中未能实现。区间覆盖率在整个过程中均低于名义水平，且随预算增加而恶化，与预期相反。
